// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/AdSuspect.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

/**
 * "Son izin verilenler" listesinde reklam/yönlendirme sunucusuna BENZEYEN adları öne çıkarır. Engellemez: yalnızca
 * kullanıcıya hangisini engelleyeceğini gösterir (kararı kullanıcı verir). Bu yüzden ara sıra yanlış işaretleme zararsızdır;
 * yine de yaygın siteler işaretlenmesin diye kurallar dar tutuldu (ölçüm: tools/ analizinde ilk 10 bin sitenin ~%0,5'i).
 *
 * İpuçları (puanlar toplanır, [THRESHOLD] ve üstü "şüpheli"):
 *  - Etiket parçalarında reklam/izleme sözcükleri: ads, adserver, banner, popunder, track, trk, pixel, redirect, affiliate… (+3)
 *  - Kayıtlı adın onaltılık rastgele dizi olması (ör. 0017c6c37c.com) (+3)
 *  - Uzun sessiz harf dizisi (ör. krmwbimfpndw) (+2), harf-rakam karışımı (ör. 1jutu5nnx) (+2)
 *  - Kötüye kullanımı yüksek, yaygın sitelerde neredeyse hiç görülmeyen uzantılar (.cfd, .cyou, .icu, .sbs…) (+2),
 *    reklam ağlarında sık ama meşru kullanımı da olan uzantılar (.top, .xyz, .online, .site…) (+1)
 *  - 20+ harfli tek sözcük öbeği (dönen yönlendirme adlarına özgü: "launchingonsetwhirlwind") (+1)
 * Ad cihazdan çıkmaz; hesap tamamen yereldir.
 */
object AdSuspect {
    const val THRESHOLD = 3

    private val WORDS = setOf(
        "ad", "ads", "adv", "advert", "adverts", "advertising", "adserver", "adservice", "adsrv", "adserv", "adtech", "adnet",
        "banner", "banners", "pop", "popup", "popups", "popunder", "popads", "track", "tracker", "tracking", "trk", "trck",
        "pixel", "pixels", "beacon", "click", "clicks", "clk", "redirect", "redir", "rdr", "aff", "affiliate", "affiliates",
        "promo", "promos", "push", "pushnotify", "notify", "analytics", "metrics", "telemetry", "stats", "counter", "hit", "hits",
        "bet", "casino", "reklam", "reklamlar", "sponsor", "sponsored", "smartlink", "offerwall", "monetize", "monetization",
    )

    /** Kötüye kullanımı yüksek, ilk 200 bin sitede neredeyse hiç görülmeyen uzantılar. */
    internal val RISKY_TLDS = setOf(
        "cfd", "cyou", "icu", "sbs", "rest", "quest", "monster", "buzz", "bond", "autos", "boats", "beauty", "hair", "makeup",
        "skin", "homes", "yachts", "mom", "cam",
    )
    private val COMMON_ABUSED_TLDS = setOf("top", "xyz", "online", "site", "space", "click", "website", "pw", "bid", "win", "loan", "work")
    private val VOWELS = "aeiouy"

    fun isSuspect(name: String): Boolean = score(name) >= THRESHOLD

    fun score(raw: String): Int {
        val name = raw.lowercase().trimEnd('.')
        val labels = name.split('.')
        if (labels.size < 2 || labels.any { it.isEmpty() }) return 0
        var s = 0
        val tld = labels.last()
        // kayıtlı ad: "x.com.tr" gibi iki parçalı soneklerde bir önceki etiket
        val sldIdx = if (labels.size >= 3 && labels[labels.size - 2] in SECOND_LEVEL && tld.length == 2) labels.size - 3 else labels.size - 2
        val sld = labels[sldIdx]

        var word = false
        for (i in 0 until labels.size - 1) {
            for (tok in labels[i].split('-', '_')) {
                val t = tok.trimEnd { it.isDigit() }.trimStart { it.isDigit() }
                if (t in WORDS) { word = true; break }
            }
            if (word) break
        }
        if (word) s += 3

        val digits = sld.count { it.isDigit() }
        val letters = sld.count { it in 'a'..'z' }
        if (sld.length >= 8 && sld.all { it in '0'..'9' || it in 'a'..'f' } && digits >= 2 && letters >= 2) s += 3
        else {
            if (maxConsonants(sld) >= 6) s += 2
            if (sld.length >= 8 && digits >= 3 && letters >= 3 && MIXED.containsMatchIn(sld)) {
                // harf-rakam-harf geçişi birden çoksa (ör. x7k2m9) rastgele üretilmiş ad olasılığı yüksek
                s += if (ALTERNATING.containsMatchIn(sld)) 3 else 2
            }
        }
        if (tld in RISKY_TLDS) s += 2 else if (tld in COMMON_ABUSED_TLDS) s += 1
        if (letters >= 20 && letters == sld.length) s += 1
        return s
    }

    private val MIXED = Regex("[a-z][0-9]+[a-z]")
    private val ALTERNATING = Regex("[a-z][0-9][a-z]+[0-9][a-z]")
    private val SECOND_LEVEL = setOf("com", "net", "org", "co", "gen", "web", "biz", "info", "gov", "edu", "ac", "bel", "k12")

    private fun maxConsonants(s: String): Int {
        var m = 0; var c = 0
        for (ch in s) {
            if (ch in 'a'..'z' && ch !in VOWELS) { c++; if (c > m) m = c } else c = 0
        }
        return m
    }
}

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/AeroArt.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/**
 * Frutiger Aero çizimleri: gökyüzü, cam kartlar, parlak düğmeler, sıvı küre, kabarcıklar, anahtar, kaydırıcı.
 * Yalnızca [Gfx] kullanır (Android'e de AWT'ye de bağlı değil). Bir örnek tek bir tema + cam yoğunluğu içindir;
 * tema veya cam değişince yeni örnek kurulur. Boyuta bağlı gradyanlar ilk kullanımda üretilip saklanır,
 * böylece kare başına bellek ayrılmaz.
 */
open class AeroArt(val theme: AeroTheme, val glass: Float) {
    protected val dark = theme.dark
    protected val aTop = GlassMath.top(glass, dark)
    protected val aBot = GlassMath.bottom(glass, dark)
    protected val aTopStrong = GlassMath.top(1f, dark)
    protected val aBotStrong = GlassMath.bottom(1f, dark)

    protected fun white(a: Float) = Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, a)
    protected fun tint(a: Float) = Rgb.alpha(theme.tint, a)

    /** Alt sayfa ve bildirimlerin "dolu cam" rengi: arkadaki içerik görünmesin diye neredeyse opak. */
    private val solidTop: Int = if (dark) Rgb.alpha(Rgb.over(tint(0.10f), theme.skyMid), 0.97f)
        else Rgb.alpha(Rgb.lerp(Rgb.WHITE, theme.skyTop, 0.18f), 0.96f)
    private val solidBottom: Int = if (dark) Rgb.alpha(Rgb.over(tint(0.05f), theme.skyBottom), 0.97f)
        else Rgb.alpha(Rgb.lerp(Rgb.WHITE, theme.skyMid, 0.22f), 0.94f)

    /** Üst parıltının başlangıç opaklığı: açık temada belirgin, koyu temada hafif. */
    protected val sheen = if (dark) 0.11f else 0.34f

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ stil kancaları (Aqua varsayılanı)

    /** Bu çizicinin stili. */
    open val style: UiStyle get() = UiStyle.AQUA

    /** Süs parçacıklarının davranışı ve çizimi (Aqua: yükselen kabarcıklar). */
    open val particleMode: ParticleMode get() = ParticleMode.RISE

    /** Süs parçacığı. [phase] 0..2π yavaş değişen evre (sallanma, dönüş, parıltı için). Varsayılan: kabarcık. */
    open fun particle(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, alpha: Float, phase: Float) = bubble(g, cx, cy, r, alpha)

    /** Arka planda sürekli hareket eden katman var mı (çim sallanması vb.)? Varsa hareket açıkken kareler akar. */
    open val liveSky: Boolean get() = false

    /**
     * Bir karenin arka planı. [live] açıksa (hareket açık) hareketli parçalar [time] sn'ye göre çizilir; kapalıysa
     * dinlenme hallerinde. Varsayılan: durağan [sky].
     */
    open fun skyFrame(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, live: Boolean, time: Float) = sky(g, w, h)

    /** Stilin hareket kişiliği (sayfa geçişi, liste girişi). */
    open val motion: StyleMotion get() = StyleMotion.AQUA

    /** Başlık yazısı çarpanı (Metro büyük yazı kullanır). */
    open val titleScale: Float get() = 1f

    /** Sahne saati (sn): kart ve düğme süsleri (parıltı, tarama ışığı) bununla oynar. Sahne her karede yazar. */
    var clock: Float = 0f

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ gökyüzü

    private class SkyStyle(val w: Float, val h: Float, theme: AeroTheme, dark: Boolean) {
        val base = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, theme.skyTop, theme.skyMid, theme.skyBottom, AeroTheme.SKY_MID_POS)
        val bloom = Fill.radial(
            w * 0.20f, -h * 0.04f, w * 1.25f,
            Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0.10f else 0.66f),
            Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0.04f else 0.22f),
            Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f), 0.42f,
        )
        private val ribbon = if (dark) theme.accent else Rgb.WHITE
        private val ra = if (dark) 0.5f else 1f
        val ribbonA = Fill.linear(
            0f, 0f, w, 0f,
            Rgb.alpha(ribbon, 0.03f * ra), Rgb.alpha(ribbon, 0.21f * ra), Rgb.alpha(ribbon, 0.03f * ra), 0.55f,
        )
        val ribbonB = Fill.linear(
            0f, 0f, w, 0f,
            Rgb.alpha(ribbon, 0.02f * ra), Rgb.alpha(ribbon, 0.13f * ra), Rgb.alpha(ribbon, 0.02f * ra), 0.40f,
        )
        val haze = Fill.linear(
            0f, h * 0.62f, 0f, h,
            Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0.04f else 0.20f),
        )
        val pathA = GPath()
        val pathB = GPath()

        init {
            pathA.moveTo(-0.1f * w, 0.70f * h)
                .cubicTo(0.25f * w, 0.50f * h, 0.62f * w, 0.88f * h, 1.1f * w, 0.52f * h)
                .lineTo(1.1f * w, 0.66f * h)
                .cubicTo(0.62f * w, 1.02f * h, 0.25f * w, 0.66f * h, -0.1f * w, 0.90f * h)
                .close()
            pathB.moveTo(-0.1f * w, 0.30f * h)
                .cubicTo(0.30f * w, 0.18f * h, 0.70f * w, 0.42f * h, 1.1f * w, 0.20f * h)
                .lineTo(1.1f * w, 0.27f * h)
                .cubicTo(0.70f * w, 0.50f * h, 0.30f * w, 0.26f * h, -0.1f * w, 0.38f * h)
                .close()
        }
    }

    private var sky: SkyStyle? = null

    /** Tüm ekranı kaplayan gökyüzü: gradyan, ışık hâlesi, iki yumuşak şerit ve alt sis. */
    open fun sky(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float) {
        var s = sky
        if (s == null || s.w != w || s.h != h) { s = SkyStyle(w, h, theme, dark); sky = s }
        g.paint(s.base); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(s.bloom); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(s.ribbonB); g.path(s.pathB)
        g.paint(s.ribbonA); g.path(s.pathA)
        g.paint(s.haze); g.rect(0f, h * 0.62f, w, h)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ kabarcık

    private val bubbleBody = Fill.radial(
        0f, 0f, 1f,
        tint(0.03f), tint(0.10f), white(if (dark) 0.34f else 0.62f), 0.68f,
    )
    private val bubbleRim = Fill.linear(-1f, -1f, 1f, 1f, white(0.95f), white(0.18f))
    private val softSpot = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, white(0.95f), white(0f))
    private val bounceSpot = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, Rgb.alpha(theme.accentLight, 0.75f), Rgb.alpha(theme.accentLight, 0f))

    /** Sabun köpüğü gibi parlak, saydam küre. [alpha] 0..1. */
    open fun bubble(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, alpha: Float) {
        if (alpha <= 0.01f || r <= 0.5f) return
        g.save()
        g.translate(cx, cy)
        g.scale(r, r)
        g.alpha(alpha)
        g.paint(bubbleBody); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f)
        g.strokeWidth(0.07f)
        g.paint(bubbleRim); g.strokeCircle(0f, 0f, 0.96f)
        // üst-sol parlama
        g.save(); g.translate(-0.36f, -0.44f); g.rotate(-34f); g.scale(0.27f, 0.14f)
        g.paint(softSpot); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()
        if (r >= 9f) {
            // alt-sağ yansıma
            g.save(); g.translate(0.40f, 0.50f); g.rotate(-40f); g.scale(0.22f, 0.09f)
            g.paint(bounceSpot); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()
        }
        g.restore()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ cam kart

    private class CardStyle(
        val w: Float, val h: Float, rad: Float, art: AeroArt,
    ) {
        val body = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, art.tint(art.aTop), art.tint(art.aBot))
        val bodyStrong = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, art.solidTop, art.solidBottom)
        val selTint = Fill.linear(
            0f, 0f, 0f, h,
            Rgb.alpha(art.theme.accentLight, if (art.dark) 0.22f else 0.30f),
            Rgb.alpha(art.theme.accent, if (art.dark) 0.14f else 0.16f),
        )
        val gloss = GPath()
        val glossFill: Fill
        val rim = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, art.white(if (art.dark) 0.60f else 0.95f), art.white(if (art.dark) 0.14f else 0.34f))
        val rimSel = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, art.theme.accentLight, art.theme.accent)

        init {
            val k = rad.coerceIn(0f, min(w, h) / 2f)
            val edgeL = max(k, h * 0.50f)
            val edgeR = max(k, h * 0.27f)
            val bow = max(edgeL, edgeR) + h * 0.13f
            gloss.moveTo(0f, edgeL)
            gloss.lineTo(0f, k)
            gloss.arc(k, k, k, k, 180f, 90f, true)
            gloss.lineTo(w - k, 0f)
            gloss.arc(w - k, k, k, k, -90f, 90f, true)
            gloss.lineTo(w, edgeR)
            gloss.quadTo(w * 0.52f, bow, 0f, edgeL)
            gloss.close()
            glossFill = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, max(edgeL, edgeR) + h * 0.06f, art.white(art.sheen), art.white(art.sheen * 0.12f))
        }
    }

    private val cards = LongCache<CardStyle>(80)

    protected fun key(w: Float, h: Float, r: Float): Long =
        (((w * 2f).toInt().toLong() and 0xFFFFFL) shl 40) or (((h * 2f).toInt().toLong() and 0xFFFFFL) shl 20) or ((r * 2f).toInt().toLong() and 0xFFFFFL)   // alanlar maskelenir: eksi değer üst alanları bozmasın

    private fun cardStyle(w: Float, h: Float, rad: Float): CardStyle {
        val k = key(w, h, rad)
        var s = cards[k]
        if (s == null) {
            s = CardStyle(w, h, rad, this)
            cards[k] = s
        }
        return s
    }

    /** Dışa doğru sönen yumuşak gölge halkaları (kartın altına değil, yalnızca dışına çizilir). */
    private fun shadow(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, rad: Float, strength: Float) {
        val n = 6
        val step = 1.9f
        val base = (if (dark) 0.14f else 0.085f) * strength
        g.strokeWidth(step + 0.35f)
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            val f = 1f - i / n.toFloat()
            g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, base * f * f))
            val e = 0.9f + i * step
            val dy = 1.6f + i * 0.4f
            g.strokeRoundRect(-e, -e + dy, w + e, h + e + dy, rad + e)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Cam kart. [selected] 0..1 vurgu kenarı ve renk; [press] 0..1 basılı parlama; [strong] 0..1 daha opak yüzey
     * (alt sayfalar için); [shadow] gölge katsayısı (0 = yok).
     */
    open fun card(
        g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, rad: Float,
        selected: Float = 0f, press: Float = 0f, strong: Float = 0f, shadow: Float = 1f,
    ) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        val rr = min(rad, min(w, h) / 2f)
        val st = cardStyle(w, h, rr)
        g.save()
        g.translate(l, t)
        if (shadow > 0f) shadow(g, w, h, rr, shadow)
        g.paint(st.body); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr)
        if (strong > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(strong); g.paint(st.bodyStrong); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr); g.restore() }
        if (selected > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(selected); g.paint(st.selTint); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr); g.restore() }
        g.paint(st.glossFill); g.path(st.gloss)
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f)
        g.paint(st.rim); g.strokeRoundRect(0.6f, 0.6f, w - 0.6f, h - 0.6f, max(0f, rr - 0.6f))
        if (selected > 0f) {
            g.save(); g.alpha(selected)
            g.strokeWidth(2f)
            g.paint(st.rimSel); g.strokeRoundRect(1.1f, 1.1f, w - 1.1f, h - 1.1f, max(0f, rr - 1.1f))
            g.restore()
        }
        if (press > 0f) {
            g.save(); g.alpha(press)
            g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, 0.20f)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr)
            g.restore()
        }
        g.restore()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ parlak düğme (seçili çip, birincil)

    private class PillStyle(val w: Float, val h: Float, art: AeroArt) {
        val body = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, art.theme.control, art.theme.controlDeep)
        val gloss = GPath()
        val glossFill: Fill
        val rim = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, art.white(0.80f), Rgb.alpha(art.theme.accentLight, 0.60f))

        init {
            val k = min(w, h) / 2f
            gloss.arc(k, k, k, k, 180f, 90f, false)
            gloss.lineTo(w - k, 0f)
            gloss.arc(w - k, k, k, k, -90f, 90f, true)
            gloss.lineTo(w, h * 0.50f)
            gloss.quadTo(w * 0.5f, h * 0.64f, 0f, h * 0.50f)
            gloss.close()
            glossFill = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h * 0.55f, art.white(0.40f), art.white(0.05f))
        }
    }

    private val pills = LongCache<PillStyle>(40)

    /** Dolu, parlak vurgu düğmesi (tam yuvarlak uçlu). Beyaz yazı üzerinde okunur. [alpha] ile solup gelebilir. */
    open fun pill(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, press: Float = 0f, shadow: Float = 1f) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        val k = key(w, h, 0f)
        var st = pills[k]
        if (st == null) {
            st = PillStyle(w, h, this); pills[k] = st
        }
        g.save()
        g.translate(l, t)
        if (shadow > 0f) {
            val n = 4
            g.strokeWidth(2.2f)
            for (i in 0 until n) {
                val f = 1f - i / n.toFloat()
                g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.controlDeep, (if (dark) 0.24f else 0.11f) * shadow * f * f))
                val e = 1.1f + i * 1.9f
                g.strokeRoundRect(-e, -e + 2f, w + e, h + e + 2f, h / 2f + e)
            }
        }
        g.paint(st.body); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        g.paint(st.glossFill); g.path(st.gloss)
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f)
        g.paint(st.rim); g.strokeRoundRect(0.6f, 0.6f, w - 0.6f, h - 0.6f, h / 2f - 0.6f)
        if (press > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(press); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, 0.22f)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f); g.restore() }
        g.restore()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ sıvı küre

    private class OrbStyle(val r: Float, art: AeroArt) {
        private val th = art.theme
        private val dk = art.dark
        val ground = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, Rgb.alpha(th.shadow, if (dk) 0.60f else 0.34f), Rgb.alpha(th.shadow, 0f))
        val glow = Fill.radial(
            0f, 0f, r * 1.75f,
            Rgb.alpha(th.glow, 0.62f), Rgb.alpha(th.glow, 0.22f), Rgb.alpha(th.glow, 0f), 0.52f,
        )
        val glass = Fill.radial(
            0f, 0f, r,
            art.white(if (dk) 0.05f else 0.10f), art.white(if (dk) 0.09f else 0.16f), art.white(if (dk) 0.40f else 0.72f), 0.70f,
        )
        val bounce = Fill.linear(
            0f, r * 0.10f, 0f, r,
            Rgb.alpha(th.accentLight, 0f), Rgb.alpha(th.accentLight, if (dk) 0.34f else 0.55f),
        )
        val liquid = Fill.linear(
            0f, -r, 0f, r,
            Rgb.alpha(th.accentLight, 0.97f), Rgb.alpha(th.accent, 0.97f), Rgb.alpha(th.accentDeep, 1f), 0.38f,
        )
        val liquidBack = Fill.linear(
            0f, -r, 0f, r,
            Rgb.alpha(th.accentLight, 0.55f), Rgb.alpha(th.accent, 0.55f), Rgb.alpha(th.accentDeep, 0.6f), 0.38f,
        )
        val liquidErr = Fill.linear(
            0f, -r, 0f, r,
            Rgb.alpha(ERR_LIGHT, 0.97f), Rgb.alpha(ERR_MID, 0.97f), Rgb.alpha(ERR_DEEP, 1f), 0.38f,
        )
        val rim = Fill.linear(-r * 0.75f, -r * 0.75f, r * 0.75f, r * 0.75f, art.white(0.96f), Rgb.alpha(th.accent, 0.62f))
        val shine = Fill.linear(0f, -1f, 0f, 1f, art.white(0.88f), art.white(0.05f))
        val crescent = GPath().arc(0f, 0f, r * 0.86f, r * 0.86f, 38f, 104f, false)
        val wave = GPath()
        val wave2 = GPath()
    }

    private val orbs = LongCache<OrbStyle>(6)

    private val bx = floatArrayOf(-0.48f, -0.16f, 0.26f, 0.52f, -0.04f, 0.12f)
    private val bs = floatArrayOf(0.55f, 0.80f, 0.45f, 0.65f, 1.00f, 0.38f)
    private val bo = floatArrayOf(0.00f, 0.31f, 0.57f, 0.82f, 0.16f, 0.68f)
    private val br = floatArrayOf(2.4f, 1.7f, 3.0f, 1.9f, 1.5f, 2.6f)

    private fun fillWave(p: GPath, r: Float, yLevel: Float, amp: Float, phase: Float, cycles: Float) {
        p.reset()
        val n = 28
        val x0 = -r - 3f
        val x1 = r + 3f
        for (i in 0..n) {
            val u = i / n.toFloat()
            val x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * u
            val y = yLevel + amp * orbFlow.gain * orbGain * orbFlow.offset(u, cycles, phase)
            if (i == 0) p.moveTo(x, y) else p.lineTo(x, y)
        }
        p.lineTo(x1, r + 3f).lineTo(x0, r + 3f).close()
    }

    /** Ana düğmenin şekli. Sahne her karede yazar; [OrbShape.CIRCLE] özgün cam küredir. */
    var orbShape: OrbShape = OrbShape.CIRCLE

    /** Sıvının hareket biçimi ([OrbFlow]); sahne her karede yazar. [OrbFlow.CALM] özgün dalgadır. */
    var orbFlow: OrbFlow = OrbFlow.CALM
    /** Kendi stilim kaydırıcısı: sıvı dalga yüksekliği çarpanı (1 = normal). */
    var orbGain: Float = 1f

    /** Sıvının üstüne karışan hız tonu ve oranı (0 = ton yok). Sahne bağlantı gecikmesine göre yazar ([OrbMath.tintColor]). */
    var liquidTint: Int = 0
    var liquidTintAmt: Float = 0f

    /** Sıvının rengi (opak ARGB); 0 = temanın kendi rengi. Seçiliyse hız tonu uygulanmaz. */
    var liquidColor: Int = 0

    private class LiquidFills(r: Float, c: Int) {
        val liquid = Fill.linear(0f, -r, 0f, r,
            Rgb.alpha(Rgb.lerp(c, Rgb.WHITE, 0.40f), 0.97f), Rgb.alpha(c, 0.97f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.lerp(c, 0xFF000000.toInt(), 0.40f), 1f), 0.38f)
        val back = Fill.linear(0f, -r, 0f, r,
            Rgb.alpha(Rgb.lerp(c, Rgb.WHITE, 0.40f), 0.55f), Rgb.alpha(c, 0.55f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.lerp(c, 0xFF000000.toInt(), 0.40f), 0.6f), 0.38f)
    }

    private val liquidFills = LongCache<LiquidFills>(8)

    private fun liquidFillsFor(r: Float): LiquidFills? {
        val c = liquidColor
        if (c == 0) return null
        val k = ((c.toLong() and 0xFFFFFF) shl 24) or (r * 2f).toInt().toLong()
        var f = liquidFills[k]
        if (f == null) { f = LiquidFills(r, c); liquidFills[k] = f }
        return f
    }

    private class ShapePaths(shape: OrbShape, r: Float) {
        val outline = shape.outline(GPath(), r)
        val inner = shape.outline(GPath(), r - 1.6f)
        val ring = shape.outline(GPath(), r - 5f)
    }

    private val shapeCache = LongCache<ShapePaths>(10)

    private val decoPaths = LongCache<GPath>(24)

    /** Seçili şeklin çizgisi, [delta] kadar büyütülmüş (eksi: küçültülmüş). Önbellekli; kare başına ayırma yapmaz. */
    protected fun orbPath(r: Float, delta: Float): GPath {
        val k = key(r, delta + 16f, 50f + orbShape.ordinal)
        var p = decoPaths[k]
        if (p == null) { p = orbShape.outline(GPath(), r + delta); decoPaths[k] = p }
        return p
    }

    /** Süslerin kırpıldığı alan: küre için özgün daire, diğer şekiller için şeklin [inset] kadar içi. */
    protected fun clipOrb(g: Gfx, r: Float, inset: Float) {
        if (orbShape == OrbShape.CIRCLE) g.clipCircle(0f, 0f, r - inset) else g.clipPath(orbPath(r, -inset))
    }

    /**
     * Şeklin süs sabitleri: [x]/[y] yarıçap katı olarak (küre için özgün konum). Sıra: filiz, parıltı 1, parıltı 2.
     */
    protected fun decoX(i: Int): Float = if (orbShape.isShield) ShieldData.DECO[orbShape.shieldNumber - 1][i * 2] else DECO[orbShape.ordinal][i][0]
    protected fun decoY(i: Int): Float = if (orbShape.isShield) ShieldData.DECO[orbShape.shieldNumber - 1][i * 2 + 1] else DECO[orbShape.ordinal][i][1]


    /** Dalga dolgusu: [hw] yarı genişlik, dalga [yLevel] çevresinde, dolgu [bottom]'a kadar iner. */
    private fun fillWaveRange(p: GPath, hw: Float, yLevel: Float, bottom: Float, amp: Float, phase: Float, cycles: Float) {
        p.reset()
        val n = 28
        for (i in 0..n) {
            val u = i / n.toFloat()
            val x = -hw + 2f * hw * u
            val y = yLevel + amp * orbFlow.gain * orbGain * orbFlow.offset(u, cycles, phase)
            if (i == 0) p.moveTo(x, y) else p.lineTo(x, y)
        }
        p.lineTo(hw, bottom).lineTo(-hw, bottom).close()
    }

    /** Üçgen, kare, altıgen ve yıldız küre: aynı cam ve sıvı, şeklin çizgisine kırpılmış. */
    private fun orbShaped(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, level: Float, phase: Float, glow: Float, error: Float, press: Float) {
        val shape = orbShape
        val ok = key(r, r, 0f)
        var st = orbs[ok]
        if (st == null) { st = OrbStyle(r, this); orbs[ok] = st }
        val sk = key(r, r, 10f + shape.ordinal)
        var sp = shapeCache[sk]
        if (sp == null) { sp = ShapePaths(shape, r); shapeCache[sk] = sp }
        val lv = level.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val lf = liquidFillsFor(r)
        val top = r * shape.topF
        val bottom = r * shape.bottomF
        g.save()
        g.translate(cx, cy)

        // zemin gölgesi
        g.save(); g.translate(0f, bottom + r * 0.07f); g.scale(r * 0.80f, r * 0.15f)
        g.paint(st.ground); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()

        if (glow > 0.01f) { g.save(); g.alpha(glow.coerceIn(0f, 1f)); g.paint(st.glow); g.circle(0f, 0f, r * 1.75f); g.restore() }

        // cam gövde
        g.paint(st.glass); g.path(sp.outline)
        g.paint(st.bounce); g.path(sp.outline)

        // sıvı: seviye, şeklin gerçek üst-alt aralığına göre ölçülür
        if (lv > 0.012f) {
            val yLevel = bottom - (bottom - top) * lv
            val edge = min(1f, min(lv * 5f, (1f - lv) * 5f))
            val amp = 3.6f * edge
            g.save()
            g.clipPath(sp.inner)
            fillWaveRange(st.wave2, r * 1.4f, yLevel - 1.5f, bottom + 4f, amp * 0.8f, phase * 0.8f + 2.1f, 1.2f)
            fillWaveRange(st.wave, r * 1.4f, yLevel, bottom + 4f, amp, phase, 1.5f)
            g.paint(lf?.back ?: st.liquidBack); g.path(st.wave2)
            if (error < 0.999f) { g.save(); g.alpha(1f - error); g.paint(lf?.liquid ?: st.liquid); g.path(st.wave); g.restore() }
            if (error > 0.001f) { g.save(); g.alpha(error); g.paint(st.liquidErr); g.path(st.wave); g.restore() }
            if (lf == null && liquidTintAmt > 0.01f && error < 0.5f) { g.save(); g.alpha(liquidTintAmt); g.paint(liquidTint); g.path(st.wave); g.restore() }
            g.strokeWidth(1.6f)
            g.paint(white(0.55f)); g.strokePath(st.wave)
            if (lv > 0.2f && r >= 30f) {
                val bot = bottom * 0.86f
                val topB = yLevel + 6f
                if (topB < bot) {
                    for (i in bx.indices) {
                        val f = (((phase / (2f * PI.toFloat())) * bs[i] + bo[i]) % 1f + 1f) % 1f
                        val y = bot - f * (bot - topB)
                        val x = bx[i] * r * 0.9f + 2f * sin(phase * 1.3f + i)
                        val fade = min(1f, min(f * 6f, (1f - f) * 6f))
                        g.paint(white(0.42f * fade)); g.circle(x, y, br[i])
                        g.paint(white(0.85f * fade)); g.circle(x - br[i] * 0.3f, y - br[i] * 0.3f, br[i] * 0.34f)
                    }
                }
            }
            g.restore()
        }

        // cam kenar halkaları
        g.strokeWidth(2.4f)
        g.paint(st.rim); g.strokePath(sp.inner)
        g.strokeWidth(1f)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.14f else 0.30f)); g.strokePath(sp.ring)
        // üst parlama (şeklin dışına taşmasın diye kırpılır)
        g.save(); g.clipPath(sp.outline)
        g.translate(-r * 0.20f * shape.shineX, r * shape.topF * 0.58f)
        g.rotate(-16f); g.scale(r * 0.56f * shape.shineScale, r * 0.30f * shape.shineScale)
        g.paint(st.shine); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()

        if (press > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(press); g.paint(white(0.22f)); g.path(sp.outline); g.restore() }
        g.restore()

        // güç simgesi
        val mix = Easing.clamp01((lv - 0.38f) / 0.20f)
        val off = if (dark) theme.accentLight else theme.controlDeep
        val isz = r * 0.62f * shape.iconScale
        val iy = cy + r * 0.04f + r * shape.iconDy
        Icons.draw(g, Icon.POWER, cx, iy + 1.6f, isz, Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, 0.30f * mix), 2.5f)
        Icons.draw(g, Icon.POWER, cx, iy, isz, Rgb.lerp(off, Rgb.WHITE, mix), 2.5f)
    }

    /**
     * Ana düğme: cam küre ve içinde yükselen sıvı.
     * [level] sıvı seviyesi (0..1), [phase] dalga evresi (radyan), [glow] dış ışıma (0..1),
     * [error] hata rengine karışım (0..1), [press] basılı parlama (0..1).
     */
    open fun orb(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, level: Float, phase: Float, glow: Float, error: Float, press: Float) {
        if (orbShape != OrbShape.CIRCLE) { orbShaped(g, cx, cy, r, level, phase, glow, error, press); return }
        val k = key(r, r, 0f)
        var st = orbs[k]
        if (st == null) {
            st = OrbStyle(r, this); orbs[k] = st
        }
        val lv = level.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val lf = liquidFillsFor(r)
        g.save()
        g.translate(cx, cy)

        // zemin gölgesi
        g.save(); g.translate(0f, r * 1.07f); g.scale(r * 0.92f, r * 0.15f)
        g.paint(st.ground); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()

        if (glow > 0.01f) { g.save(); g.alpha(glow.coerceIn(0f, 1f)); g.paint(st.glow); g.circle(0f, 0f, r * 1.75f); g.restore() }

        // cam gövde
        g.paint(st.glass); g.circle(0f, 0f, r)
        g.paint(st.bounce); g.circle(0f, 0f, r)

        // sıvı (kürenin içine kırpılır)
        if (lv > 0.012f) {
            val yLevel = r - 2f * r * lv
            val edge = min(1f, min(lv * 5f, (1f - lv) * 5f))
            val amp = 3.6f * edge
            g.save()
            g.clipCircle(0f, 0f, r - 1.2f)
            fillWave(st.wave2, r, yLevel - 1.5f, amp * 0.8f, phase * 0.8f + 2.1f, 1.2f)
            fillWave(st.wave, r, yLevel, amp, phase, 1.5f)
            g.paint(lf?.back ?: st.liquidBack); g.path(st.wave2)
            if (error < 0.999f) { g.save(); g.alpha(1f - error); g.paint(lf?.liquid ?: st.liquid); g.path(st.wave); g.restore() }
            if (error > 0.001f) { g.save(); g.alpha(error); g.paint(st.liquidErr); g.path(st.wave); g.restore() }
            if (lf == null && liquidTintAmt > 0.01f && error < 0.5f) { g.save(); g.alpha(liquidTintAmt); g.paint(liquidTint); g.path(st.wave); g.restore() }
            // yüzey çizgisi
            g.strokeWidth(1.6f)
            g.paint(white(0.55f)); g.strokePath(st.wave)
            // sıvı içinde yükselen minik baloncuklar
            if (lv > 0.2f && r >= 30f) {
                val bottom = r * 0.86f
                for (i in bx.indices) {
                    val f = (((phase / (2f * PI.toFloat())) * bs[i] + bo[i]) % 1f + 1f) % 1f
                    val top = yLevel + 6f
                    val y = bottom - f * (bottom - top)
                    val hw = max(0f, sqrt(max(0f, (r - 4f) * (r - 4f) - y * y)) - br[i])
                    val x = (bx[i] * r + 2f * sin(phase * 1.3f + i)).coerceIn(-hw, hw)
                    val fade = min(1f, min(f * 6f, (1f - f) * 6f))
                    g.paint(white(0.42f * fade)); g.circle(x, y, br[i])
                    g.paint(white(0.85f * fade)); g.circle(x - br[i] * 0.3f, y - br[i] * 0.3f, br[i] * 0.34f)
                }
            }
            g.restore()
        }

        // cam kenar halkaları
        g.strokeWidth(2.4f)
        g.paint(st.rim); g.strokeCircle(0f, 0f, r - 1.2f)
        g.strokeWidth(1f)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.14f else 0.30f)); g.strokeCircle(0f, 0f, r - 5f)
        // alt yansıma (yay)
        g.strokeWidth(3.2f)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.22f else 0.45f)); g.strokePath(st.crescent)
        // üst parlama
        g.save(); g.translate(-r * 0.20f, -r * 0.58f); g.rotate(-16f); g.scale(r * 0.56f, r * 0.30f)
        g.paint(st.shine); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()

        if (press > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(press); g.paint(white(0.22f)); g.circle(0f, 0f, r); g.restore() }
        g.restore()

        // güç simgesi
        val mix = Easing.clamp01((lv - 0.38f) / 0.20f)
        val off = if (dark) theme.accentLight else theme.controlDeep
        val isz = r * 0.62f
        Icons.draw(g, Icon.POWER, cx, cy + r * 0.04f + 1.6f, isz, Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, 0.30f * mix), 2.5f)
        Icons.draw(g, Icon.POWER, cx, cy + r * 0.04f, isz, Rgb.lerp(off, Rgb.WHITE, mix), 2.5f)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ anahtar, kaydırıcı, segment

    protected val knobFill = Fill.radial(-0.3f, -0.4f, 1.4f, white(1f), Rgb.lerp(Rgb.WHITE, theme.accentLight, 0.30f), Rgb.lerp(Rgb.WHITE, theme.accent, 0.42f), 0.55f)
    private val trackOn = LongCache<Fill>(12)

    protected fun onFill(h: Float): Fill {
        val k = key(1f, h, 1f)
        var f = trackOn[k]
        if (f == null) { f = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, theme.control, theme.controlDeep); trackOn[k] = f }
        return f
    }

    private val trackIn = LongCache<Fill>(12)

    protected fun insetFill(h: Float): Fill {
        val k = key(1f, h, 2f)
        var f = trackIn[k]
        if (f == null) {
            f = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, if (dark) 0.55f else 0.34f), Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, if (dark) 0.18f else 0.12f))
            trackIn[k] = f
        }
        return f
    }

    /** Parlak küre düğme (anahtarın ve kaydırıcının tutamacı). */
    protected fun knob(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, press: Float) {
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, if (dark) 0.35f else 0.22f)); g.circle(cx, cy + 1.6f, r + 0.6f)
        g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.scale(r, r)
        g.paint(knobFill); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f)
        g.restore()
        g.strokeWidth(1f)
        g.paint(white(0.95f)); g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, r - 0.5f)
        g.paint(white(0.75f)); g.oval(cx - r * 0.55f, cy - r * 0.78f, cx + r * 0.55f, cy - r * 0.18f)
        if (press > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(press); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, 0.25f)); g.circle(cx, cy, r); g.restore() }
    }

    /** Açma/kapama anahtarı. [on] 0..1 (animasyonlu). Boyut (l,t) ile (w,h). */
    open fun switch(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, w: Float, h: Float, on: Float, press: Float) {
        g.save()
        g.translate(l, t)
        g.paint(insetFill(h)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        if (on > 0.001f) {
            g.save(); g.alpha(on)
            g.paint(onFill(h)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
            g.paint(white(0.28f)); g.roundRect(1.5f, 1.2f, w - 1.5f, h * 0.5f, h / 2f - 1.2f)
            g.restore()
        }
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.40f else 0.85f)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.6f, 0.6f, w - 0.6f, h - 0.6f, h / 2f - 0.6f)
        val kr = h / 2f - 3.2f + press * 0.8f
        knob(g, h / 2f + (w - h) * on.coerceIn(0f, 1f), h / 2f, kr, press)
        g.restore()
    }

    /** Yatay kaydırıcı: (l, cy) sol-orta, genişlik [w], değer [v] 0..1. Tutamaç merkezi l+12 ile l+w-12 arasında gezer. */
    open fun slider(g: Gfx, l: Float, cy: Float, w: Float, v: Float, press: Float) {
        val th = 8f
        val top = cy - th / 2f
        val kx = l + 12f + (w - 24f) * v.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        g.save()
        g.translate(l, top)
        g.paint(insetFill(th)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, th, th / 2f)
        val fw = (kx - l).coerceAtLeast(th)
        g.paint(onFill(th)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, fw, th, th / 2f)
        g.paint(white(0.30f)); g.roundRect(1f, 0.8f, max(1.5f, fw - 1f), th * 0.5f, th / 2f - 0.8f)
        g.strokeWidth(1f)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.35f else 0.80f)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.5f, 0.5f, w - 0.5f, th - 0.5f, th / 2f - 0.5f)
        g.restore()
        knob(g, kx, cy, 12f + press * 1.5f, press)
    }

    /** Segmentli seçici: [pos] seçili parçanın (kesirli, animasyonlu) sırası, [n] parça sayısı. */
    open fun segmented(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, n: Int, pos: Float) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        g.save()
        g.translate(l, t)
        g.paint(insetFill(h)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.35f else 0.80f)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.6f, 0.6f, w - 0.6f, h - 0.6f, h / 2f - 0.6f)
        val inset = 3f
        val sw = (w - inset * 2f) / n
        val x = inset + sw * pos.coerceIn(0f, (n - 1).toFloat())
        g.restore()
        pill(g, l + x, t + inset, l + x + sw, b - inset, 0f, 0.6f)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ küçük parçalar

    /** Gecikme çubukları: [level] 0..4. */
    /**
     * Hız çubukları. [colored] açıksa dolu çubuklar hıza göre renklenir (4-3: yeşil, 2: sarı, 1: kırmızı); renkler açık ve
     * koyu temada cam üzerinde ayrı ayrı okunaklı seçilmiştir. Renk tek başına anlam taşımaz: çubuk sayısı aynı bilgiyi verir.
     */
    open fun bars(g: Gfx, x: Float, bottom: Float, level: Int, active: Boolean, colored: Boolean = false) {
        val on = when {
            colored && level >= 3 -> if (dark) 0xFF5BD47A.toInt() else 0xFF1E7F3A.toInt()
            colored && level == 2 -> if (dark) 0xFFF2B544.toInt() else 0xFF9A5B00.toInt()
            colored && level == 1 -> if (dark) 0xFFFF8A7A.toInt() else 0xFFB3261E.toInt()
            active -> theme.link
            else -> Rgb.alpha(theme.textSoft, 0.85f)
        }
        val off = Rgb.alpha(theme.textSoft, 0.22f)
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
            val bh = 5f + i * 3f
            g.paint(if (i < level) on else off)
            g.roundRect(x + i * 5.2f, bottom - bh, x + i * 5.2f + 3.4f, bottom, 1.4f)
        }
    }

    /** Tema örneği: gökyüzü gradyanlı küçük küre. [t] null ise "otomatik" (yarı açık, yarı koyu). */
    open fun swatch(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, t: AeroTheme?, selected: Float) {
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, if (dark) 0.40f else 0.20f)); g.circle(cx, cy + 1.8f, r + 0.8f)
        g.save()
        g.translate(cx, cy)
        val sz = (r * 2f).toInt()
        if (t != null) {
            g.paint(swatchFill(t.id.hashCode() * 31 + t.skyMid, sz, t)); g.circle(0f, 0f, r)   // renk de anahtarda: dinamik tema değişebilir
        } else {
            val a = Themes.aqua
            val n = Themes.night
            val half1 = swatchHalf1
            val half2 = swatchHalf2
            if (half1.isEmpty || swatchHalfR != r) {      // yarıçap değişince (dar ekran, yön değişimi) yeniden kurulur
                half1.reset().arc(0f, 0f, r, r, 135f, 180f, false).close()
                half2.reset().arc(0f, 0f, r, r, 315f, 180f, false).close()
                swatchHalfR = r
            }
            g.paint(swatchFill(1, sz, a)); g.path(half1)
            g.paint(swatchFill(2, sz, n)); g.path(half2)
        }
        val ac = t ?: Themes.aqua
        g.paint(swatchOrb(ac)); g.save(); g.translate(0f, r * 0.12f); g.scale(r * 0.46f, r * 0.46f); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()
        g.paint(white(0.55f)); g.oval(-r * 0.62f, -r * 0.86f, r * 0.18f, -r * 0.34f)
        g.strokeWidth(1.4f)
        g.paint(white(0.95f)); g.strokeCircle(0f, 0f, r - 0.7f)
        g.restore()
        if (selected > 0.001f) {
            g.save(); g.alpha(selected)
            g.strokeWidth(2.4f)
            g.paint(theme.link); g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, r + 4.2f)
            g.restore()
        }
    }

    // Tema sayısı büyüdükçe (12 → 24) önbellek yetmez ve her karede yeniden ayrılır; her tema ve boyut için yer var.
    private val swatchFills = LongCache<Fill>(96)

    private fun swatchFill(idHash: Int, sz: Int, th: AeroTheme): Fill {
        val k = (idHash.toLong() shl 32) or (sz.toLong() and 0xFFFFFFFFL)
        var f = swatchFills[k]
        if (f == null) {
            val r = sz / 2f
            f = Fill.linear(-r * 0.7f, -r, r * 0.7f, r, th.skyTop, th.skyMid, th.skyBottom, 0.5f)
            swatchFills[k] = f
        }
        return f
    }
    private val swatchHalf1 = GPath()
    private val swatchHalf2 = GPath()
    private var swatchHalfR = 0f
    private val swatchOrbs = HashMap<String, Fill>()
    private val swatchOrbSig = HashMap<String, Long>()

    /** Önbellek id ile aranır (kare başına ayırma yok); dinamik temanın renkleri değişirse imza farklı çıkar ve yeniden kurulur. */
    private fun swatchOrb(t: AeroTheme): Fill {
        val sig = (t.accentLight.toLong() * 31 + t.accent) * 31 + t.accentDeep
        val f = swatchOrbs[t.id]
        if (f != null && swatchOrbSig[t.id] == sig) return f
        val n = Fill.linear(0f, -1f, 0f, 1f, t.accentLight, t.accent, t.accentDeep, 0.5f)
        swatchOrbs[t.id] = n; swatchOrbSig[t.id] = sig
        return n
    }

    /** Vurgu renkli simgeler ve çizgiler için okunaklı renk (koyu temada açık, açık temada koyu). */
    val ink: Int get() = theme.link

    /** Satır başı simge diski: cam gibi parlak, vurgu renkli yuvarlak. */
    open fun iconDisc(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float) {
        g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.scale(r, r)
        g.paint(discFill); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f)
        g.restore()
        g.strokeWidth(1f)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.35f else 0.85f)); g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, r - 0.5f)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.14f else 0.45f)); g.oval(cx - r * 0.62f, cy - r * 0.92f, cx + r * 0.62f, cy - r * 0.18f)
    }

    private val discFill = Fill.linear(0f, -1f, 0f, 1f, Rgb.alpha(theme.accentLight, if (dark) 0.34f else 0.62f), Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, if (dark) 0.24f else 0.34f))

    /** Küçük onay rozeti (bağlı sunucu işareti). */
    open fun badge(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float) {
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, 0.25f)); g.circle(cx, cy + 1f, r + 0.6f)
        g.paint(theme.control); g.circle(cx, cy, r)
        g.strokeWidth(1f); g.paint(white(0.9f)); g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, r - 0.5f)
        Icons.draw(g, Icon.CHECK, cx, cy, r * 1.35f, Rgb.WHITE, 2.6f)
    }

    private var barFill: Fill? = null
    private var barShadow: Fill? = null
    private var barH = 0f
    private var barSky = 0f

    /**
     * Üst çubuk zemini: gökyüzü renginde, neredeyse opak bir cam şerit. İçerik başlığın altından geçerken
     * yazılar birbirine karışmasın diye. [a] 0..1 (kaydırdıkça belirir), [skyH] gökyüzünün (ekranın) yüksekliği.
     */
    open fun bar(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, a: Float, skyH: Float) {
        if (a <= 0.01f) return
        var f = barFill
        if (f == null || barH != h || barSky != skyH) {
            val t0 = Rgb.over(tint(if (dark) 0.10f else 0.34f), theme.skyAt(0f))
            val t1 = Rgb.over(tint(if (dark) 0.06f else 0.20f), theme.skyAt((h / skyH).coerceIn(0f, 1f)))
            f = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.alpha(t0, 1f), Rgb.alpha(t1, 1f))
            barFill = f
            barShadow = Fill.linear(0f, h, 0f, h + 10f, Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, if (dark) 0.30f else 0.13f), Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, 0f))
            barH = h; barSky = skyH
        }
        g.save(); g.alpha(a)
        g.paint(barShadow!!); g.rect(0f, h, w, h + 10f)
        g.paint(f); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.22f else 0.70f)); g.rect(0f, h - 1f, w, h)
        g.restore()
    }

    /** Alt sayfanın üstündeki küçük tutamaç. */
    open fun grabber(g: Gfx, cx: Float, y: Float) {
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.40f else 0.85f)); g.roundRect(cx - 18f, y, cx + 18f, y + 4.5f, 2.25f)
    }

    companion object {
        private val DECO = arrayOf(
            // küre
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.62f, -0.80f), floatArrayOf(-0.62f, -0.70f), floatArrayOf(0.70f, -0.42f)),
            // üçgen
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.04f, -0.78f), floatArrayOf(-0.20f, -0.30f), floatArrayOf(0.40f, 0.05f)),
            // kare
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.50f, -0.88f), floatArrayOf(-0.70f, -0.72f), floatArrayOf(0.74f, -0.40f)),
            // altıgen
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.40f, -0.77f), floatArrayOf(-0.55f, -0.68f), floatArrayOf(0.74f, -0.40f)),
            // yıldız
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.03f, -0.90f), floatArrayOf(-0.62f, -0.35f), floatArrayOf(0.70f, -0.30f)),
            // sekizgen
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.40f, -0.92f), floatArrayOf(-0.62f, -0.62f), floatArrayOf(0.74f, -0.40f)),
            // beşgen
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.06f, -0.80f), floatArrayOf(-0.56f, -0.42f), floatArrayOf(0.70f, -0.30f)),
            // dikdörtgen
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.50f, -0.60f), floatArrayOf(-0.72f, -0.46f), floatArrayOf(0.76f, -0.40f)),
            // ters üçgen
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.45f, -0.84f), floatArrayOf(-0.60f, -0.62f), floatArrayOf(0.45f, -0.35f)),
            // elmas
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.04f, -0.86f), floatArrayOf(-0.36f, -0.36f), floatArrayOf(0.45f, 0.12f)),
            // çiçek
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.05f, -0.90f), floatArrayOf(-0.62f, -0.45f), floatArrayOf(0.78f, -0.30f)),
            // altı köşeli yıldız
            arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.03f, -0.88f), floatArrayOf(-0.60f, -0.33f), floatArrayOf(0.62f, -0.34f)),
        )
        /** Hata durumunda sıvı renkleri (tema bağımsız, kırmızımsı). */
        const val ERR_LIGHT: Int = 0xFF8F72 or (0xFF shl 24)
        const val ERR_MID: Int = 0xE5533D or (0xFF shl 24)
        const val ERR_DEEP: Int = 0xB3342A or (0xFF shl 24)
    }
}

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/AppScope.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

/** DNS hangi uygulamalara uygulanır: hepsine, yalnızca seçilenlere ya da seçilenler dışındakilere. */
enum class AppScope(val id: String) { ALL("all"), ONLY("only"), EXCEPT("except") }

/** Telefondaki bir uygulama (başlatıcıda görünen): paket adı ve görünen ad. */
class AppEntry(val pkg: String, val label: String)

/** [AppScope] ayarının tünele çevrilmiş hali. */
class ScopePlan(val kind: Kind, val packages: List<String>) {
    /** NONE: "yalnızca seçilenler" ama seçili yüklü uygulama yok. Android boş izin listesini "hepsi" sayar; bu yüzden tünel hiç kurulmaz. */
    enum class Kind { ALL, ALLOW, DENY, NONE }
}

object AppScopes {
    const val MAX_APPS = 1000
    private val PKG = Regex("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+)+$")

    fun validPkg(s: String): Boolean = s.length <= 255 && PKG.matches(s)

    /** "a.b,c.d" -> geçerli paket adları (en çok [MAX_APPS], tekrarsız). */
    fun decode(s: String?): Set<String> {
        if (s.isNullOrBlank() || s.length > 100_000) return emptySet()
        val out = LinkedHashSet<String>()
        for (p in s.split(',')) {
            if (out.size >= MAX_APPS) break
            if (validPkg(p)) out.add(p)
        }
        return out
    }

    fun encode(apps: Set<String>): String = apps.filter { validPkg(it) }.sorted().take(MAX_APPS).joinToString(",")

    /**
     * Tünelin hangi uygulamaları kapsayacağı. [own] uygulamanın kendisidir: bağlantı doğrulaması ve ölçümler kendi
     * trafiğimizden gider, bu yüzden "yalnızca seçilenler"de her zaman kapsama alınır, "hariç"te asla dışarıda bırakılmaz.
     * "Yalnızca seçilenler"de seçili yüklü uygulama yoksa [ScopePlan.Kind.NONE] döner (Android boş izin listesini "hepsi" sayar,
     * bu yüzden koruma hiç başlatılmaz; sessizce tüm trafiğe geçilmez). "Hariç"te boş liste, dışlanan yok demektir: hepsi.
     */
    fun plan(s: AppSettings, own: String, installed: (String) -> Boolean): ScopePlan {
        if (s.appScope == AppScope.ALL) return ScopePlan(ScopePlan.Kind.ALL, emptyList())
        val pk = s.apps.filter { it != own && installed(it) }
        if (pk.isEmpty()) return if (s.appScope == AppScope.ONLY) ScopePlan(ScopePlan.Kind.NONE, emptyList()) else ScopePlan(ScopePlan.Kind.ALL, emptyList())
        return if (s.appScope == AppScope.ONLY) ScopePlan(ScopePlan.Kind.ALLOW, pk + own) else ScopePlan(ScopePlan.Kind.DENY, pk)
    }
}

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/ArtAero.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.sin

/**
 * Gerçek Frutiger Aero: gökyüzü (seçili renk temasından), bulutlar, güneş ışınları, yeşil çimen tepeler ve rüzgârda
 * sallanan çim; üzerinde cam kartlar, cam damlaları ve jel düğmeler. Çim her temada yeşildir (anlamı çimen).
 * Koyu temada gece çimeni ve yıldızlar. Çim sallanması yalnızca hareket açıkken kare kare hesaplanır.
 */
class AeroSkyArt(theme: AeroTheme, glass: Float) : AeroArt(theme, glass) {
    override val style: UiStyle get() = UiStyle.AERO
    override val liveSky: Boolean get() = true
    override val motion: StyleMotion = StyleMotion(PageMotion.SLIDE, 0.42f, 0.03f, 0.5f, depth = 1.1f, up = SpringSpec.BOUNCY, toggle = SpringSpec.BOUNCY, fx = FxKind.DROP)

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ manzara

    private class Scenery(val w: Float, val h: Float, val dark: Boolean) {
        private fun c(v: Long) = v.toInt()

        val farFill: Fill
        val midFill: Fill
        val nearFill: Fill
        val far = GPath()
        val mid = GPath()
        val near = GPath()
        val haze: Fill
        val bloom = Fill.radial(w * 0.18f, h * 0.02f, w * 1.15f,
            Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0.06f else 0.70f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0.02f else 0.24f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f), 0.40f)
        val ray = Fill.linear(w * 0.18f, h * 0.02f, w * 0.75f, h * 0.60f,
            Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0f else 0.26f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f))
        val rays = Array(3) { GPath() }

        // çim
        val count = 130
        val bx = FloatArray(count); val by = FloatArray(count); val bh = FloatArray(count); val bw = FloatArray(count)
        val lean = FloatArray(count); val ph = FloatArray(count); val shade = IntArray(count)
        val bladeFill = Array(3) { i -> Fill.linear(0f, h * 0.74f, 0f, h + 10f, bladeTip(i), bladeBase(i)) }
        val bladePath = Array(3) { GPath() }

        private fun bladeTip(i: Int): Int = if (dark) arrayOf(c(0xFF4DBB6A), c(0xFF35945A), c(0xFF247045))[i]
            else arrayOf(c(0xFFB5EE6A), c(0xFF78D44E), c(0xFF4DB345))[i]
        private fun bladeBase(i: Int): Int = if (dark) arrayOf(c(0xFF1E6B3E), c(0xFF165433), c(0xFF0F3D26))[i]
            else arrayOf(c(0xFF3AA33A), c(0xFF2C8F33), c(0xFF1F7A2B))[i]

        // bulutlar: (merkez x, merkez y, ölçek)
        val clouds = arrayOf(floatArrayOf(0.30f, 0.15f, 1.0f), floatArrayOf(0.80f, 0.27f, 0.8f), floatArrayOf(0.52f, 0.42f, 0.6f))
        val puff = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0.92f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0.55f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f), 0.55f)
        val starX = FloatArray(14); val starY = FloatArray(14); val starR = FloatArray(14)

        fun hillY(x: Float, base: Float, a1: Float, f1: Float, p1: Float, a2: Float, f2: Float, p2: Float): Float =
            base + a1 * sin(x * f1 + p1) + a2 * sin(x * f2 + p2)

        private fun hill(p: GPath, base: Float, a1: Float, f1: Float, p1: Float, a2: Float, f2: Float, p2: Float) {
            p.reset()
            val n = 36
            for (i in 0..n) {
                val x = -8f + (w + 16f) * i / n
                val y = hillY(x, base, a1, f1, p1, a2, f2, p2)
                if (i == 0) p.moveTo(x, y) else p.lineTo(x, y)
            }
            p.lineTo(w + 8f, h + 8f).lineTo(-8f, h + 8f).close()
        }

        init {
            val k = 2f * PI.toFloat() / w
            hill(far, h * 0.665f, h * 0.022f, k * 1.3f, 0.6f, h * 0.012f, k * 3.1f, 1.7f)
            hill(mid, h * 0.735f, h * 0.026f, k * 1.0f, 2.2f, h * 0.012f, k * 2.6f, 0.4f)
            hill(near, h * 0.815f, h * 0.024f, k * 1.2f, 4.1f, h * 0.010f, k * 3.3f, 2.9f)
            farFill = if (dark) Fill.linear(0f, h * 0.62f, 0f, h * 0.76f, c(0xFF1C4E4A), c(0xFF133B3B))
                else Fill.linear(0f, h * 0.62f, 0f, h * 0.76f, c(0xFF9ADCA6), c(0xFF6FC58A))
            midFill = if (dark) Fill.linear(0f, h * 0.70f, 0f, h * 0.85f, c(0xFF1A5C3B), c(0xFF10432C))
                else Fill.linear(0f, h * 0.70f, 0f, h * 0.85f, c(0xFF6FD064), c(0xFF3FA13F))
            nearFill = if (dark) Fill.linear(0f, h * 0.78f, 0f, h, c(0xFF165232), c(0xFF0A2C1B))
                else Fill.linear(0f, h * 0.78f, 0f, h, c(0xFF4CB542), c(0xFF1D7A2A))
            haze = Fill.linear(0f, h * 0.48f, 0f, h * 0.70f, Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0.05f else 0.42f))

            // güneş ışınları
            val sx = w * 0.18f; val sy = h * 0.02f
            val spread = floatArrayOf(0.30f, 0.56f, 0.82f)
            for (i in 0 until 3) {
                val a0 = spread[i] * w * 1.4f
                rays[i].moveTo(sx, sy).lineTo(a0, h * 0.78f).lineTo(a0 + w * 0.16f, h * 0.78f).close()
            }

            val rnd = java.util.Random(7L)
            val crestMin = h * 0.78f
            for (i in 0 until count) {
                bx[i] = rnd.nextFloat() * (w + 20f) - 10f
                val t = rnd.nextFloat()
                by[i] = crestMin + (h - crestMin + 6f) * t * t * 0.9f + rnd.nextFloat() * 6f
                val depth = ((by[i] - crestMin) / (h - crestMin)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                bh[i] = (16f + 34f * depth) * (0.75f + 0.6f * rnd.nextFloat())
                bw[i] = 2.6f + 3.4f * depth
                lean[i] = (rnd.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 8f
                ph[i] = rnd.nextFloat() * 6.28f
                shade[i] = rnd.nextInt(3)
            }
            // yakındakiler sonra çizilsin (üstte)
            val order = (0 until count).sortedBy { by[it] }
            fun reorder(a: FloatArray) { val b = a.copyOf(); for (i in 0 until count) a[i] = b[order[i]] }
            reorder(bx); reorder(by); reorder(bh); reorder(bw); reorder(lean); reorder(ph)
            val sh = shade.copyOf(); for (i in 0 until count) shade[i] = sh[order[i]]

            for (i in starX.indices) { starX[i] = rnd.nextFloat() * w; starY[i] = rnd.nextFloat() * h * 0.55f; starR[i] = 0.6f + rnd.nextFloat() * 1.4f }
        }

        fun buildBlades(live: Boolean, time: Float) {
            for (p in bladePath) p.reset()
            for (i in 0 until count) {
                val sway = if (live) (sin(time * 1.5f + ph[i] + bx[i] * 0.011f) * 0.6f + sin(time * 0.6f + bx[i] * 0.004f) * 0.4f) else 0f
                val tipX = bx[i] + lean[i] + sway * bh[i] * 0.30f
                val tipY = by[i] - bh[i]
                val p = bladePath[shade[i]]
                val half = bw[i] / 2f
                p.moveTo(bx[i] - half, by[i] + 2f)
                p.quadTo(bx[i] - half * 0.3f + (tipX - bx[i]) * 0.35f, by[i] - bh[i] * 0.55f, tipX, tipY)
                p.quadTo(bx[i] + half * 0.3f + (tipX - bx[i]) * 0.35f, by[i] - bh[i] * 0.55f, bx[i] + half, by[i] + 2f)
                p.close()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun scene(w: Float, h: Float): Scenery {
        var s = if (dark) sceneDark else sceneLight
        if (s == null || s.w != w || s.h != h) { s = Scenery(w, h, dark); if (dark) sceneDark = s else sceneLight = s }
        return s
    }

    private var skyBase: Fill? = null
    private var skyBaseW = 0f
    private var skyBaseH = 0f

    override fun sky(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float) = skyFrame(g, w, h, false, 0f)

    override fun skyFrame(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, live: Boolean, time: Float) {
        val s = scene(w, h)
        var base = skyBase
        if (base == null || skyBaseW != w || skyBaseH != h) {
            base = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h * 0.72f, theme.skyTop, theme.skyMid, theme.skyBottom, AeroTheme.SKY_MID_POS)
            skyBase = base; skyBaseW = w; skyBaseH = h
        }
        g.paint(base); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(s.bloom); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        if (!dark) {
            for (r in s.rays) { g.paint(s.ray); g.path(r) }
            // bulutlar (yavaşça sürüklenir)
            val drift = if (live) (time * 2.2f) % (w + 240f) else 0f
            for (cl in s.clouds) {
                val sc = cl[2] * w * 0.075f
                var cx = cl[0] * w + drift * cl[2]
                if (cx > w + sc * 3f) cx -= w + sc * 6f
                val cy = cl[1] * h
                g.paint(s.puff)
                for (k in PUFFS) {
                    g.save(); g.translate(cx + k[0] * sc, cy + k[1] * sc); g.scale(k[2] * sc, k[2] * sc * 0.66f)
                    g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()
                }
            }
        } else {
            g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0.75f))
            for (i in s.starX.indices) {
                val tw = if (live) 0.55f + 0.45f * sin(time * 1.1f + i * 1.7f) else 1f
                g.save(); g.alpha(tw); g.circle(s.starX[i], s.starY[i], s.starR[i]); g.restore()
            }
        }
        g.paint(s.haze); g.rect(0f, h * 0.48f, w, h * 0.70f)
        g.paint(s.farFill); g.path(s.far)
        g.paint(s.midFill); g.path(s.mid)
        g.paint(s.nearFill); g.path(s.near)
        s.buildBlades(live, time)
        for (i in 0 until 3) { g.paint(s.bladeFill[i]); g.path(s.bladePath[i]) }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ cam damlaları

    private val dropBody = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, white(0.04f), white(0.10f), white(if (dark) 0.34f else 0.62f), 0.72f)
    private val dropShade = Fill.radial(0.35f, 0.5f, 1f, Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, if (dark) 0.30f else 0.16f), Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, 0f))

    private fun droplet(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float) {
        g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.scale(r, r)
        g.paint(dropShade); g.circle(0.12f, 0.22f, 1.25f)
        g.paint(dropBody); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f)
        g.restore()
        g.strokeWidth(0.8f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.35f else 0.8f)); g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, r - 0.4f)
        g.paint(white(0.95f)); g.circle(cx - r * 0.38f, cy - r * 0.40f, max(0.8f, r * 0.24f))
    }

    override fun card(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, rad: Float, selected: Float, press: Float, strong: Float, shadow: Float) {
        super.card(g, l, t, r, b, rad, selected, press, strong, shadow)
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w < 80f || h < 40f || strong > 0.5f) return
        val n = min(5, 1 + (h / 110f).toInt())
        var s = (w * 7f).toInt() * 31 + (h * 7f).toInt()
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            s = s * 1103515245 + 12345
            val fx = ((s ushr 8) and 0xFFFF) / 65535f
            s = s * 1103515245 + 12345
            val fy = ((s ushr 8) and 0xFFFF) / 65535f
            val rr = 2.6f + (i % 3) * 1.1f
            // sağ kenara yakın: yazılar solda
            droplet(g, l + w * (0.62f + 0.34f * fx), t + 9f + (h - 18f) * fy, rr)
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ jel düğme

    private class GelStyle(val w: Float, val h: Float, art: AeroSkyArt) {
        val body = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, art.theme.control, art.theme.controlDeep)
        val upper = GPath()
        val upperFill = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h * 0.5f, art.white(0.55f), art.white(0.16f))
        val glow = Fill.radial(w * 0.5f, h * 1.05f, w * 0.55f, Rgb.alpha(art.theme.accentLight, 0.75f), Rgb.alpha(art.theme.accentLight, 0f))
        val rim = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, art.white(0.85f), Rgb.alpha(art.theme.accentLight, 0.60f))

        init {
            val k = min(w, h) / 2f
            upper.arc(k, k, k, k, 180f, 90f, false)
            upper.lineTo(w - k, 0f)
            upper.arc(w - k, k, k, k, -90f, 90f, true)
            upper.lineTo(w, h * 0.5f)
            upper.lineTo(0f, h * 0.5f)
            upper.close()
        }
    }

    private val gels = LongCache<GelStyle>(40)

    private fun gel(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, press: Float, shadow: Float) {
        val k = key(w, h, 7f)
        var st = gels[k]
        if (st == null) { st = GelStyle(w, h, this); gels[k] = st }
        if (shadow > 0f) {
            g.strokeWidth(2.2f)
            for (i in 0 until 4) {
                val f = 1f - i / 4f
                g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.controlDeep, (if (dark) 0.24f else 0.12f) * shadow * f * f))
                val e = 1.1f + i * 1.9f
                g.strokeRoundRect(-e, -e + 2f, w + e, h + e + 2f, h / 2f + e)
            }
        }
        g.paint(st.body); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        g.save(); g.clipRoundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f); g.paint(st.glow); g.rect(0f, h * 0.45f, w, h); g.restore()
        g.paint(st.upperFill); g.path(st.upper)
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f)
        g.paint(st.rim); g.strokeRoundRect(0.6f, 0.6f, w - 0.6f, h - 0.6f, h / 2f - 0.6f)
        if (press > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(press); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, 0.22f)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f); g.restore() }
    }

    override fun pill(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, press: Float, shadow: Float) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t); gel(g, w, h, press, shadow); g.restore()
    }

    override fun switch(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, w: Float, h: Float, on: Float, press: Float) {
        g.save()
        g.translate(l, t)
        g.paint(insetFill(h)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        if (on > 0.001f) { g.save(); g.alpha(on); gel(g, w, h, 0f, 0f); g.restore() }
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.40f else 0.85f)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.6f, 0.6f, w - 0.6f, h - 0.6f, h / 2f - 0.6f)
        knob(g, h / 2f + (w - h) * on.coerceIn(0f, 1f), h / 2f, h / 2f - 3.2f + press * 0.8f, press)
        g.restore()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ küre: çim yansıması

    /**
     * Çim yansıması: dolgu, aşağıdaki elipsin kendi birim uzayında tanımlıdır (elips ölçeklenmiş çizildiği için), böylece
     * her şekilde ve boyutta aynıdır: elipsin üst kenarında saydam, şeklin alt ucunda çimen yeşili.
     */
    private val grassFill = Fill.linear(0f, -1f, 0f, -0.05f,
        Rgb.alpha(0xFF6FD064.toInt(), 0f), Rgb.alpha(0xFF2E9A3A.toInt(), if (dark) 0.35f else 0.50f))

    override fun orb(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, level: Float, phase: Float, glow: Float, error: Float, press: Float) {
        super.orb(g, cx, cy, r, level, phase, glow, error, press)
        if (r < 24f) return
        val bottom = r * orbShape.bottomF
        g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); clipOrb(g, r, 1.6f)
        g.save(); g.translate(0f, bottom + r * 0.02f); g.scale(r * 0.92f, r * 0.42f)
        g.paint(grassFill); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f)
        g.restore()
        g.restore()
    }

    private companion object {
        // Manzara temadan bağımsızdır: tema geçişinde çizici her karede yenilense de yeniden kurulmaz.
        private var sceneLight: Scenery? = null
        private var sceneDark: Scenery? = null

        val PUFFS = arrayOf(
            floatArrayOf(-1.5f, 0.25f, 0.9f), floatArrayOf(-0.6f, -0.25f, 1.2f), floatArrayOf(0.5f, -0.10f, 1.1f),
            floatArrayOf(1.4f, 0.22f, 0.9f), floatArrayOf(0.0f, 0.30f, 1.3f),
        )
    }
}

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/ArtAurora.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.sin

/**
 * Frutiger Aurora: turkuazdan yeşile ve altta sarıya geçen yumuşak, bulanık zemin; altta parlayan beyaz ışık hüzmesi ve
 * akan renkli ışık şeritleri; üzerinde ince çizgilerden örülü, saydam, dalgalı tel kafes perdeler. Kartlar, düğmeler
 * ve küre temel cam çizimdir (Aero camı). Renk teması hafifçe karışır.
 * Hareket: yatay kayma, hafif yaylı; zemin hafifçe nefes alır (yalnızca hareket açıkken).
 */
class AuroraArt(theme: AeroTheme, glass: Float) : AeroArt(theme, glass) {
    override val style: UiStyle get() = UiStyle.AURORA
    override val particleMode: ParticleMode get() = ParticleMode.NONE
    override val liveSky: Boolean get() = true
    override val motion: StyleMotion = StyleMotion(PageMotion.SLIDE, 0.40f, 0.03f, 0.4f, depth = 0.9f, up = SpringSpec.SOFT, toggle = SpringSpec.SOFT, fx = FxKind.SWEEP)

    private val teal = 0xFF0E9FA6.toInt()
    private val green = 0xFF28C08A.toInt()
    private val lemon = 0xFFE4EE62.toInt()
    private val sea = 0xFF1FB4E6.toInt()

    private class Scene(val w: Float, val h: Float, art: AuroraArt) {
        private val dk = art.dark
        private val th = art.theme
        val base = if (dk)
            Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.lerp(0xFF021C26.toInt(), th.skyTop, 0.18f), Rgb.lerp(0xFF05423F.toInt(), th.skyMid, 0.18f),
                Rgb.lerp(0xFF1C4A22.toInt(), th.skyBottom, 0.15f), 0.58f)
        else
            Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.lerp(art.teal, th.skyTop, 0.26f), Rgb.lerp(art.green, th.skyMid, 0.26f),
                Rgb.lerp(art.lemon, th.skyBottom, 0.20f), 0.62f)
        val glowL = Fill.radial(w * 0.12f, h * 0.92f, w * 0.85f, Rgb.alpha(art.lemon, if (dk) 0.40f else 0.85f), Rgb.alpha(art.lemon, 0f))
        val glowR = Fill.radial(w * 0.95f, h * 0.78f, w * 0.80f, Rgb.alpha(art.sea, if (dk) 0.45f else 0.75f), Rgb.alpha(art.sea, 0f))
        val glowT = Fill.radial(w * 0.30f, h * 0.05f, w * 0.9f, Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dk) 0.10f else 0.35f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f))

        // tel kafes: iki kenar eğrisi arasında ara değerlenmiş eğriler
        val meshN = 26
        val meshA = Array(meshN) { GPath() }
        val meshB = Array(meshN) { GPath() }
        val streakMain = GPath()
        val streakGreen = GPath()
        val streakBlue = GPath()

        init {
            fun mesh(out: Array<GPath>, a: FloatArray, b: FloatArray) {
                for (k in 0 until meshN) {
                    val t = k / (meshN - 1f)
                    val p = FloatArray(8) { a[it] + (b[it] - a[it]) * t }
                    out[k].reset().moveTo(p[0] * w, p[1] * h).cubicTo(p[2] * w, p[3] * h, p[4] * w, p[5] * h, p[6] * w, p[7] * h)
                }
            }
            // sol-orta perde: yukarıdan aşağı kıvrılır
            mesh(meshA,
                floatArrayOf(0.40f, -0.05f, 0.55f, 0.30f, 0.80f, 0.35f, 1.05f, 0.30f),
                floatArrayOf(0.30f, -0.05f, 0.45f, 0.55f, 0.65f, 0.75f, 0.95f, 0.52f))
            // alt şerit perde: soldan sağa akar
            mesh(meshB,
                floatArrayOf(-0.05f, 0.62f, 0.25f, 0.50f, 0.55f, 0.82f, 1.05f, 0.62f),
                floatArrayOf(-0.05f, 0.80f, 0.30f, 0.66f, 0.60f, 1.02f, 1.05f, 0.80f))
            streakMain.moveTo(-0.05f * w, 0.84f * h).cubicTo(0.28f * w, 0.74f * h, 0.58f * w, 0.96f * h, 1.05f * w, 0.76f * h)
            streakGreen.moveTo(-0.05f * w, 0.52f * h).cubicTo(0.10f * w, 0.60f * h, 0.20f * w, 0.76f * h, 0.52f * w, 0.84f * h)
            streakBlue.moveTo(0.52f * w, 0.84f * h).cubicTo(0.72f * w, 0.90f * h, 0.90f * w, 0.70f * h, 1.05f * w, 0.50f * h)
        }
    }

    private var scene: Scene? = null

    private fun scene(w: Float, h: Float): Scene {
        var s = scene
        if (s == null || s.w != w || s.h != h) { s = Scene(w, h, this); scene = s }
        return s
    }

    override fun sky(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float) = skyFrame(g, w, h, false, 0f)

    override fun skyFrame(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, live: Boolean, time: Float) {
        val s = scene(w, h)
        val t = if (live) time else 0f
        g.paint(s.base); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(s.glowT); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(s.glowL); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(s.glowR); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        val br = 1f + 0.015f * sin(t * 0.35f)
        // tel kafes perdeler
        g.save(); g.translate(sin(t * 0.20f) * w * 0.02f, 0f)
        g.strokeWidth(1.4f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.22f else 0.46f))
        for (p in s.meshA) g.strokePath(p)
        g.restore()
        g.save(); g.translate(cos(t * 0.17f) * w * 0.02f, 0f)
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.16f else 0.34f))
        for (p in s.meshB) g.strokePath(p)
        g.restore()
        // ışık şeritleri
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(lemon, if (dark) 0.35f else 0.60f)); g.strokeWidth(8f * br); g.strokePath(s.streakGreen)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(sea, if (dark) 0.35f else 0.55f)); g.strokeWidth(8f * br); g.strokePath(s.streakBlue)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.10f else 0.20f)); g.strokeWidth(34f * br); g.strokePath(s.streakMain)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.18f else 0.34f)); g.strokeWidth(16f * br); g.strokePath(s.streakMain)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.55f else 0.85f)); g.strokeWidth(4.5f); g.strokePath(s.streakMain)
        g.paint(white(1f)); g.strokeWidth(1.4f); g.strokePath(s.streakMain)
    }

    override fun bubble(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, alpha: Float) {}
    override fun particle(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, alpha: Float, phase: Float) {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ Aurora: ışıklı düğmeler

    /** Işıklı cam: yumuşak gövde, üstte parlak çizgi, seçiliyken açık renkli ışıma halkası. */
    override fun card(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, rad: Float, selected: Float, press: Float, strong: Float, shadow: Float) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        val rr = min(rad, min(w, h) / 2f)
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        if (selected > 0f) { g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accentLight, 0.30f * selected)); g.roundRect(-3f, -3f, w + 3f, h + 3f, rr + 3f) }
        if (shadow > 0f) { g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accentDeep, (if (dark) 0.30f else 0.12f) * shadow)); g.roundRect(0f, 3f, w, h + 3f, rr) }
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFF10242B.toInt() else Rgb.WHITE, (0.38f + 0.55f * strong).coerceIn(0f, 1f))); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accentLight, 0.16f + 0.22f * press + 0.18f * selected)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr)
        g.strokeWidth(1.4f); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0.35f else 0.85f))
        g.strokeRoundRect(0.7f, 0.7f, w - 0.7f, h - 0.7f, max(0f, rr - 0.7f))
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0.70f)); g.roundRect(rr, 1.2f, w - rr, 2.4f, 1.2f)
        g.restore()
    }

    /** Işıklı anahtar: açıkken ışıyan renkli yuva ve parlak tutamaç. */
    override fun switch(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, w: Float, h: Float, on: Float, press: Float) {
        val k = on.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        if (k > 0.01f) { g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accentLight, 0.35f * k)); g.roundRect(-3f, -3f, w + 3f, h + 3f, h / 2f + 3f) }
        g.paint(Rgb.lerp(if (dark) 0xFF2A3F46.toInt() else 0xFFD3E4E8.toInt(), theme.accent, k)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0.7f)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.6f, 0.6f, w - 0.6f, h - 0.6f, h / 2f - 0.6f)
        val cx = h / 2f + (w - h) * k
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0.45f)); g.circle(cx, h / 2f, h / 2f - 1f + press)
        g.paint(Rgb.WHITE); g.circle(cx, h / 2f, h / 2f - 4f + press)
        g.restore()
    }
}

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/ArtDuru.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.sin

/**
 * Duru: sakin ve sade. Açık nane tonlu bir gökyüzü, altta yavaşça kıpırdayan saydam bir su bandı; kartlar düz, ince kenarlı ve
 * hafif saydamdır (parlak cam efekti yok), anahtarlar sade. Az hareket, az çizim: pil ve okunaklılık için. Tek vurgu rengi:
 * seçili renk temasının vurgusu. Hareket: kısa, yumuşak geçişler; bağlanınca suya düşen damlanın halkası (RING).
 */
class DuruArt(theme: AeroTheme, glass: Float) : AeroArt(theme, glass) {
    override val style: UiStyle get() = UiStyle.DURU
    override val particleMode: ParticleMode get() = ParticleMode.NONE
    override val liveSky: Boolean get() = true
    override val motion: StyleMotion = StyleMotion(PageMotion.DRIFT, 0.34f, 0.025f, 0f, depth = 0.35f, down = SpringSpec.SOFT, up = SpringSpec.SOFT, toggle = SpringSpec.SOFT, fx = FxKind.WISP)

    private val mint = 0xFF63CDBB.toInt()
    private val teal = 0xFF2E8C7E.toInt()

    private class Scene(val w: Float, val h: Float, art: DuruArt) {
        private val dk = art.dark
        private val th = art.theme
        val base = if (dk)
            Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.lerp(0xFF101614.toInt(), th.skyTop, 0.08f), Rgb.lerp(0xFF141C19.toInt(), th.skyMid, 0.08f), Rgb.lerp(0xFF18241F.toInt(), th.skyBottom, 0.08f), 0.55f)
        else
            Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.lerp(0xFFF4FAF7.toInt(), th.skyTop, 0.10f), Rgb.lerp(0xFFDDEFE9.toInt(), th.skyMid, 0.10f), Rgb.lerp(0xFFC3E3DA.toInt(), th.skyBottom, 0.10f), 0.60f)
        val glow = Fill.radial(w * 0.85f, h * 0.06f, w * 0.80f, Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dk) 0.06f else 0.55f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f))
        val waterTop = h * 0.80f
        val water = Fill.linear(0f, waterTop, 0f, h, Rgb.alpha(art.mint, if (dk) 0.10f else 0.30f), Rgb.alpha(art.teal, if (dk) 0.18f else 0.34f), Rgb.alpha(art.teal, if (dk) 0.26f else 0.46f), 0.5f)
    }

    private var scene: Scene? = null

    private fun scene(w: Float, h: Float): Scene {
        var s = scene
        if (s == null || s.w != w || s.h != h) { s = Scene(w, h, this); scene = s }
        return s
    }

    override fun sky(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float) = skyFrame(g, w, h, false, 0f)

    override fun skyFrame(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, live: Boolean, time: Float) {
        val s = scene(w, h)
        val t = if (live) time else 0f
        g.paint(s.base); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(s.glow); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        // su bandı: üst kenarı çok hafif dalgalanır; parlak bir ince çizgi yüzeyi belirtir
        val bob = sin(t * 0.7f) * h * 0.004f
        g.paint(s.water); g.rect(0f, s.waterTop + bob, w, h)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0.14f else 0.65f)); g.rect(0f, s.waterTop + bob, w, s.waterTop + bob + max(1f, h * 0.0016f))
    }

    override fun bubble(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, alpha: Float) {}
    override fun particle(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, alpha: Float, phase: Float) {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ Duru: düz, ince kenarlı, hafif saydam yüzeyler

    /** Kart: hafif saydam düz yüzey, ince kenar, çok yumuşak gölge; seçiliyken vurgu renginde ince çerçeve. */
    override fun card(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, rad: Float, selected: Float, press: Float, strong: Float, shadow: Float) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        val rr = min(rad * 0.55f, min(w, h) / 2f)
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFF1F2C27.toInt() else Rgb.WHITE, (0.55f + 0.35f * strong + 0.08f * press).coerceIn(0f, 1f))); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr)
        if (selected > 0f || press > 0f) { g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, 0.08f * selected + 0.07f * press)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr) }
        g.strokeWidth(1f); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt() else 0xFF2E8C7E.toInt(), if (dark) 0.14f else 0.22f)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.5f, 0.5f, w - 0.5f, h - 0.5f, max(0f, rr - 0.5f))
        if (selected > 0.01f) { g.strokeWidth(1.6f); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, 0.85f * selected)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.8f, 0.8f, w - 0.8f, h - 0.8f, max(0f, rr - 0.8f)) }
        g.restore()
    }

    /** Anahtar: sade hap yuva, açıkken vurgu rengi; tutamaç düz beyaz daire. */
    override fun switch(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, w: Float, h: Float, on: Float, press: Float) {
        val k = on.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        g.paint(Rgb.lerp(if (dark) 0xFF2C3A35.toInt() else 0xFFC6DDD6.toInt(), theme.accent, k)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        val cx = h / 2f + (w - h) * k
        val rad = h / 2f - 2.5f + press * 1.2f
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(0xFF000000.toInt(), 0.14f)); g.circle(cx, h / 2f + 1f, rad)
        g.paint(Rgb.WHITE); g.circle(cx, h / 2f, rad)
        g.restore()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ Duru: tamamen düz bileşenler (cam, parlama, gölge yok)

    private val wavePath = GPath()
    private val err = 0xFFD64545.toInt()

    /** Dolu düğme: düz vurgu rengi, köşeler yumuşak dikdörtgen (hap değil), gölge ve parlama yok. */
    override fun pill(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, press: Float, shadow: Float) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        val rr = min(h * 0.34f, 14f)
        g.paint(Rgb.lerp(theme.control, theme.controlDeep, 0.30f + 0.25f * press)); g.roundRect(l, t, r, b, rr)
    }

    /** Ana düğme: düz daire; sıvı yerine alttan yükselen sakin su düzeyi. Cam, parlama ve baloncuk yok. */
    override fun orb(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, level: Float, phase: Float, glow: Float, error: Float, press: Float) {
        if (orbShape != OrbShape.CIRCLE) { super.orb(g, cx, cy, r, level, phase, glow, error, press); return }
        val lv = level.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val base = if (liquidColor != 0) liquidColor else theme.control
        val fillC = Rgb.lerp(base, err, error.coerceIn(0f, 1f))
        val deep = Rgb.lerp(if (liquidColor != 0) Rgb.lerp(liquidColor, 0xFF000000.toInt(), 0.25f) else theme.controlDeep, err, error.coerceIn(0f, 1f))
        // bağlıyken yavaşça nefes alan tek ince halka
        if (glow > 0.01f) {
            val k = 0.5f + 0.5f * sin(phase * 0.5f)
            g.strokeWidth(1.4f); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(fillC, 0.55f * glow * (1f - 0.5f * k))); g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, r * (1.10f + 0.08f * k))
        }
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFF1F2C27.toInt() else Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0.85f else 0.80f)); g.circle(cx, cy, r)
        if (lv > 0.012f) {
            val yLevel = cy + r - 2f * r * lv
            val amp = 2.4f * min(1f, min(lv * 5f, (1f - lv) * 5f))
            g.save(); g.clipCircle(cx, cy, r - 1f)
            val p = wavePath.reset()
            val n = 20
            val x0 = cx - r
            val x1 = cx + r
            // Eski dalga sin(phase + i·0,55) ile aynı dalga boyu: CALM hareketi bu biçimde özgün görünümü korur.
            val cyc = 0.55f * n / TAU_F
            p.moveTo(x0, cy + r + 2f)
            for (i in 0..n) {
                val x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * i / n
                p.lineTo(x, yLevel + amp * orbFlow.gain * orbGain * orbFlow.offset(i.toFloat() / n, cyc, phase))
            }
            p.lineTo(x1, cy + r + 2f); p.close()
            g.paint(fillC); g.path(p)
            g.restore()
        }
        g.strokeWidth(1.6f); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(deep, 0.75f)); g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, r - 0.8f)
        if (press > 0f) { g.paint(Rgb.alpha(deep, 0.14f * press)); g.circle(cx, cy, r) }
        val mix = Easing.clamp01((lv - 0.38f) / 0.20f)
        val off = if (dark) theme.accentLight else theme.controlDeep
        val isz = r * 0.56f
        Icons.draw(g, Icon.POWER, cx, cy + r * 0.04f, isz, Rgb.lerp(off, Rgb.WHITE, mix), 2.2f)
    }

    /** Satır başı simge: düz, yumuşak köşeli kare, vurgu renginin hafif tonu. */
    override fun iconDisc(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float) {
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, if (dark) 0.22f else 0.16f)); g.roundRect(cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r, r * 0.42f)
    }

    override fun badge(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float) {
        g.paint(theme.control); g.circle(cx, cy, r)
        Icons.draw(g, Icon.CHECK, cx, cy, r * 1.3f, Rgb.WHITE, 2.4f)
    }

    /** Segmentli seçici: düz iz, seçili parça düz dolu. */
    override fun segmented(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, n: Int, pos: Float) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        val rr = min(h * 0.34f, 14f)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt() else 0xFF2E8C7E.toInt(), if (dark) 0.10f else 0.10f)); g.roundRect(l, t, r, b, rr)
        val inset = 3f
        val sw = (w - inset * 2f) / n
        val x = l + inset + sw * pos.coerceIn(0f, (n - 1).toFloat())
        pill(g, x, t + inset, x + sw, b - inset, 0f, 0f)
    }

    /** Üst çubuk: düz, tek ince alt çizgi. */
    override fun bar(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, a: Float, skyH: Float) {
        if (a <= 0.01f) return
        g.save(); g.alpha(a)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFF141C19.toInt() else 0xFFEAF5F1.toInt(), 0.96f)); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt() else 0xFF2E8C7E.toInt(), if (dark) 0.14f else 0.20f)); g.rect(0f, h - 1f, w, h)
        g.restore()
    }
}

private const val TAU_F = 6.2831855f

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/ArtEco.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
