import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/**
 * Frutiger Eco: doğa ile teknolojinin buluşması (yenilenebilir enerji). Yeşile çalan gökyüzü, altta yeşil tepeler üzerinde
 * dönen rüzgâr türbinleri ve parlak güneş panelleri, süzülen bokeh kabarcıkları, ağaç dallarından süzülen güneş lekeleri
 * (geceleri ateşböcekleri), köşelerde sallanan dal ve yapraklar, yaprak biçimli kartlar ve düğmeler. Küre, yeşil kıtalı
 * bir Dünya'dır. Hareket: yapraklar düşer, türbinler döner, seçili kartın köşesinde yaprak büyür, bağlanınca kürede filiz uzar.
 */
class EcoArt(theme: AeroTheme, glass: Float) : AeroArt(theme, glass) {
    override val style: UiStyle get() = UiStyle.ECO
    override val particleMode: ParticleMode get() = ParticleMode.FALL
    override val liveSky: Boolean get() = true
    override val motion: StyleMotion = StyleMotion(PageMotion.FADE_SCALE, 0.40f, 0.04f, 0.35f, depth = 1.2f, up = SpringSpec(300f, 18f), toggle = SpringSpec(300f, 19f), fx = FxKind.LEAF)

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ yaprak biçimi

    private val leaf = GPath().apply {
        moveTo(0f, 0f)
        cubicTo(0.64f, -0.16f, 0.58f, -0.76f, 0f, -1f)
        cubicTo(-0.58f, -0.76f, -0.64f, -0.16f, 0f, 0f)
        close()
    }
    private val leafFill = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, -1f,
        if (dark) 0xFF1B6B3A.toInt() else 0xFF2E8B3A.toInt(), if (dark) 0xFF47B36B.toInt() else 0xFF9BDB5F.toInt())
    private val leafFillB = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, -1f,
        if (dark) 0xFF2C7A46.toInt() else 0xFF55A83F.toInt(), if (dark) 0xFF7CCB8A.toInt() else 0xFFC9E86A.toInt())
    private val leafAutumn = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, -1f,
        if (dark) 0xFF8A5A22.toInt() else 0xFFD9892B.toInt(), if (dark) 0xFFC9A04A.toInt() else 0xFFF3CF5E.toInt())

    private fun drawLeaf(g: Gfx, x: Float, y: Float, angleDeg: Float, size: Float, fill: Fill, veins: Boolean = true) {
        g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.rotate(angleDeg); g.scale(size, size)
        g.paint(fill); g.path(leaf)
        if (veins) {
            g.strokeWidth(0.045f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.28f else 0.55f)); g.line(0f, -0.04f, 0f, -0.88f)
        }
        g.restore()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ gökyüzü

    private class Backdrop(val w: Float, val h: Float, art: EcoArt) {
        val th = art.theme
        val dk = art.dark
        private val g0 = if (dk) 0xFF0B2A20.toInt() else 0xFFE9F8D6.toInt()
        private val g1 = if (dk) 0xFF0E3A2A.toInt() else 0xFFCBEBAE.toInt()
        private val g2 = if (dk) 0xFF123522.toInt() else 0xFFA4D38B.toInt()
        val base = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h,
            Rgb.lerp(th.skyTop, g0, 0.55f), Rgb.lerp(th.skyMid, g1, 0.55f), Rgb.lerp(th.skyBottom, g2, 0.55f), AeroTheme.SKY_MID_POS)
        val dapple = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, Rgb.alpha(0xFFFFF4C0.toInt(), 0.55f), Rgb.alpha(0xFFFFF4C0.toInt(), 0.18f), Rgb.alpha(0xFFFFF4C0.toInt(), 0f), 0.5f)
        val firefly = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, Rgb.alpha(0xFFE9FF8A.toInt(), 0.95f), Rgb.alpha(0xFFB6F25A.toInt(), 0.30f), Rgb.alpha(0xFFB6F25A.toInt(), 0f), 0.30f)
        val light = Fill.radial(w * 0.85f, 0f, w * 1.0f, Rgb.alpha(0xFFFFF8D0.toInt(), if (dk) 0.06f else 0.55f), Rgb.alpha(0xFFFFF8D0.toInt(), 0f))
        val stem = if (dk) 0xFF1F5A38.toInt() else 0xFF4E7D3A.toInt()
        val stemPath = GPath()

        // tepeler: ön ve arka; çizgiler bir kez kurulur
        val hillFar = GPath()
        val hillNear = GPath()
        val farFill = Fill.linear(0f, h * 0.76f, 0f, h,
            Rgb.alpha(if (dk) 0xFF1B6B3A.toInt() else 0xFF7FCB5A.toInt(), if (dk) 0.55f else 0.62f),
            Rgb.alpha(if (dk) 0xFF0E3A22.toInt() else 0xFF3E9B3F.toInt(), if (dk) 0.70f else 0.78f))
        val nearFill = Fill.linear(0f, h * 0.84f, 0f, h,
            Rgb.alpha(if (dk) 0xFF14502F.toInt() else 0xFF56B23F.toInt(), if (dk) 0.70f else 0.80f),
            Rgb.alpha(if (dk) 0xFF0A2E1B.toInt() else 0xFF2E8B3A.toInt(), if (dk) 0.85f else 0.90f))
        // güneş paneli: birim paralelkenar
        val panel = GPath().poly(0.14f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 0.86f, 1f, 0f, 1f, closed = true)
        val panelFill = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f,
            if (dk) 0xFF1E4F8F.toInt() else 0xFF2F7FD0.toInt(), if (dk) 0xFF0F2B57.toInt() else 0xFF0E4A9A.toInt(), if (dk) 0xFF1E4F8F.toInt() else 0xFF5BB0F0.toInt(), 0.6f)
        val blade = GPath().apply { moveTo(0f, 0f); quadTo(0.10f, -0.45f, 0f, -1f); quadTo(-0.05f, -0.45f, 0f, 0f); close() }
        val bokeh = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dk) 0.03f else 0.10f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dk) 0.06f else 0.16f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dk) 0.22f else 0.55f), 0.82f)
        val sun = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, Rgb.alpha(0xFFFFFBD6.toInt(), if (dk) 0.0f else 0.95f), Rgb.alpha(0xFFFFF0A0.toInt(), if (dk) 0.0f else 0.35f), Rgb.alpha(0xFFFFF0A0.toInt(), 0f), 0.30f)

        init {
            hillFar.moveTo(0f, h)
            for (i in 0..16) { val u = i / 16f; hillFar.lineTo(u * w, crestFar(u)) }
            hillFar.lineTo(w, h).close()
            hillNear.moveTo(0f, h)
            for (i in 0..16) { val u = i / 16f; hillNear.lineTo(u * w, crestNear(u)) }
            hillNear.lineTo(w, h).close()
        }

        fun crestFar(u: Float) = h * (0.800f + 0.026f * sin(u * 3.4f + 0.5f))
        fun crestNear(u: Float) = h * (0.885f + 0.020f * sin(u * 2.6f + 2.2f))
    }

    private var back: Backdrop? = null

    private fun backdrop(w: Float, h: Float): Backdrop {
        var b = back
        if (b == null || b.w != w || b.h != h) { b = Backdrop(w, h, this); back = b }
        return b
    }

    override fun sky(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float) = skyFrame(g, w, h, false, 0f)

    override fun skyFrame(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, live: Boolean, time: Float) {
        val b = backdrop(w, h)
        g.paint(b.base); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(b.light); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        val t = if (live) time else 0f
        if (!dark) {
            // yaprak aralarından süzülen güneş lekeleri (yavaşça kayar)
            for (i in 0 until 4) {
                val x = w * (0.18f + 0.25f * i) + sin(t * 0.20f + i * 2.1f) * w * 0.07f
                val y = h * (0.14f + 0.17f * i) + cos(t * 0.17f + i * 1.3f) * h * 0.035f
                g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.rotate(-24f); g.scale(w * 0.34f, w * 0.20f)
                g.alpha(0.55f + 0.30f * sin(t * 0.5f + i * 1.7f)); g.paint(b.dapple); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f)
                g.restore()
            }
        } else {
            // ateşböcekleri
            for (i in 0 until 8) {
                val x = w * ((i * 0.137f + 0.07f) % 1f) + sin(t * 0.35f + i * 1.9f) * 18f
                val y = h * (0.10f + 0.08f * i) + cos(t * 0.28f + i * 2.3f) * 14f
                val pulse = 0.35f + 0.65f * max(0f, sin(t * 0.9f + i * 2.7f))
                val r = 7f + (i % 3) * 3f
                g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.scale(r, r); g.alpha(pulse); g.paint(b.firefly); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()
            }
        }
        scenery(g, b, w, h, t)
        // köşelerde dallar
        g.save(); g.alpha(if (dark) 0.62f else 0.72f)
        branch(g, b, w + 8f, -8f, 126f, min(h * 0.34f, w * 0.95f), 7, t, 0f)
        branch(g, b, w + 8f, -8f, 150f, min(h * 0.20f, w * 0.60f), 5, t, 1.7f)
        branch(g, b, -10f, h + 10f, -52f, min(h * 0.20f, w * 0.60f), 5, t, 3.1f)
        g.restore()
    }

    /** Alt kısım: tepeler, rüzgâr türbinleri, güneş panelleri; üstte yavaşça süzülen bokeh kabarcıkları ve güneş. */
    private fun scenery(g: Gfx, b: Backdrop, w: Float, h: Float, t: Float) {
        if (!dark) {
            g.save(); g.translate(w * 0.80f, h * 0.10f); g.scale(w * 0.34f, w * 0.34f); g.paint(b.sun); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()
        }
        for (i in 0 until 6) {
            val r = w * (0.035f + 0.022f * (i % 3))
            val x = w * ((0.12f + i * 0.17f) % 1f) + sin(t * 0.18f + i * 1.7f) * w * 0.02f
            val y = h * (0.20f + 0.11f * i) + cos(t * 0.14f + i * 2.1f) * h * 0.015f
            g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.scale(r, r); g.paint(b.bokeh); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()
        }
        g.paint(b.farFill); g.path(b.hillFar)
        // rüzgâr türbinleri (arka tepenin sırtında)
        for (i in 0 until 3) {
            val u = 0.60f + 0.17f * i
            val bx = u * w
            val by = b.crestFar(u)
            val th = h * (0.058f + 0.008f * i)
            val hx = bx
            val hy = by - th
            g.strokeWidth(1.6f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.45f else 0.80f)); g.line(bx, by, hx, hy)
            val bl = th * 0.62f
            for (k in 0 until 3) {
                g.save(); g.translate(hx, hy); g.rotate(t * (26f + 5f * i) + k * 120f + i * 40f); g.scale(bl * 0.30f, bl)
                g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.60f else 0.97f)); g.path(b.blade)
                g.restore()
            }
            g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.75f else 1f)); g.circle(hx, hy, 2.2f)
        }
        g.paint(b.nearFill); g.path(b.hillNear)
        // güneş panelleri (ön tepenin sağında, eğimli sıra)
        val pw = w * 0.115f
        val ph = h * 0.026f
        for (i in 0 until 3) {
            val u = 0.56f + 0.15f * i
            val x = u * w
            val y = b.crestNear(u) + h * 0.008f
            g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.scale(pw, ph); g.alpha(0.50f)
            g.paint(b.panelFill); g.path(b.panel)
            g.strokeWidth(0.05f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.35f else 0.75f))
            g.line(0.38f, 0f, 0.32f, 1f); g.line(0.69f, 0f, 0.66f, 1f); g.line(0.07f, 0.5f, 0.93f, 0.5f)
            g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.10f else 0.30f)); g.rect(0.14f, 0f, 0.80f, 0.34f)
            g.restore()
        }
    }

    /** Eğimli bir dal: gövde bir ikinci derece eğri, yapraklar sırayla iki yana dizilir ve rüzgârda sallanır. */
    private fun branch(g: Gfx, b: Backdrop, ox: Float, oy: Float, angleDeg: Float, len: Float, n: Int, t: Float, seed: Float) {
        val a = angleDeg * PI.toFloat() / 180f
        val ex = ox + cos(a) * len
        val ey = oy + sin(a) * len
        val cx = (ox + ex) / 2f + sin(a) * len * 0.12f
        val cy = (oy + ey) / 2f - cos(a) * len * 0.12f
        val sw = sin(t * 0.7f + seed) * 0.02f
        b.stemPath.reset().moveTo(ox, oy).quadTo(cx, cy, ex + sw * len, ey)
        g.strokeWidth(2.4f); g.paint(b.stem); g.strokePath(b.stemPath)
        for (i in 1..n) {
            val u = i / (n + 1f) + 0.04f
            val iu = 1f - u
            val px = iu * iu * ox + 2f * iu * u * cx + u * u * (ex + sw * len)
            val py = iu * iu * oy + 2f * iu * u * cy + u * u * ey
            val side = if (i % 2 == 0) 1f else -1f
            val ang = angleDeg + 90f + side * 52f + sin(t * 0.9f + seed + i * 0.8f) * 5f
            val sz = len * 0.20f * (1.05f - 0.55f * u)
            drawLeaf(g, px, py, ang, sz, if (i % 3 == 0) leafFillB else leafFill)
        }
        drawLeaf(g, ex + sw * len, ey, angleDeg + 90f + sin(t * 0.9f + seed) * 4f, len * 0.13f, leafFillB)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ düşen yapraklar

    override fun particle(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, alpha: Float, phase: Float) {
        val pick = ((phase * 3.1f).toInt() and 0x7fffffff) % 5
        val fill = if (pick == 0) leafAutumn else if (pick % 2 == 1) leafFill else leafFillB
        g.save(); g.alpha(alpha * (if (dark) 0.75f else 0.9f))
        drawLeaf(g, cx, cy, phase * 38f + 20f, r * 1.7f, fill, veins = r > 9f)
        g.restore()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ yaprak biçimli yüzeyler

    private class Shape(val w: Float, val h: Float, rad: Float) {
        val path = GPath()
        val avg: Float

        init {
            val m = min(w, h) / 2f
            val big = min(rad * 1.25f, m)
            val small = min(rad * 0.38f, m)
            // sol üst büyük, sağ üst küçük, sağ alt büyük, sol alt küçük
            path.moveTo(big, 0f)
            path.lineTo(w - small, 0f); path.arc(w - small, small, small, small, -90f, 90f, true)
            path.lineTo(w, h - big); path.arc(w - big, h - big, big, big, 0f, 90f, true)
            path.lineTo(small, h); path.arc(small, h - small, small, small, 90f, 90f, true)
            path.lineTo(0f, big); path.arc(big, big, big, big, 180f, 90f, true)
            path.close()
            avg = (big + small) / 2f
        }
    }

    private val shapes = LongCache<Shape>(80)

    private fun shapeOf(w: Float, h: Float, rad: Float): Shape {
        val k = key(w, h, rad)
        var s = shapes[k]
        if (s == null) { s = Shape(w, h, rad); shapes[k] = s }
        return s
    }

    private class Paints(val w: Float, val h: Float, art: EcoArt) {
        val body = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, art.tint(art.aTop), art.tint(art.aBot))
        val wash = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, w, h, Rgb.alpha(0xFF9BDB5F.toInt(), if (art.dark) 0.05f else 0.16f), Rgb.alpha(0xFF2E8B3A.toInt(), 0.04f))
        val rim = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, w, h, art.white(if (art.dark) 0.50f else 0.92f), Rgb.alpha(0xFF6CBF5A.toInt(), if (art.dark) 0.30f else 0.50f))
        val bodyStrong = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.alpha(art.theme.skyTop, 0.97f), Rgb.alpha(art.theme.skyMid, 0.97f))
    }

    private val paints = LongCache<Paints>(80)

    private fun paintsOf(w: Float, h: Float): Paints {
        val k = key(w, h, 9f)
        var p = paints[k]
        if (p == null) { p = Paints(w, h, this); paints[k] = p }
        return p
    }

    override fun card(
        g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, rad: Float,
        selected: Float, press: Float, strong: Float, shadow: Float,
    ) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        val sp = shapeOf(w, h, min(rad, min(w, h) / 2f))
        val pt = paintsOf(w, h)
        g.save()
        g.translate(l, t)
        if (shadow > 0f) {
            g.strokeWidth(2.2f)
            val base = (if (dark) 0.16f else 0.10f) * shadow
            for (i in 0 until 5) {
                val f = 1f - i / 5f
                g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFF000000.toInt() else 0xFF1E5A2A.toInt(), base * f * f))
                val e = 0.9f + i * 1.9f
                g.strokeRoundRect(-e, -e + 2.4f, w + e, h + e + 2.4f, sp.avg + e)
            }
        }
        g.paint(pt.body); g.path(sp.path)
        g.paint(pt.wash); g.path(sp.path)
        if (strong > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(strong); g.paint(pt.bodyStrong); g.path(sp.path); g.restore() }
        if (selected > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(selected); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, 0.16f)); g.path(sp.path); g.restore() }
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f); g.paint(pt.rim); g.strokePath(sp.path)
        if (selected > 0f) {
            g.save(); g.alpha(selected)
            g.strokeWidth(2f); g.paint(theme.accent); g.strokePath(sp.path)
            g.restore()
            if (w >= 90f && h >= 44f) {
                // seçilince köşede iki yaprak büyür (sağ üst)
                val gr = Easing.outBack(selected, 1.6f)
                val sway = sin(clock * 1.3f) * 4f
                drawLeaf(g, w - 10f, 5f, 28f + sway, 17f * gr, leafFillB)
                drawLeaf(g, w - 10f, 5f, -22f + sway, 13f * gr, leafFill)
            }
        }
        if (press > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(press); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, 0.18f)); g.path(sp.path); g.restore() }
        g.restore()
    }

    private class PillShape(val w: Float, val h: Float) {
        val path = GPath()
        init {
            val big = h / 2f
            val small = h * 0.20f
            path.moveTo(big, 0f)
            path.lineTo(w - small, 0f); path.arc(w - small, small, small, small, -90f, 90f, true)
            path.lineTo(w, h - big); path.arc(w - big, h - big, big, big, 0f, 90f, true)
            path.lineTo(small, h); path.arc(small, h - small, small, small, 90f, 90f, true)
            path.lineTo(0f, big); path.arc(big, big, big, big, 180f, 90f, true)
            path.close()
        }
    }

    private val pillShapes = LongCache<PillShape>(40)
    private val pillBody = LongCache<Fill>(40)

    override fun pill(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, press: Float, shadow: Float) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        val k = key(w, h, 5f)
        var ps = pillShapes[k]
        if (ps == null) { ps = PillShape(w, h); pillShapes[k] = ps }
        var f = pillBody[k]
        if (f == null) { f = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.lerp(theme.control, 0xFF8FD35A.toInt(), 0.18f), theme.controlDeep); pillBody[k] = f }
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        if (shadow > 0f) {
            g.strokeWidth(2.2f)
            for (i in 0 until 4) {
                val ff = 1f - i / 4f
                g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.controlDeep, (if (dark) 0.22f else 0.12f) * shadow * ff * ff))
                val e = 1.1f + i * 1.9f
                g.strokeRoundRect(-e, -e + 2f, w + e, h + e + 2f, h / 2f + e)
            }
        }
        g.paint(f); g.path(ps.path)
        g.paint(white(0.20f)); g.roundRect(h * 0.35f, 1.4f, w - h * 0.25f, h * 0.42f, h * 0.2f)
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f); g.paint(white(0.65f)); g.strokePath(ps.path)
        if (press > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(press); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, 0.22f)); g.path(ps.path); g.restore() }
        g.restore()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ küre: filiz

    override fun orb(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, level: Float, phase: Float, glow: Float, error: Float, press: Float) {
        super.orb(g, cx, cy, r, level, phase, glow, error, press)
        if (r >= 24f && error < 0.5f) continents(g, cx, cy, r, press)
        val gr = Easing.clamp01((level - 0.08f) / 0.45f)
        if (gr <= 0.01f || r < 24f || error > 0.5f) return
        val s = Easing.outBack(gr, 1.5f)
        val sway = sin(phase * 0.8f) * 5f
        g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.scale(1f - 0.03f * press, 1f - 0.03f * press)
        // filiz kürenin sağ üst kenarından çıkar
        val bx = r * decoX(0)
        val by = r * decoY(0)
        g.strokeWidth(2.6f); g.paint(if (dark) 0xFF47B36B.toInt() else 0xFF3C9A43.toInt())
        g.line(bx, by + 2f, bx + 6f * s, by - 22f * s)
        drawLeaf(g, bx + 6f * s, by - 22f * s, 38f + sway, r * 0.26f * s, leafFillB)
        drawLeaf(g, bx + 3f * s, by - 12f * s, -52f + sway, r * 0.20f * s, leafFill)
        g.restore()
    }

    /** Küre bir Dünya: kenarlara yakın, güç simgesini örtmeyen yeşil kıtalar ve ince bir meridyen. */
    private val land = GPath().apply {
        moveTo(-0.34f, -0.10f)
        cubicTo(-0.30f, -0.26f, -0.12f, -0.30f, -0.02f, -0.22f)
        cubicTo(0.06f, -0.34f, 0.22f, -0.26f, 0.20f, -0.12f)
        cubicTo(0.34f, -0.08f, 0.30f, 0.06f, 0.16f, 0.08f)
        cubicTo(0.12f, 0.24f, -0.02f, 0.30f, -0.08f, 0.16f)
        cubicTo(-0.18f, 0.20f, -0.22f, 0.06f, -0.30f, 0.04f)
        cubicTo(-0.38f, 0.02f, -0.38f, -0.06f, -0.34f, -0.10f)
        close()
    }
    private val globeRing = GPath().apply {
        arc(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f, 0f, 90f, false); arc(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f, 90f, 90f, true)
        arc(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f, 180f, 90f, true); arc(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f, 270f, 90f, true); close()
    }
    private val landFill = Fill.linear(0f, -0.3f, 0f, 0.3f,
        if (dark) 0xFF2F9A55.toInt() else 0xFF3FA845.toInt(), if (dark) 0xFF1B6B3A.toInt() else 0xFF2E8B3A.toInt())

    private fun continents(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, press: Float) {
        val k = 1f - 0.03f * press
        g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.scale(k, k); clipOrb(g, r, 3f)
        // enlem / boylam çizgileri (ince, açık)
        g.save(); g.alpha(if (dark) 0.22f else 0.38f); g.strokeWidth(1f); g.paint(white(1f))
        g.line(-r, 0f, r, 0f)
        val lat = r * 0.55f
        val chord = sqrt(r * r - lat * lat)
        g.line(-chord, -lat, chord, -lat); g.line(-chord, lat, chord, lat)
        g.save(); g.scale(r * 0.46f, r); g.strokeWidth(0.02f); g.strokePath(globeRing); g.restore()
        g.save(); g.scale(r * 0.82f, r); g.strokeWidth(0.016f); g.strokePath(globeRing); g.restore()
        g.restore()
        g.alpha(if (dark) 0.50f else 0.60f)
        val drift = sin(clock * 0.25f) * r * 0.04f
        g.save(); g.translate(-r * 0.50f + drift, -r * 0.40f); g.scale(r * 0.85f, r * 0.85f); g.paint(landFill); g.path(land); g.restore()
        g.save(); g.translate(r * 0.52f - drift, r * 0.58f); g.scale(r * 0.72f, r * 0.72f); g.rotate(170f); g.paint(landFill); g.path(land); g.restore()
        g.restore()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ anahtar: yaprak topuzlu

    override fun switch(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, w: Float, h: Float, on: Float, press: Float) {
        val o = on.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        g.paint(insetFill(h)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        if (o > 0.001f) {
            g.save(); g.alpha(o)
            g.paint(Rgb.lerp(theme.control, 0xFF4DAF4A.toInt(), 0.25f)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
            g.paint(white(0.20f)); g.roundRect(1.5f, 1.2f, w - 1.5f, h * 0.46f, h / 2f - 1.2f)
            g.restore()
        }
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.40f else 0.85f)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.6f, 0.6f, w - 0.6f, h - 0.6f, h / 2f - 0.6f)
        val kr = h / 2f - 3.2f + press * 0.8f
        val kx = h / 2f + (w - h) * on.coerceIn(-0.12f, 1.12f)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, if (dark) 0.35f else 0.20f)); g.circle(kx, h / 2f + 1.5f, kr + 0.6f)
        g.paint(white(0.97f)); g.circle(kx, h / 2f, kr)
        // topuzdaki yaprak açıldıkça büyür
        drawLeaf(g, kx, h / 2f + kr * 0.55f, 18f, kr * 1.45f * (0.45f + 0.55f * o), if (o > 0.5f) leafFillB else leafFill)
        g.restore()
    }

    override fun iconDisc(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float) {
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, if (dark) 0.28f else 0.26f)); g.circle(cx, cy, r)
        g.strokeWidth(1f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.30f else 0.75f)); g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, r - 0.5f)
    }
}

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/ArtLiquid.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.sin

/**
 * Liquid Glass: bulanık mavi-mor ışık lekeleri üzerinde kalın, yarı saydam cam. Kartların ve düğmelerin üst-sol kenarında
 * parlak beyaz ışık çizgisi, alt-sağında ince ters yansıma vardır; cam arkasındaki ışığı hafifçe renklendirir.
 * Hareket: akışkan, yaylı; zemin lekeleri yavaşça kayar (yalnızca hareket açıkken). Renk teması hafifçe karışır.
 */
class LiquidArt(theme: AeroTheme, glass: Float) : AeroArt(theme, glass) {
    override val style: UiStyle get() = UiStyle.LIQUID
    override val particleMode: ParticleMode get() = ParticleMode.NONE
    override val liveSky: Boolean get() = true
    override val motion: StyleMotion = StyleMotion(PageMotion.FADE_SCALE, 0.42f, 0.04f, 0.55f, depth = 0.8f, tilt = 3f, up = SpringSpec.SOFT, toggle = SpringSpec.SOFT, fx = FxKind.GLASS)

    private val blue = 0xFF3D8BFF.toInt()
    private val indigo = 0xFF6A5CFF.toInt()
    private val ice = 0xFFA9DCFF.toInt()

    private class Scene(val w: Float, val h: Float, art: LiquidArt) {
        private val dk = art.dark
        private val th = art.theme
        val base = if (dk)
            Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.lerp(0xFF050B24.toInt(), th.skyTop, 0.12f), Rgb.lerp(0xFF0B1646.toInt(), th.skyMid, 0.12f), Rgb.lerp(0xFF1B1560.toInt(), th.skyBottom, 0.10f), 0.55f)
        else
            Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.lerp(0xFFBFD9FF.toInt(), th.skyTop, 0.18f), Rgb.lerp(0xFF8FB4FF.toInt(), th.skyMid, 0.18f), Rgb.lerp(0xFFB9A8FF.toInt(), th.skyBottom, 0.16f), 0.6f)
        val blobA = Fill.radial(w * 0.22f, h * 0.20f, w * 0.75f, Rgb.alpha(art.blue, if (dk) 0.55f else 0.70f), Rgb.alpha(art.blue, 0f))
        val blobB = Fill.radial(w * 0.85f, h * 0.55f, w * 0.80f, Rgb.alpha(art.indigo, if (dk) 0.55f else 0.60f), Rgb.alpha(art.indigo, 0f))
        val blobC = Fill.radial(w * 0.30f, h * 0.92f, w * 0.85f, Rgb.alpha(art.ice, if (dk) 0.30f else 0.75f), Rgb.alpha(art.ice, 0f))
        val sheen = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, w, h * 0.5f, Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dk) 0.10f else 0.35f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f), 0.6f)
    }

    private var scene: Scene? = null

    private fun scene(w: Float, h: Float): Scene {
        var s = scene
        if (s == null || s.w != w || s.h != h) { s = Scene(w, h, this); scene = s }
        return s
    }

    override fun sky(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float) = skyFrame(g, w, h, false, 0f)

    override fun skyFrame(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, live: Boolean, time: Float) {
        val s = scene(w, h)
        val t = if (live) time else 0f
        g.paint(s.base); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.save(); g.translate(sin(t * 0.21f) * w * 0.05f, cos(t * 0.17f) * h * 0.02f)
        g.paint(s.blobA); g.rect(-w * 0.1f, -h * 0.1f, w * 1.1f, h * 1.1f)
        g.restore()
        g.save(); g.translate(cos(t * 0.19f) * w * 0.05f, sin(t * 0.23f) * h * 0.02f)
        g.paint(s.blobB); g.rect(-w * 0.1f, -h * 0.1f, w * 1.1f, h * 1.1f)
        g.restore()
        g.paint(s.blobC); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(s.sheen); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
    }

    override fun bubble(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, alpha: Float) {}
    override fun particle(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, alpha: Float, phase: Float) {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ Liquid Glass: kalın saydam cam

    /** Cam kart: saydam gövde, üst-sol parlak kenar, alt-sağ ince yansıma, seçiliyken renkli ışıma. */
    override fun card(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, rad: Float, selected: Float, press: Float, strong: Float, shadow: Float) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        val rr = min(rad + 4f, min(w, h) / 2f)
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        if (shadow > 0f) { g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFF000018.toInt() else 0xFF2A3F8F.toInt(), (if (dark) 0.35f else 0.14f) * shadow)); g.roundRect(0f, 4f, w, h + 4f, rr) }
        if (selected > 0f) { g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accentLight, 0.30f * selected)); g.roundRect(-3f, -3f, w + 3f, h + 3f, rr + 3f) }
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFF8FB4FF.toInt() else Rgb.WHITE, (0.14f + 0.40f * strong + 0.10f * press).coerceIn(0f, 1f))); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, 0.10f + 0.14f * selected + 0.10f * press)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr)
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0.30f else 0.70f)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.6f, 0.6f, w - 0.6f, h - 0.6f, max(0f, rr - 0.6f))
        // parlak kenar: üstte uzun beyaz çizgi, solda kısa
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0.85f)); g.roundRect(rr, 1.2f, w - rr * 0.8f, 2.6f, 1.3f)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0.45f)); g.roundRect(1.2f, rr, 2.4f, h - rr, 1.2f)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accentLight, 0.45f)); g.roundRect(rr, h - 3.2f, w - rr, h - 1.6f, 0.8f)
        g.restore()
    }

    /** Cam anahtar: saydam yuva, açıkken mavi ışıma; tutamaç kalın cam damla (beyaz parıltılı). */
    override fun switch(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, w: Float, h: Float, on: Float, press: Float) {
        val k = on.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        if (k > 0.01f) { g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accentLight, 0.40f * k)); g.roundRect(-3f, -3f, w + 3f, h + 3f, h / 2f + 3f) }
        g.paint(Rgb.lerp(if (dark) 0xFF26345F.toInt() else 0xFFC9D8F5.toInt(), theme.accent, k)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        g.strokeWidth(1.2f); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0.65f)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.6f, 0.6f, w - 0.6f, h - 0.6f, h / 2f - 0.6f)
        val cx = h / 2f + (w - h) * k
        val rad = h / 2f - 1.5f + press * 1.5f
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0.50f)); g.circle(cx, h / 2f, rad + 1.2f)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0.92f)); g.circle(cx, h / 2f, rad - 1f)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accentLight, 0.45f)); g.circle(cx + rad * 0.15f, h / 2f + rad * 0.25f, rad * 0.5f)
        g.paint(Rgb.WHITE); g.circle(cx - rad * 0.35f, h / 2f - rad * 0.4f, rad * 0.22f)
        g.restore()
    }
}

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/ArtMetro.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.sin

/**
 * Frutiger Metro: 2000'lerin başının şehir, müzik ve gençlik vektör sanatı. Zeminde güneş ışını çizgileri, gökdelen
 * silueti (pencereli), hoparlör, iç içe halkalar, yıldızlar, girdaplar, yarım ton noktalar, sıçrama damlaları ve pembe/turuncu
 * şerit dalgalar. Düğmeler, kartlar, anahtarlar ve küre öteki stillerle aynıdır (temel cam çizim); yalnızca zemin ve
 * hareket Metro'ya özgüdür. Renk teması bir miktar karışır.
 * Hareket: karolar yana yatarak girer (turnike).
 */
class MetroArt(theme: AeroTheme, glass: Float) : AeroArt(theme, glass) {
    override val style: UiStyle get() = UiStyle.METRO
    override val particleMode: ParticleMode get() = ParticleMode.NONE
    override val motion: StyleMotion = StyleMotion(PageMotion.TURNSTILE, 0.32f, 0.035f, 0f, depth = 0.8f, tilt = 6f, up = SpringSpec.CRISP, toggle = SpringSpec.CRISP, fx = FxKind.SLICE)
    override val titleScale: Float get() = 1.22f

    private val lime = 0xFFC4EE4E.toInt()
    private val turq = 0xFF27D1C2.toInt()
    private val pink = 0xFFFF4FA3.toInt()
    private val orange = 0xFFFFA83A.toInt()
    private val blue = 0xFF1F8BFF.toInt()
    private val inkC = 0xFF081A2B.toInt()

    private val star5 = GPath().apply {
        for (i in 0 until 10) {
            val a = (-90.0 + i * 36.0) * PI / 180.0
            val r = if (i % 2 == 0) 1f else 0.42f
            val x = (cos(a) * r).toFloat()
            val y = (sin(a) * r).toFloat()
            if (i == 0) moveTo(x, y) else lineTo(x, y)
        }
        close()
    }

    private class Shapes(val w: Float, val h: Float, art: MetroArt) {
        val th = art.theme
        val dk = art.dark
        val base = if (dk)
            Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.lerp(0xFF04101C.toInt(), th.skyTop, 0.22f), Rgb.lerp(0xFF0A2540.toInt(), th.skyMid, 0.22f),
                Rgb.lerp(0xFF020912.toInt(), th.skyBottom, 0.18f), 0.55f)
        else
            Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.lerp(art.lime, th.skyTop, 0.30f), Rgb.lerp(art.turq, th.skyMid, 0.34f),
                Rgb.lerp(0xFFFFE9A6.toInt(), th.skyBottom, 0.25f), 0.60f)
        val ray = GPath()
        val swash = GPath()
        val swash2 = GPath()
        val swirl = GPath()
        val swashFill = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, w, 0f, Rgb.alpha(art.pink, if (dk) 0.55f else 0.80f), Rgb.alpha(art.orange, if (dk) 0.55f else 0.85f),
            Rgb.alpha(art.turq, if (dk) 0.45f else 0.65f), 0.55f)
        val glow = Fill.radial(w * 0.5f, h * 0.66f, w * 0.9f, Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dk) 0.18f else 0.55f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f))

        init {
            // ışınlar: tek bir kama; sahnede döndürülerek çizilir
            val cx = w * 0.5f
            val cy = h * 0.66f
            val len = (w + h) * 1.2f
            val half = (PI / 36.0).toFloat()
            ray.moveTo(cx, cy).lineTo(cx + len * sin(-half), cy - len * cos(-half)).lineTo(cx + len * sin(half), cy - len * cos(half)).close()
            // şerit dalgalar
            swash.moveTo(-0.1f * w, 0.84f * h).cubicTo(0.20f * w, 0.70f * h, 0.45f * w, 1.00f * h, 0.78f * w, 0.80f * h)
                .cubicTo(0.92f * w, 0.72f * h, 1.0f * w, 0.74f * h, 1.1f * w, 0.70f * h)
            swash2.moveTo(-0.1f * w, 0.90f * h).cubicTo(0.25f * w, 0.78f * h, 0.52f * w, 1.04f * h, 0.86f * w, 0.86f * h)
                .cubicTo(0.96f * w, 0.80f * h, 1.0f * w, 0.82f * h, 1.1f * w, 0.78f * h)
            // girdap: birim koordinatlarda sarmal
            var first = true
            var a = 0.0
            while (a < 4.2 * PI) {
                val r = 0.08f + (a / (4.2 * PI)).toFloat() * 0.92f
                val x = (cos(a) * r).toFloat()
                val y = (sin(a) * r).toFloat()
                if (first) { swirl.moveTo(x, y); first = false } else swirl.lineTo(x, y)
                a += 0.18
            }
        }
    }

    private var shapes: Shapes? = null

    private fun shapes(w: Float, h: Float): Shapes {
        var s = shapes
        if (s == null || s.w != w || s.h != h) { s = Shapes(w, h, this); shapes = s }
        return s
    }

    /** İç içe halkalar: dıştan içe dönüşümlü ana renk ve beyaz. */
    private fun rings(g: Gfx, x: Float, y: Float, r: Float, c1: Int, c2: Int, n: Int = 5) {
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            g.paint(if (i % 2 == 0) c1 else c2); g.circle(x, y, r * (1f - i / n.toFloat()))
        }
    }

    private fun star(g: Gfx, x: Float, y: Float, r: Float, rot: Float, fill: Int, line: Int) {
        g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.rotate(rot); g.scale(r, r)
        g.paint(fill); g.path(star5)
        g.strokeWidth(0.10f); g.paint(line); g.strokePath(star5)
        g.restore()
    }

    private fun speaker(g: Gfx, x: Float, y: Float, r: Float) {
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(inkC, if (dark) 0.85f else 0.82f)); g.circle(x, y, r)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(lime, 0.95f)); g.circle(x, y, r * 0.82f)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(inkC, 0.9f)); g.circle(x, y, r * 0.62f)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(turq, 0.95f)); g.circle(x, y, r * 0.46f)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(inkC, 0.9f)); g.circle(x, y, r * 0.16f)
        g.paint(white(0.75f)); g.oval(x - r * 0.46f, y - r * 0.50f, x - r * 0.04f, y - r * 0.24f)
    }

    private val xs = floatArrayOf(2f, 11f, 20f, 28f, 38f, 47f, 55f, 64f, 73f, 82f, 90f)
    private val ws = floatArrayOf(8f, 8f, 7f, 9f, 8f, 7f, 8f, 8f, 8f, 7f, 9f)
    private val hs = floatArrayOf(0.08f, 0.13f, 0.10f, 0.17f, 0.12f, 0.20f, 0.09f, 0.15f, 0.11f, 0.18f, 0.085f)
    private val dots = floatArrayOf(0.52f, 0.06f, 4f, 0.56f, 0.09f, 2.4f, 0.49f, 0.10f, 2f, 0.62f, 0.05f, 3f, 0.07f, 0.18f, 3f, 0.04f, 0.22f, 2f)

    private fun skyline(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float) {
        val u = w / 100f
        val base = h * 0.985f
        // (x, genişlik, yükseklik) yüzde cinsinden; yükseklik h'nin yüzdesi
        val body = Rgb.alpha(inkC, if (dark) 0.70f else 0.50f)
        val face = Rgb.alpha(if (dark) blue else turq, if (dark) 0.55f else 0.55f)
        val win = Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFFBFE8FF.toInt() else 0xFFFFF4B0.toInt(), if (dark) 0.75f else 0.85f)
        for (i in xs.indices) {
            val l = xs[i] * u
            val bw = ws[i] * u
            val bh = hs[i] * h
            g.paint(body); g.rect(l, base - bh, l + bw, base)
            g.paint(face); g.rect(l + bw * 0.62f, base - bh, l + bw, base)
            if (i == 5) { g.paint(body); g.rect(l + bw * 0.45f, base - bh - h * 0.05f, l + bw * 0.55f, base - bh) } // anten
            g.paint(win)
            var wy = base - bh + 5f
            while (wy < base - 8f) {
                g.rect(l + bw * 0.14f, wy, l + bw * 0.14f + 3f, wy + 3.5f)
                g.rect(l + bw * 0.38f, wy, l + bw * 0.38f + 3f, wy + 3.5f)
                wy += 11f
            }
        }
    }

    override fun sky(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float) {
        val s = shapes(w, h)
        val u = min(w, h)
        g.paint(s.base); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        // güneş ışınları
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.06f else 0.20f))
        for (i in 0 until 18) {
            g.save()
            val cx = w * 0.5f
            val cy = h * 0.66f
            g.translate(cx, cy); g.rotate(i * 20f); g.translate(-cx, -cy)
            g.path(s.ray)
            g.restore()
        }
        g.paint(s.glow); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        // yarım ton noktalar (sol üst, küçülerek solar)
        val dot = Rgb.alpha(if (dark) blue else pink, if (dark) 0.55f else 0.55f)
        g.paint(dot)
        for (i in 0 until 7) for (j in 0 until 7) {
            val r = (3.2f - (i + j) * 0.25f)
            if (r > 0.5f) g.circle(w * 0.04f + i * 11f, h * 0.05f + j * 11f, r)
        }
        // halkalar
        rings(g, w * 1.0f, h * 0.17f, u * 0.12f, Rgb.alpha(inkC, 0.80f), white(0.92f))
        rings(g, w * 0.0f, h * 0.47f, u * 0.07f, Rgb.alpha(if (dark) blue else pink, 0.92f), white(0.9f), 4)
        rings(g, w * 0.93f, h * 0.60f, u * 0.04f, Rgb.alpha(if (dark) turq else orange, 0.92f), white(0.9f), 3)
        // yıldızlar
        val sf = Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dark) 0.15f else 0.90f)
        val sl = Rgb.alpha(inkC, if (dark) 0.9f else 0.85f)
        star(g, w * 0.30f, h * 0.12f, u * 0.045f, 12f, sf, sl)
        star(g, w * 0.14f, h * 0.30f, u * 0.035f, -20f, Rgb.alpha(if (dark) turq else pink, 0.95f), sl)
        star(g, w * 0.70f, h * 0.38f, u * 0.05f, 25f, sf, sl)
        star(g, w * 0.92f, h * 0.75f, u * 0.04f, -10f, Rgb.alpha(orange, 0.95f), sl)
        star(g, w * 0.46f, h * 0.50f, u * 0.025f, 5f, sf, sl)
        // hoparlör ve girdaplar
        speaker(g, w * 0.95f, h * 0.31f, u * 0.075f)
        g.save(); g.translate(w * 0.62f, h * 0.075f); g.rotate(70f); g.scale(u * 0.08f, u * 0.08f)
        g.strokeWidth(0.12f); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) pink else inkC, 0.75f)); g.strokePath(s.swirl); g.restore()
        // sıçrama damlaları
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(inkC, if (dark) 0.5f else 0.8f))
        var i = 0
        while (i < dots.size) { g.circle(w * dots[i], h * dots[i + 1], dots[i + 2]); i += 3 }
        // şehir
        skyline(g, w, h)
        // şerit dalgalar
        g.strokeWidth(h * 0.030f); g.paint(s.swashFill); g.strokePath(s.swash)
        g.strokeWidth(h * 0.012f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.50f else 0.85f)); g.strokePath(s.swash2)
    }

    override fun skyFrame(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, live: Boolean, time: Float) = sky(g, w, h)

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ Metro: düz karo düğmeler

    /** Düz karo: keskin köşe, ince çerçeve, seçiliyken sol vurgu şeridi; basınca koyulaşır (cam parıltı yok). */
    override fun card(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, rad: Float, selected: Float, press: Float, strong: Float, shadow: Float) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        val rr = min(5f, min(w, h) / 2f)
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        if (shadow > 0f) { g.paint(Rgb.alpha(0xFF000000.toInt(), (if (dark) 0.35f else 0.14f) * shadow)); g.roundRect(0f, 2.5f, w, h + 2.5f, rr) }
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFF1B2A33.toInt() else Rgb.WHITE, (0.62f + 0.36f * strong).coerceIn(0f, 1f))); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr)
        if (selected > 0f) {
            g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, 0.20f * selected)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr)
            g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, selected)); g.rect(0f, 0f, 4f * selected + 0.01f, h)
        }
        if (press > 0f) { g.paint(Rgb.alpha(0xFF000000.toInt(), 0.12f * press)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr) }
        g.strokeWidth(1f); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) Rgb.WHITE else 0xFF000000.toInt(), if (dark) 0.22f else 0.14f))
        g.strokeRoundRect(0.5f, 0.5f, w - 0.5f, h - 0.5f, max(0f, rr - 0.5f))
        g.restore()
    }

    /** Düz anahtar: köşeli yuva, açıkken tam vurgu rengi, kare tutamaç. */
    override fun switch(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, w: Float, h: Float, on: Float, press: Float) {
        val k = on.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        g.paint(Rgb.lerp(if (dark) 0xFF3A4A54.toInt() else 0xFFC9D3D9.toInt(), theme.accent, k)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, 4f)
        val s = h - 10f + press * 2f
        val x = 5f + (w - h) * k
        g.paint(Rgb.WHITE); g.roundRect(x - press, 5f - press, x - press + s, 5f - press + s, 2.5f)
        g.restore()
    }
}

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/ArtY2k.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.sin

/**
 * Y2K: holografik, yanardöner pastel pembe, mor, mavi ve nane; parlak krom kalpler, cam gibi baloncuklar, dört köşeli
 * parıltılar, piksel pencereler (yükleme çubuklu) ve hafif tane dokusu. Düğmeler yanardöner şeker, kartlar renk
 * değiştiren krom çerçeveli buzlu cam. Renk teması hafifçe karışır.
 * Hareket: yaylı (geri sekmeli) açılış; kürede ışık taraması ve dönen parıltı.
 */
class Y2kArt(theme: AeroTheme, glass: Float) : AeroArt(theme, glass) {
    override val style: UiStyle get() = UiStyle.Y2K
    override val particleMode: ParticleMode get() = ParticleMode.TWINKLE
    override val liveSky: Boolean get() = true
    override val motion: StyleMotion = StyleMotion(PageMotion.POP, 0.42f, 0.03f, 1f, depth = 1.6f, up = SpringSpec.JELLY, toggle = SpringSpec.JELLY, fx = FxKind.SPARK)

    private val ice = 0xFFFFE6F7.toInt()
    private val cyan = 0xFF7FE3FF.toInt()
    private val silver = 0xFFA99BD8.toInt()
    private val pop1 = 0xFFFF6FC8.toInt()   // sıcak pembe
    private val pop2 = 0xFFB28CFF.toInt()   // mor
    private val mint = 0xFFA6FFE0.toInt()

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ parıltı (dört köşeli yıldız)

    private val star = GPath().apply {
        moveTo(0f, -1f)
        quadTo(0.13f, -0.13f, 1f, 0f)
        quadTo(0.13f, 0.13f, 0f, 1f)
        quadTo(-0.13f, 0.13f, -1f, 0f)
        quadTo(-0.13f, -0.13f, 0f, -1f)
        close()
    }
    private val starFill = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, white(1f), white(0.92f), Rgb.alpha(ice, 0.85f), 0.45f)
    private val starPink = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, white(1f), Rgb.alpha(pop1, 0.95f), Rgb.alpha(pop1, 0.80f), 0.40f)
    private val starCyan = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, white(1f), Rgb.alpha(cyan, 0.95f), Rgb.alpha(cyan, 0.80f), 0.40f)
    private val starGlow = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, white(if (dark) 0.40f else 0.55f), white(0f))

    private fun sparkle(g: Gfx, x: Float, y: Float, r: Float, a: Float, tone: Int = 0) {
        if (a <= 0.02f) return
        g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.alpha(min(1f, a))
        g.save(); g.scale(r * 1.7f, r * 1.7f); g.paint(starGlow); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()
        g.scale(r, r); g.paint(if (tone == 1) starPink else if (tone == 2) starCyan else starFill); g.path(star)
        g.restore()
    }

    override fun particle(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, alpha: Float, phase: Float) {
        val tw = 0.5f + 0.5f * sin(phase * 2f)
        val tone = ((phase * 3.1f).toInt() and 0x7fffffff) % 6
        sparkle(g, cx, cy, r * (0.45f + 0.65f * tw), alpha * (0.25f + 0.75f * tw), if (tone == 0) 1 else if (tone == 3) 2 else 0)
    }

    override fun bubble(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, alpha: Float) = particle(g, cx, cy, r, alpha, 0.8f)

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ gökyüzü

    private class Backdrop(val w: Float, val h: Float, art: Y2kArt) {
        val th = art.theme
        val dk = art.dark
        private val p0 = if (dk) 0xFF2A0F55.toInt() else 0xFFFFD6F0.toInt()
        private val p1 = if (dk) 0xFF1B2A6B.toInt() else 0xFFCDB8FF.toInt()
        private val p2 = if (dk) 0xFF0E3A66.toInt() else 0xFFB4F0FF.toInt()
        // Tema rengi hafifçe karışır (%28); görünümü holografik pastel belirler.
        val base = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h,
            Rgb.lerp(p0, th.skyTop, 0.28f), Rgb.lerp(p1, th.skyMid, 0.28f), Rgb.lerp(p2, th.skyBottom, 0.28f), 0.52f)
        private val ha = if (dk) 0.22f else 0.46f
        val holoA = Fill.linear(-w * 0.2f, 0f, w * 1.2f, h * 0.9f,
            Rgb.alpha(art.pop1, ha), Rgb.alpha(art.cyan, ha * 1.1f), Rgb.alpha(art.pop2, ha), 0.5f)
        val holoB = Fill.linear(w * 1.1f, 0f, -w * 0.1f, h,
            Rgb.alpha(art.mint, ha * 0.8f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, ha * 0.9f), Rgb.alpha(art.pop1, ha * 0.8f), 0.5f)
        val flare = Fill.radial(0f, 0f, 1f, Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dk) 0.16f else 0.75f), Rgb.alpha(art.cyan, if (dk) 0.06f else 0.22f), Rgb.alpha(art.cyan, 0f), 0.45f)
        // parlak krom kalp: birim koordinatlarda
        val heart = GPath().apply {
            moveTo(0f, 0.92f)
            cubicTo(-1.35f, -0.05f, -1.05f, -1.05f, 0f, -0.38f)
            cubicTo(1.05f, -1.05f, 1.35f, -0.05f, 0f, 0.92f)
            close()
        }
        val heartFill = Fill.linear(-1f, -1f, 1f, 1f,
            Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dk) 0.55f else 0.98f), Rgb.alpha(art.pop1, if (dk) 0.70f else 0.92f),
            Rgb.alpha(art.pop2, if (dk) 0.60f else 0.90f), 0.55f)
        val heartShine = Fill.radial(-0.40f, -0.50f, 0.60f, Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dk) 0.55f else 0.97f), Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, 0f))
        val bubbleFill = Fill.radial(-0.30f, -0.35f, 1.25f, Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (dk) 0.40f else 0.85f),
            Rgb.alpha(art.cyan, if (dk) 0.18f else 0.30f), Rgb.alpha(art.pop1, if (dk) 0.30f else 0.42f), 0.62f)
        val winBar = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, Rgb.alpha(art.pop1, 0.92f), Rgb.alpha(art.pop2, 0.92f))
    }

    private var back: Backdrop? = null

    private fun backdrop(w: Float, h: Float): Backdrop {
        var b = back
        if (b == null || b.w != w || b.h != h) { b = Backdrop(w, h, this); back = b }
        return b
    }

    override fun sky(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float) = skyFrame(g, w, h, false, 0f)

    private fun chromeHeart(g: Gfx, b: Backdrop, x: Float, y: Float, r: Float, rot: Float) {
        g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.rotate(rot); g.scale(r, r)
        g.paint(b.heartFill); g.path(b.heart)
        g.paint(b.heartShine); g.path(b.heart)
        g.strokeWidth(0.045f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.60f else 0.98f)); g.strokePath(b.heart)
        g.restore()
    }

    private fun glossBubble(g: Gfx, b: Backdrop, x: Float, y: Float, r: Float) {
        g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.scale(r, r)
        g.paint(b.bubbleFill); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f)
        g.strokeWidth(0.05f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.45f else 0.90f)); g.strokeCircle(0f, 0f, 0.97f)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.55f else 0.95f)); g.oval(-0.62f, -0.70f, -0.08f, -0.38f)
        g.restore()
    }

    /** Piksel pencere: başlık çubuğu, üç nokta ve parça parça dolan yükleme çubuğu. */
    private fun pixelWindow(g: Gfx, b: Backdrop, x: Float, y: Float, w: Float, t: Float) {
        val h = w * 0.62f
        g.save(); g.translate(x, y)
        g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.14f else 0.55f)); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(pop2, if (dark) 0.75f else 0.85f)); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h * 0.22f)
        val d = h * 0.07f
        for (i in 0 until 3) { g.paint(white(0.95f)); g.rect(h * 0.07f + i * d * 2.2f, h * 0.075f, h * 0.07f + i * d * 2.2f + d, h * 0.075f + d) }
        g.strokeWidth(1.6f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.60f else 0.98f)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.8f, 0.8f, w - 0.8f, h - 0.8f, 0f)
        // yükleme çubuğu
        val bx = w * 0.10f
        val bw = w * 0.80f
        val by = h * 0.58f
        val bh = h * 0.18f
        g.strokeWidth(1.3f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.70f else 0.98f)); g.strokeRoundRect(bx, by, bx + bw, by + bh, 0f)
        val n = 8
        val fill = ((t * 0.45f) % 1.25f / 1.25f * (n + 2)).toInt().coerceAtMost(n)
        val sw = (bw - 4f) / n
        for (i in 0 until fill) { g.paint(if (i % 2 == 0) pop1 else pop2); g.rect(bx + 2f + i * sw + 0.6f, by + 2f, bx + 2f + (i + 1) * sw - 0.6f, by + bh - 2f) }
        g.restore()
    }

    override fun skyFrame(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, live: Boolean, time: Float) {
        val b = backdrop(w, h)
        g.paint(b.base); g.rect(0f, 0f, w, h)
        val t = if (live) time else 0f
        // iki yanardöner şerit zıt yönlerde yavaşça kayar
        g.save(); g.translate(sin(t * 0.22f) * w * 0.28f, 0f)
        g.paint(b.holoA); g.rect(-w * 0.6f, 0f, w * 1.8f, h)
        g.restore()
        g.save(); g.translate(cos(t * 0.17f) * w * 0.22f, 0f)
        g.paint(b.holoB); g.rect(-w * 0.6f, 0f, w * 1.8f, h)
        g.restore()
        // yumuşak ışık lekeleri
        for (i in 0 until 3) {
            val x = w * (0.2f + 0.3f * i) + sin(t * 0.25f + i * 2f) * w * 0.05f
            val y = h * (0.12f + 0.30f * i) + cos(t * 0.2f + i) * h * 0.03f
            g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.scale(w * (0.55f - 0.08f * i), w * (0.55f - 0.08f * i)); g.paint(b.flare); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()
        }
        // tane dokusu: sabit rastgele noktalar
        var s = 7919
        val ga = if (dark) 0.10f else 0.14f
        for (i in 0 until 110) {
            s = s * 1103515245 + 12345
            val fx = ((s ushr 8) and 0xFFFF) / 65535f
            s = s * 1103515245 + 12345
            val fy = ((s ushr 8) and 0xFFFF) / 65535f
            g.paint(if (i and 1 == 0) white(ga) else Rgb.alpha(pop2, ga))
            g.rect(fx * w, fy * h, fx * w + 1.6f, fy * h + 1.6f)
        }
        // piksel pencereler
        pixelWindow(g, b, w * 0.69f + sin(t * 0.2f) * 3f, h * 0.125f, w * 0.27f, t)
        // baloncuklar
        glossBubble(g, b, w * 0.12f + sin(t * 0.3f) * 5f, h * 0.30f, w * 0.07f)
        glossBubble(g, b, w * 0.90f, h * 0.52f + cos(t * 0.27f) * 6f, w * 0.10f)
        glossBubble(g, b, w * 0.72f + sin(t * 0.33f + 1f) * 4f, h * 0.90f, w * 0.055f)
        glossBubble(g, b, w * 0.30f, h * 0.60f + cos(t * 0.21f) * 5f, w * 0.035f)
        // krom kalpler
        chromeHeart(g, b, w * 0.06f + sin(t * 0.19f) * w * 0.015f, h * 0.15f + cos(t * 0.15f) * h * 0.012f, w * 0.14f, -14f + sin(t * 0.1f) * 5f)
        chromeHeart(g, b, w * 0.94f + cos(t * 0.17f) * w * 0.015f, h * 0.96f + sin(t * 0.13f) * h * 0.01f, w * 0.17f, 16f + cos(t * 0.1f) * 5f)
        chromeHeart(g, b, w * 0.80f, h * 0.31f + sin(t * 0.23f) * h * 0.01f, w * 0.06f, 12f)
        // sabit büyük parıltılar
        sparkle(g, w * 0.46f, h * 0.20f, w * 0.040f * (0.8f + 0.2f * sin(t * 1.9f)), 0.95f, 1)
        sparkle(g, w * 0.24f, h * 0.44f, w * 0.028f * (0.8f + 0.2f * sin(t * 2.3f + 1f)), 0.9f, 2)
        sparkle(g, w * 0.66f, h * 0.70f, w * 0.034f * (0.8f + 0.2f * sin(t * 2.1f + 2f)), 0.9f)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ krom

    private val chromeCache = LongCache<Fill>(40)

    private fun chrome(h: Float, vertical: Boolean = true): Fill {
        val k = key(1f, h, if (vertical) 11f else 12f)
        var f = chromeCache[k]
        if (f == null) {
            val c0 = white(0.98f)
            val c1 = Rgb.alpha(silver, 0.92f)
            f = if (vertical) Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, c0, c1, c0, 0.55f) else Fill.linear(0f, 0f, h, h, c0, c1, c0, 0.55f)
            chromeCache[k] = f
        }
        return f
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ kart

    private class CardP(val w: Float, val h: Float, art: Y2kArt) {
        val body = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, art.tint(art.aTop), art.tint(art.aBot))
        val bodyStrong = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, Rgb.alpha(art.theme.skyTop, 0.97f), Rgb.alpha(art.theme.skyMid, 0.97f))
        val holo = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, w, h, Rgb.alpha(art.pop1, 0.95f), Rgb.alpha(art.cyan, 0.95f), Rgb.alpha(art.pop2, 0.95f), 0.5f)
        val gloss = GPath()
        val glossFill: Fill

        init {
            val rr = min(14f, min(w, h) / 2f)
            gloss.arc(rr, rr, rr, rr, 180f, 90f, false)
            gloss.lineTo(w - rr, 0f)
            gloss.arc(w - rr, rr, rr, rr, -90f, 90f, true)
            gloss.lineTo(w, h * 0.38f)
            gloss.quadTo(w * 0.5f, h * 0.52f, 0f, h * 0.38f)
            gloss.close()
            glossFill = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h * 0.5f, art.white(if (art.dark) 0.18f else 0.55f), art.white(0.04f))
        }
    }

    private val cardPs = LongCache<CardP>(80)

    override fun card(
        g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, rad: Float,
        selected: Float, press: Float, strong: Float, shadow: Float,
    ) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        val rr = min(rad, min(w, h) / 2f)
        val k = key(w, h, 13f)
        var p = cardPs[k]
        if (p == null) { p = CardP(w, h, this); cardPs[k] = p }
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        if (shadow > 0f) {
            g.strokeWidth(2.2f)
            val base = (if (dark) 0.20f else 0.12f) * shadow
            for (i in 0 until 5) {
                val f = 1f - i / 5f
                g.paint(Rgb.alpha(if (dark) 0xFF000000.toInt() else 0xFF3B5E8C.toInt(), base * f * f))
                val e = 0.9f + i * 1.9f
                g.strokeRoundRect(-e, -e + 2f, w + e, h + e + 2f, rr + e)
            }
        }
        g.paint(p.body); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr)
        if (strong > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(strong); g.paint(p.bodyStrong); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr); g.restore() }
        if (selected > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(selected); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, 0.16f)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr); g.restore() }
        g.paint(p.glossFill); g.path(p.gloss)
        // kalın krom kenar
        g.strokeWidth(2.4f); g.paint(p.holo); g.strokeRoundRect(1.2f, 1.2f, w - 1.2f, h - 1.2f, max(0f, rr - 1.2f))
        g.strokeWidth(1f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.30f else 0.85f)); g.strokeRoundRect(3f, 3f, w - 3f, h - 3f, max(0f, rr - 3f))
        if (selected > 0f) {
            g.save(); g.alpha(selected)
            g.strokeWidth(2.2f); g.paint(theme.accent); g.strokeRoundRect(1.2f, 1.2f, w - 1.2f, h - 1.2f, max(0f, rr - 1.2f))
            g.restore()
        }
        // köşe parıltıları: sönüp yanar
        if (strong <= 0.5f && w >= 80f && h >= 40f) {
            val n = min(3, 1 + (h / 120f).toInt())
            var s = (w * 5f).toInt() * 31 + (h * 5f).toInt()
            for (i in 0 until n) {
                s = s * 1103515245 + 12345
                val fx = ((s ushr 8) and 0xFFFF) / 65535f
                s = s * 1103515245 + 12345
                val fy = ((s ushr 8) and 0xFFFF) / 65535f
                val tw = 0.5f + 0.5f * sin(clock * 1.8f + i * 2.1f + fx * 6f)
                sparkle(g, w * (0.50f + 0.44f * fx), 6f + min(26f, h * 0.30f) * fy, 2.6f + 2.2f * tw, 0.35f + 0.65f * tw, if (i == 0 && fx > 0.6f) 1 else 0)
            }
        }
        if (press > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(press); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, 0.20f)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, rr); g.restore() }
        g.restore()
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ şeker düğme

    private class CandyP(val w: Float, val h: Float, art: Y2kArt) {
        val body = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h, art.theme.control, art.theme.controlDeep)
        val glow = Fill.radial(w * 0.5f, h * 1.1f, w * 0.55f, Rgb.alpha(art.theme.accentLight, 0.80f), Rgb.alpha(art.theme.accentLight, 0f))
        val holoOver = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, w, h, Rgb.alpha(art.pop1, 0.50f), Rgb.alpha(art.cyan, 0.42f), Rgb.alpha(art.pop2, 0.50f), 0.5f)
        val upper = GPath()
        val upperFill = Fill.linear(0f, 0f, 0f, h * 0.5f, art.white(0.78f), art.white(0.12f))

        init {
            val k = min(w, h) / 2f
            upper.arc(k, k, k, k, 180f, 90f, false)
            upper.lineTo(w - k, 0f)
            upper.arc(w - k, k, k, k, -90f, 90f, true)
            upper.lineTo(w, h * 0.5f)
            upper.quadTo(w * 0.5f, h * 0.60f, 0f, h * 0.5f)
            upper.close()
        }
    }

    private val candyPs = LongCache<CandyP>(40)

    private fun candy(g: Gfx, w: Float, h: Float, press: Float, shadow: Float) {
        val k = key(w, h, 14f)
        var p = candyPs[k]
        if (p == null) { p = CandyP(w, h, this); candyPs[k] = p }
        if (shadow > 0f) {
            g.strokeWidth(2.2f)
            for (i in 0 until 4) {
                val f = 1f - i / 4f
                g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.controlDeep, (if (dark) 0.26f else 0.16f) * shadow * f * f))
                val e = 1.1f + i * 1.9f
                g.strokeRoundRect(-e, -e + 2f, w + e, h + e + 2f, h / 2f + e)
            }
        }
        g.paint(p.body); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        g.paint(p.holoOver); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        g.save(); g.clipRoundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f); g.paint(p.glow); g.rect(0f, h * 0.45f, w, h); g.restore()
        g.paint(p.upperFill); g.path(p.upper)
        g.strokeWidth(1.8f); g.paint(chrome(h)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.9f, 0.9f, w - 0.9f, h - 0.9f, h / 2f - 0.9f)
        if (w > 40f) sparkle(g, w * 0.82f, h * 0.30f, 2.4f + 1.6f * (0.5f + 0.5f * sin(clock * 2.2f + w * 0.07f)), 0.9f)
        if (press > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(press); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, 0.24f)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f); g.restore() }
    }

    override fun pill(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, press: Float, shadow: Float) {
        val w = r - l
        val h = b - t
        if (w <= 1f || h <= 1f) return
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t); candy(g, w, h, press, shadow); g.restore()
    }

    private val knobChrome = Fill.radial(-0.25f, -0.35f, 1.35f, white(1f), Rgb.alpha(silver, 0.95f), white(0.98f), 0.62f)

    private fun chromeKnob(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, press: Float) {
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.shadow, if (dark) 0.40f else 0.26f)); g.circle(cx, cy + 1.6f, r + 0.6f)
        g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.scale(r, r); g.paint(knobChrome); g.circle(0f, 0f, 1f); g.restore()
        g.strokeWidth(1f); g.paint(white(0.95f)); g.strokeCircle(cx, cy, r - 0.5f)
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(cyan, 0.60f)); g.oval(cx - r * 0.5f, cy - r * 0.78f, cx + r * 0.5f, cy - r * 0.2f)
        if (press > 0f) { g.save(); g.alpha(press); g.paint(Rgb.alpha(theme.accent, 0.25f)); g.circle(cx, cy, r); g.restore() }
    }

    override fun switch(g: Gfx, l: Float, t: Float, w: Float, h: Float, on: Float, press: Float) {
        val o = on.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        g.save(); g.translate(l, t)
        g.paint(insetFill(h)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, h, h / 2f)
        if (o > 0.001f) { g.save(); g.alpha(o); candy(g, w, h, 0f, 0f); g.restore() }
        else { g.strokeWidth(1.4f); g.paint(chrome(h)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.7f, 0.7f, w - 0.7f, h - 0.7f, h / 2f - 0.7f) }
        chromeKnob(g, h / 2f + (w - h) * on.coerceIn(-0.12f, 1.12f), h / 2f, h / 2f - 3.2f + press * 0.9f, press)
        g.restore()
    }

    override fun slider(g: Gfx, l: Float, cy: Float, w: Float, v: Float, press: Float) {
        val th = 8f
        val kx = l + 12f + (w - 24f) * v.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        g.save(); g.translate(l, cy - th / 2f)
        g.paint(insetFill(th)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, w, th, th / 2f)
        val fw = (kx - l).coerceAtLeast(th)
        g.paint(onFill(th)); g.roundRect(0f, 0f, fw, th, th / 2f)
        g.paint(white(0.45f)); g.roundRect(1f, 0.8f, max(1.5f, fw - 1f), th * 0.5f, th / 2f - 0.8f)
        g.strokeWidth(1f); g.paint(white(if (dark) 0.35f else 0.85f)); g.strokeRoundRect(0.5f, 0.5f, w - 0.5f, th - 0.5f, th / 2f - 0.5f)
        g.restore()
        chromeKnob(g, kx, cy, 12f + press * 1.5f, press)
    }

    private val ringCache = LongCache<Fill>(6)

    private fun ringFill(r: Float): Fill {
        val k = key(r, r, 15f)
        var f = ringCache[k]
        if (f == null) { f = Fill.linear(-r, -r, r, r, white(1f), Rgb.alpha(silver, 0.95f), white(1f), 0.5f); ringCache[k] = f }
        return f
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ küre: krom halka, ışık taraması, parıltı

    override fun orb(g: Gfx, cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float, level: Float, phase: Float, glow: Float, error: Float, press: Float) {
        super.orb(g, cx, cy, r, level, phase, glow, error, press)
        if (r < 24f) return
        g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy)
        // ışık taraması: her birkaç saniyede bir çapraz bir parlama küreyi geçer
        val sweep = ((clock * 0.22f) % 1.7f) / 1.7f
        if (sweep < 0.62f) {
            val u = sweep / 0.62f
            g.save(); clipOrb(g, r, 2f); g.rotate(24f)
            g.translate(-r * 1.3f + u * r * 2.6f, 0f)
            g.alpha(0.34f * sin(u * PI.toFloat()))
            g.paint(white(1f)); g.rect(-r * 0.10f, -r * 1.5f, r * 0.10f, r * 1.5f)
            g.paint(white(0.45f)); g.rect(-r * 0.26f, -r * 1.5f, -r * 0.10f, r * 1.5f)
            g.restore()
        }
        // krom halka
        g.strokeWidth(3.2f); g.paint(ringFill(r))
        if (orbShape == OrbShape.CIRCLE) g.strokeCircle(0f, 0f, r + 1.2f) else g.strokePath(orbPath(r, 1.2f))
        g.restore()
        sparkle(g, cx + r * decoX(1), cy + r * decoY(1), r * 0.15f * (0.7f + 0.3f * sin(clock * 2.4f)), 0.95f)
        sparkle(g, cx + r * decoX(2), cy + r * decoY(2), r * 0.08f * (0.7f + 0.3f * sin(clock * 3.1f + 1f)), 0.8f)
    }
}

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/Catalog.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

enum class Tag(val id: String) {
    FAST("fast"),
    PRIVACY("privacy"),
    ADS("ads"),
    FAMILY("family"),
    SECURITY("security");

    /** Etkin dildeki adı. */
    val label: String get() = L.tx.tag(this)

    companion object {
        fun byId(id: String?): Tag? = values().firstOrNull { it.id == id }
    }
}

/** Aynı sağlayıcının filtre türü; adın ikinci kısmı olarak etkin dilde gösterilir ("AdGuard Aile"). */
enum class Variant { OPEN, ADS, SECURITY, FAMILY }

/** DNS taşıma yöntemi. [ODOH]: Oblivious DoH (RFC 9230); sunucu seçiminden bağımsız, röle + hedef çifti üzerinden. */
enum class Proto { PLAIN, DOT, DOH, ODOH }

/**
 * Kullanıcının şifreleme tercihi.
 *  - AUTO: önce DoT, olmazsa DoH, ikisi de olmazsa (sunucu izin veriyorsa ve "sıkı şifreleme" kapalıysa) düz DNS.
 *  - DOT / DOH: yalnızca o yöntem; sunucu desteklemiyorsa bağlanılmaz.
 *  - OFF: düz DNS; sunucu yalnızca şifreli çalışıyorsa (özel eklenmiş) DoT/DoH kullanılır.
 */
enum class Encryption(val id: String) {
    AUTO("auto"), DOT("dot"), DOH("doh"), OFF("off");

    /**
     * Bu sunucu için sırayla denenecek yöntemler. Boşsa bu tercihle bağlanılamaz.
     * [strict] açıkken AUTO hiçbir zaman şifresiz DNS'e düşmez.
     */
    fun plan(s: DnsServer, strict: Boolean = false): List<Proto> {
        val enc = ArrayList<Proto>(3)
        if (s.dot != null) enc.add(Proto.DOT)
        if (s.doh != null) enc.add(Proto.DOH)
        return when (this) {
            AUTO -> if (s.plain && !strict) enc + Proto.PLAIN else enc
            DOT -> if (s.dot != null) listOf(Proto.DOT) else emptyList()
            DOH -> if (s.doh != null) listOf(Proto.DOH) else emptyList()
            OFF -> if (s.plain) listOf(Proto.PLAIN) else enc
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Oblivious DoH (ODoH, RFC 9230) tercihi. Varsayılan [OFF].
 *  - FALLBACK: önce ODoH; kurulamazsa şifreleme tercihine göre normal yöntemler (gizlilik düştü uyarısıyla) ve ODoH'a dönmek için
 *    arka planda yeniden deneme.
 *  - STRICT: yalnızca ODoH; kurulamazsa bağlanılmaz (hiçbir koşulda başka yönteme düşülmez).
 * ODoH seçili sunucudan bağımsız çalışır: sorular, uygulamanın kendi röle + hedef çiftlerinden gider ([OdohCatalog]).
 */
enum class OdohMode(val id: String) {
    OFF("off"), FALLBACK("fallback"), STRICT("strict");

    /** [base] normal yöntem listesi olmak üzere bu tercihle denenecek sıra. */
    fun plan(base: List<Proto>): List<Proto> = when (this) {
        OFF -> base
        FALLBACK -> listOf(Proto.ODOH) + base
        STRICT -> listOf(Proto.ODOH)
    }
}

class DnsServer(
    val id: String,
    /** Sağlayıcı (marka) adı: çevrilmez. */
    val brand: String,
    val variant: Variant?,
    val primary: String,
    val secondary: String?,
    val tags: Set<Tag>,
    /** DNS-over-TLS sertifika adı (SNI); yoksa DoT desteklenmez. */
    val dot: String? = null,
    /** İkincil adres başka bir sertifika adı kullanıyorsa (ör. UncensoredDNS unicast). */
    val dot2: String? = null,
    /** DNS-over-HTTPS adresi (https://ad/yol); yoksa DoH desteklenmez. */
    val doh: String? = null,
    /** Düz DNS'e (UDP/53) cevap veriyor mu? Yalnızca şifreli çalışan sunucular (özel eklenenler) için false. */
    val plain: Boolean = true,
    /** Sunucuyu işleten kuruluş (özel ad: çevrilmez); özel sunucularda yok. */
    val owner: String? = null,
    /** Kullanıcının kendi eklediği sunucu mu? */
    val custom: Boolean = false,
    /** Birincil / ikincil adresin IPv6 karşılıkları (katalogda); özel sunucularda adresler [primary]/[secondary] içinde olabilir. */
    val primary6: String? = null,
    val secondary6: String? = null,
) {
    /** Düz DNS'in IPv4 ve IPv6 adresleri (özel sunucularda girilen sırayla); [addresses4] ve [addresses6] bunun ailelere göre ayrımıdır. */
    val addresses: List<String> get() = listOfNotNull(primary, secondary)

    /** Tüm IPv4 adresleri: birincil önce. */
    val addresses4: List<String> get() = listOfNotNull(primary, secondary).filter { Ip.isV4(it) }

    /** Tüm IPv6 adresleri: birincil önce (özel sunucuda IPv6 girilmişse o da buradadır). */
    val addresses6: List<String> get() = (listOfNotNull(primary, secondary).filter { Ip.isV6(it) } + listOfNotNull(primary6, secondary6)).distinct()

    /** Görünen ad: marka + (varsa) etkin dilde filtre türü. */
    val name: String get() = if (variant == null) brand else brand + " " + L.tx.variant(variant)

    /** Etkin dildeki kısa açıklama. */
    val note: String get() = if (custom) L.tx.CUSTOM_NOTE else L.tx.note(id)

    val encrypted: Boolean get() = dot != null || doh != null

    /** [index]. adres (0 birincil, 1 ikincil) için TLS sertifika adı. */
    fun tlsHost(proto: Proto, index: Int): String? = when (proto) {
        Proto.DOT -> if (index == 1 && dot2 != null) dot2 else dot
        Proto.DOH -> doh?.let { DohUrl.host(it) }
        Proto.PLAIN, Proto.ODOH -> null
    }
}

/** "https://ad/yol" -> ad ve yol. */
object DohUrl {
    fun host(url: String): String = url.removePrefix("https://").substringBefore('/').substringBefore(':')
    fun path(url: String): String = "/" + url.removePrefix("https://").substringAfter('/', "")
}

/**
 * Uygulamanın bilinen, herkese açık DNS sunucuları. Her sunucu tek satırdır:
 * `tools/catalog_check.py` bu satırları okuyup gerçek sunuculara (düz ve DoT) sorgu atarak adresleri doğrular.
 * Kaynaklar (Ekim 2026): sağlayıcıların kendi sayfaları ve AdGuard'ın DNS sağlayıcıları listesi (bkz. OKUBENI.md).
 */
object Catalog {
    const val DEFAULT_ID = "cloudflare"

    /** Sağlayıcı (marka) -> işleten kuruluş. Özel adlardır, çevrilmez; ülke ISO koduyla. */
    private val OWNERS = mapOf(
        "Cloudflare" to "Cloudflare, Inc. (US)",
        "Google" to "Google LLC (US)",
        "Quad9" to "Quad9 Foundation (CH)",
        "AdGuard" to "AdGuard Software Ltd (CY)",
        "Control D" to "Control D Inc. (CA)",
        "OpenDNS" to "Cisco Systems (US)",
        "DNS.SB" to "DNS.SB",
        "DNS4EU" to "Whalebone + EU consortium (EU)",
        "UncensoredDNS" to "censurfridns.dk (DK)",
        "CleanBrowsing" to "CleanBrowsing (US)",
        "NextDNS" to "NextDNS, Inc. (US)",
        "CIRA Shield" to "CIRA (CA)",
        "LibreDNS" to "LibreDNS (GR)",
        "SWITCH" to "SWITCH Foundation (CH)",
        "Wikimedia" to "Wikimedia Foundation (US)",
        "Digitale Gesellschaft" to "Digitale Gesellschaft (CH)",
        "Quad101" to "TWNIC (TW)",
        "AliDNS" to "Alibaba Cloud (CN)",
    )

    private fun s(
        id: String, brand: String, variant: Variant?, primary: String, secondary: String?, tags: Set<Tag>,
        dot: String? = null, doh: String? = null, dot2: String? = null, plain: Boolean = true,
    ) = DnsServer(id, brand, variant, primary, secondary, tags, dot, dot2, doh, plain, OWNERS[brand], false, V6[id]?.first, V6[id]?.second)

    /**
     * Sunucuların IPv6 adresleri (birincil, ikincil): sağlayıcıların kendi sayfalarından (Ekim 2026). Çift yığınlı ağda
     * şifreli bağlantı önce IPv6'dan denenir, olmazsa IPv4'e geçilir; adres yanlışsa sertifika denetimi bağlantıyı reddeder.
     */
    private val V6: Map<String, Pair<String, String?>> = mapOf(
        "cloudflare" to ("2606:4700:4700::1111" to "2606:4700:4700::1001"),
        "cloudflare-security" to ("2606:4700:4700::1112" to "2606:4700:4700::1002"),
        "cloudflare-family" to ("2606:4700:4700::1113" to "2606:4700:4700::1003"),
        "google" to ("2001:4860:4860::8888" to "2001:4860:4860::8844"),
        "quad9" to ("2620:fe::fe" to "2620:fe::9"),
        "quad9-open" to ("2620:fe::10" to "2620:fe::fe:10"),
        "adguard" to ("2a10:50c0::ad1:ff" to "2a10:50c0::ad2:ff"),
        "adguard-open" to ("2a10:50c0::1:ff" to "2a10:50c0::2:ff"),
        "adguard-family" to ("2a10:50c0::bad1:ff" to "2a10:50c0::bad2:ff"),
        "controld" to ("2606:1a40::" to "2606:1a40:1::"),
        "controld-malware" to ("2606:1a40::1" to "2606:1a40:1::1"),
        "controld-ads" to ("2606:1a40::2" to "2606:1a40:1::2"),
        "controld-family" to ("2606:1a40::4" to "2606:1a40:1::4"),
        "opendns" to ("2620:119:35::35" to "2620:119:53::53"),
        "dnssb" to ("2a09::" to "2a11::"),
        "dns4eu" to ("2a13:1001::86:54:11:1" to "2a13:1001::86:54:11:201"),

        s("quad101", "Quad101", null, "101.101.101.101", "101.102.103.104", setOf(Tag.FAST), "dns.twnic.tw", "https://dns.twnic.tw/dns-query"),
        s("alidns", "AliDNS", null, "223.5.5.5", "223.6.6.6", setOf(Tag.FAST), "dns.alidns.com", "https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query"),
    )

    @Volatile private var customList: List<DnsServer> = emptyList()

    /** Hazır + kullanıcının eklediği sunucular (önbelleklenir; [setCustom] ile yenilenir). */
    @Volatile var all: List<DnsServer> = builtin
        private set

    val custom: List<DnsServer> get() = customList

    /** Kullanıcının eklediği sunucuları yükler; ayarlar okunurken ([SettingsCodec.decode]) ve eklenip silinirken çağrılır. */
    fun setCustom(list: List<DnsServer>) {
        customList = list
        all = if (list.isEmpty()) builtin else builtin + list
    }

    val default: DnsServer get() = byId(DEFAULT_ID)!!

    fun byId(id: String?): DnsServer? = if (id == null) null else all.firstOrNull { it.id == id }

    /** "a.b.c.d" biçiminde, her parçası 0..255 olan geçerli bir IPv4 adresi mi? */
    fun isIpv4(s: String): Boolean {
        val parts = s.split('.')
        if (parts.size != 4) return false
        return parts.all { p -> p.isNotEmpty() && p.length <= 3 && p.all { it in '0'..'9' } && (p.length == 1 || p[0] != '0') && p.toInt() in 0..255 }   // "01" gibi öndeki sıfırlar (sekizlik belirsizliği) kabul edilmez
    }

    /** Geçerli bir IPv4 ya da IPv6 adresi mi? (Ad çözümlemesi yapmaz.) */
    fun isIp(s: String): Boolean = isIpv4(s) || Ip.isV6(s)
}

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/CnameGuard.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

/**
 * Gizli izleyici (CNAME) engeli. Sitenin kendi alt alan adı (ör. "metrik.site.com") bir izleyici sunucusuna CNAME ile
 * yönlendirilebilir; yalnızca SORULAN adı denetleyen süzgeçler bunu göremez. Burada üst DNS'ten gelen CEVAP incelenir: zincir
 * engelli bir adda bitiyorsa cevap, engelleme cevabı ("boş adres") ile DEĞİŞTİRİLİR ve önbelleğe öyle girer.
 *
 * Güvenlik ve sağlamlık: yalnızca başarılı (NOERROR), tek sorulu cevaplara dokunur; bozuk, kesik ya da çok uzun zincirli
 * cevaplar olduğu gibi bırakılır (süzgeç hiçbir zaman bağlantıyı bozmaz). Kullanıcı izin listesi her zaman üstündür.
 * Aynı yerde DNS yeniden bağlama koruması da uygulanır ([FilterEngine.rebindVerdict]): genel bir ad yerel ağ adresine
 * çözülürse cevap engelleme cevabıyla değiştirilir.
 * Cevap alıcı iş parçacıkları paralel çalışır; her iş parçacığı motorun KENDİ kopyasını ([FilterEngine.fork]) kullanır.
 */
internal object CnameGuard {
    private class Slot(var source: FilterEngine?, var mine: FilterEngine?)
    private val local = ThreadLocal<Slot>()

    /** Engellenen gizli izleyici sayısı (test ve istatistik için). */
    private val blockedCount = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong()
    val blocked: Long get() = blockedCount.get()

    /** Yeniden bağlama koruması nedeniyle engellenen cevap sayısı. */
    private val rebindCount = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong()
    val rebindBlocked: Long get() = rebindCount.get()

    /**
     * [b] içinde [base] konumundan başlayan [n] baytlık DNS cevabını denetler. Engellenmeliyse cevabı yerinde engelleme
     * cevabına çevirir ve yeni uzunluğu; aksi halde [n]'i döner. (Uzunluk her zaman >0.)
     */
    fun guard(b: ByteArray, base: Int, n: Int): Int {
        val src = FilterRuntime.engine ?: return n
        val rebind = FilterRuntime.rebind
        if (!src.active && !rebind) return n
        var s = local.get()
        if (s == null) { s = Slot(null, null); local.set(s) }
        var e = s.mine
        if (e == null || s.source !== src) { e = src.fork(); s.source = src; s.mine = e }
        var v = if (src.active) e.cnameVerdict(b, base, n) else FilterVerdict.PASS
        if (v == FilterVerdict.PASS && rebind && e.rebindVerdict(b, base, n)) { rebindCount.incrementAndGet(); v = FilterVerdict.LIST }
        if (v == FilterVerdict.PASS) return n
        val qEnd = Dns.questionEnd(b, base, n)
        if (qEnd <= base) return n
        val id = Packets.u16(b, base)
        var out = FilterEngine.buildBlocked(b, base, qEnd, b, base)
        if (out <= 0) { out = FilterEngine.buildRefused(b, base, b, base); if (out > 0) Packets.put16(b, base, id) }   // cevap kurulamazsa gizli izleyici yine geçmez
        if (out <= 0 || base + out > b.size) return n
        blockedCount.incrementAndGet()
        FilterLive.note(queryName(b, base, qEnd), v == FilterVerdict.USER)
        return out
    }

    /** Sorulan ad (yalnızca engellenen cevaplar için; ayırma yapar). */
    internal fun queryName(b: ByteArray, base: Int, qEnd: Int): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        var i = base + Packets.DNS_HDR
        while (i < qEnd) {
            val l = b[i].toInt() and 0xFF
            if (l == 0 || (l and 0xC0) != 0 || i + 1 + l > qEnd) break
            if (sb.isNotEmpty()) sb.append('.')
            for (k in 1..l) sb.append((b[i + k].toInt() and 0xFF).toChar().lowercaseChar())
            i += 1 + l
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }
}

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/CrashLog.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

/**
 * Yerel çökme günlüğü. Kayıtlar yalnızca cihazda kalır; hiçbir yere gönderilmez ve tanılama raporunda kullanıcı tarafından görülür.
 *
 * Gizlilik: hata MESAJI kaydedilmez (sunucu adı, IP ya da kullanıcı verisi içerebilir). Yalnızca hata türü, zaman, iş parçacığı
 * adı ve uygulamanın kendi kodundaki en fazla [FRAMES] satır tutulur. Kayıt tek satırdır; uzun metinler kırpılır.
 */
object CrashLog {
    /** Tutulan en fazla kayıt sayısı; en yeni başta. */
    const val KEEP = 5
    /** Tek bir kaydın en fazla karakter sayısı. */
    const val MAX_LINE = 240
    /** Bir kayıtta yer alan uygulama satırı sayısı. */
    const val FRAMES = 3
    private const val PACKAGE = "app.dnshizli"

    /**
     * Bir istisnayı tek satırlık kayda çevirir. [timeText] biçimlendirilmiş zamandır (çağıran verir; test için deterministik).
     * Örnek: "2026-10-08 20:30 IllegalStateException @ Model:412 < Widgets:88 (main)".
     */
    fun summarize(type: String, frames: List<StackFrame>, thread: String, timeText: String): String {
        val app = frames.filter { it.className.startsWith(PACKAGE) }.take(FRAMES)
            .joinToString(" < ") { it.className.substringAfterLast('.') + ":" + it.line }
        val where = app.ifEmpty { "?" }
        return clean("$timeText ${type.substringAfterLast('.')} @ $where ($thread)")
    }

    /** Yeni kaydı başa ekler, en fazla [KEEP] kayıt tutar. [raw] önceki kayıtların kayıtlı biçimi. */
    fun append(raw: String?, entry: String): String {
        val list = (listOf(clean(entry)) + entries(raw)).take(KEEP)
        return list.joinToString("\n")
    }

    /** Kayıtlı biçimi listeye çevirir (en yeni başta). Boş satırlar atılır. */
    fun entries(raw: String?): List<String> =
        raw?.split('\n')?.map { clean(it) }?.filter { it.isNotBlank() }?.take(KEEP) ?: emptyList()

    /** Satır sonlarını ve denetim karakterlerini temizler, uzunluğu sınırlar. */
    private fun clean(s: String): String {
        val one = s.map { if (it.isISOControl()) ' ' else it }.joinToString("").trim()
        return if (one.length > MAX_LINE) one.take(MAX_LINE - 1) + "…" else one
    }
}

/** Yığın satırının sadeleştirilmiş hali (test edilebilir olsun diye Java'dan bağımsız). */
data class StackFrame(val className: String, val line: Int)

// ===== app/src/main/java/app/dnshizli/core/CustomDns.kt =====
package app.dnshizli.core

/**
 * Kullanıcının kendi eklediği DNS sunucuları. Adresler IPv4 ya da IPv6 olabilir; şifreli bağlantı için isteğe bağlı
 * DoT sertifika adı ve DoH adresi girilebilir. Girdiler hem eklerken hem diskten okurken aynı kurallarla
 * doğrulanır: bozuk ya da elle değiştirilmiş bir kayıt sessizce atlanır, uygulamayı bozmaz.
 * Özel sunucular dışa aktarılan koda GİRMEZ (paylaşılan bir kod DNS'ini başkasına yönlendirmesin).
 */
object CustomDns {
    const val MAX = 8
    const val NAME_MAX = 24
    private const val URL_MAX = 200

    /** Kullanıcının doldurduğu alanlar (boşlar ""). */
    class Draft(val name: String, val ip1: String, val ip2: String, val dot: String, val doh: String)

    enum class Error { NAME, IP, IP2, DOT, DOH, LIMIT }

    private val HOST = Regex("^[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?(\\.[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?)+$")
    private val PATH = Regex("^[A-Za-z0-9._~/%=-]*$")
    private val ID = Regex("^u[0-9a-z]{1,10}$")

    fun cleanName(s: String): String = s.trim().replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")

    fun validName(s: String): Boolean =
        s.length in 1..NAME_MAX && s.none { it.isISOControl() || it in "|;,=" }

    /**
     * IPv4 ya da IPv6 adresi. Geri döngü, "bu ağ", çok noktaya yayın ve bu uygulamanın tünel adresleri geçersizdir.
     * IPv6'da yalnızca herkese açık (2000::/3) ve yerel (fc00::/7) adresler kabul edilir (bağlantı-yerel adresler bölge
     * numarası ister; IPv4'e eşlenmiş adresler anlamsızdır).
     */
    fun validIp(s: String): Boolean {
        val v4 = Ip.parse4(s)
        if (v4 != null) {
            val p = IntArray(4) { v4[it].toInt() and 0xFF }
            if (p[0] == 0 || p[0] == 127 || p[0] >= 224) return false
            if (p[0] == 10 && p[1] == 111 && p[2] == 222) return false
            return Catalog.isIpv4(s)                                   // öndeki sıfırlar ("01.2.3.4") kabul edilmez
        }
        val v6 = Ip.parse6(s) ?: return false
        val b0 = v6[0].toInt() and 0xFF
        if ((b0 and 0xE0) != 0x20 && (b0 and 0xFE) != 0xFC) return false   // 2000::/3 ya da fc00::/7
        if (Ip.sameNet(v6, SelfTest.CLIENT6, 6)) return false                // bu uygulamanın tünel adresleri
        return true
    }

    fun validDot(s: String): Boolean = s.length <= 253 && HOST.matches(s) && !Ip.isAddress(s)

    fun validDoh(s: String): Boolean {
        if (s.length > URL_MAX || !s.startsWith("https://")) return false
        val rest = s.removePrefix("https://")
        val host = rest.substringBefore('/')
        val path = if (rest.contains('/')) rest.substring(rest.indexOf('/')) else ""
        return HOST.matches(host) && !Ip.isAddress(host) && PATH.matches(path)
    }

    /** Aynı adres mi? (IPv6 farklı yazılabilir: "2606:4700::1" = "2606:4700:0:0:0:0:0:1".) */
    private fun sameIp(a: String, b: String): Boolean {
        val x = Ip.parse(a)
        val y = Ip.parse(b)
        return if (x != null && y != null) x.contentEquals(y) else a == b
    }

    /** İlk hata ya da null (geçerli). [existing]: şimdiki özel sunucu sayısı. */
    fun validate(d: Draft, existing: Int = 0): Error? {
        if (existing >= MAX) return Error.LIMIT
        if (!validName(cleanName(d.name))) return Error.NAME
        if (!validIp(d.ip1.trim())) return Error.IP
        val ip2 = d.ip2.trim()
        if (ip2.isNotEmpty() && (!validIp(ip2) || sameIp(ip2, d.ip1.trim()))) return Error.IP2
        val dot = d.dot.trim()
        if (dot.isNotEmpty() && !validDot(dot)) return Error.DOT
        val doh = d.doh.trim()
        if (doh.isNotEmpty() && !validDoh(doh)) return Error.DOH
        return null
    }

    fun build(id: String, d: Draft): DnsServer = DnsServer(
        id = id, brand = cleanName(d.name), variant = null,
