    init {
        col.add(SettingsCard().also { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.HELP_WHY_TITLE, null, Icon.HEART) {
                nav.openInfo(Strings.HELP_WHY_TITLE, listOf(Strings.HELP_WHY_BODY, Strings.HELP_WHY_TAIL))
            })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.HELP, null, Icon.INFO) { nav.openHelp() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.WHATS_NEW, null, Icon.STAR) { nav.openWhatsNew() })
        })
        col.add(SettingsCard().also { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.LOG, null, Icon.LOG) { nav.openLog() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.VPN_SETTINGS, null, Icon.SHIELD) { model.host.openVpnSettings() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.FEEDBACK, null, Icon.COPY) { model.host.shareText(model.host.diagnostics()) })
        })
        col.add(SettingsCard().also { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.SHARE_APP, null, Icon.HEART) { model.host.shareApp() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.RATE_APP, null, Icon.STAR) { model.host.rateApp() })
            c.add(InfoRow(Strings.VERSION) { model.host.versionName() })
        })
        finish()
    }
}

// =============================================================================== kişiselleştirme

/** Kişiselleştirme penceresi: dil, tema, stil, arka plan, simge ve erişilebilirlik/güç seçenekleri. */
class PersonalizePage(private val model: AppModel, nav: Nav) : ScrollPage(Strings.PERSONALIZE, true, nav) {
    private var seenVersion = -1

    // Satırların değeri ayar değişince değişir; başlıkla sığmayan değer alta iner, bu yüzden yerleşim yenilenir.
    override fun tick(dt: Float, env: Env): Boolean {
        if (seenVersion != model.version) { seenVersion = model.version; relayoutContent(env) }
        return super.tick(dt, env)
    }

    init {
        col.add(SectionTitle(Strings.SEC_LOOK))
        col.add(SettingsCard().also { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.LANGUAGE, { langName(it.lang) }, Icon.GLOBE) { openLanguage(nav) })
            c.add(SwatchRow())
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.STYLE, { it.style.label }) { openStyle(nav) })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.CUSTOM_STYLE, null, Icon.STAR) { nav.openCustomStyle() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.ORB_SHAPE, { Strings.orbShapeName(OrbShapes.get(it.orbShapes, model.shownThemeId)) }) { openOrbShape(nav, model.shownThemeId) })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.ORB_SHAPE_EACH, null) { openOrbShapeThemes(nav) })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.ORB_FLOW, { Strings.orbFlowName(it.orbFlow) }) { openOrbFlow(nav) })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.LIQUID_COLOR, { if (it.liquidColor.isEmpty()) Strings.LIQUID_THEME else "#" + it.liquidColor }) { nav.openLiquidColor() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.APP_ICON, { model.settings.appIcon.label }) { openAppIcon(nav) })
        })

        col.add(SectionTitle(Strings.PZ_BACKGROUND))
        col.add(SettingsCard().also { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.WALLPAPER, { if (it.wallpaper) Strings.WP_ON else Strings.WP_OFF }) { openWallpaper(nav) })
            c.add(SliderRow(Strings.WP_DIM, { it.wpDim / WallpaperMath.DIM_MAX }, { s, v -> s.copy(wpDim = v * WallpaperMath.DIM_MAX) }, { Strings.percent((it.wpDim * 100).roundToInt()) }))
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.WP_BLUR, Strings.OPT_WP_BLUR, { it.wpBlur.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(wpBlur = WpBlur.values()[i]) }))
        })

        col.add(SectionTitle(Strings.PZ_AUTO))
        col.add(SettingsCard().also { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.AUTO_LIGHT, { themeName(it.autoLight) }) { openAutoTheme(nav, dark = false) })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.AUTO_DARK, { themeName(it.autoDark) }) { openAutoTheme(nav, dark = true) })
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.THEME_SCHEDULE, Strings.THEME_SCHEDULE_NOTE, { it.themeSchedule }, { s, v -> s.copy(themeSchedule = v) }))
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.NIGHT_HOURS, NightHours.values().map { it.label }, { it.nightHours.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(nightHours = NightHours.values()[i]) }))
        })

        col.add(SectionTitle(Strings.PZ_FEEL))
        col.add(SettingsCard().also { c ->
            c.add(SliderRow(Strings.GLASS, { it.glass }, { s, v -> s.copy(glass = v) }, { Strings.percent((it.glass * 100).roundToInt()) }))
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.TEXT_SIZE, Strings.OPT_TEXT, { it.textScale.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(textScale = TextScale.values()[i]) }))
            // Sıra: Yok · Az · Tam (her dilde). Kabarcıklar ayrı satır değil; miktarı bu seviyeden gelir.
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.MOTION, MOTION_ORDER.map { Strings.OPT_MOTION[MOTION_LABEL_INDEX.getValue(it)] },
                { MOTION_ORDER.indexOf(it.motion) }, { s, i -> s.copy(motion = MOTION_ORDER[i]) }))
        })

        col.add(SectionTitle(Strings.PZ_ACCESS))
        col.add(SettingsCard().also { c ->
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.HIGH_CONTRAST, Strings.HIGH_CONTRAST_NOTE, { it.highContrast }, { s, v -> s.copy(highContrast = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.MINIMAL, Strings.MINIMAL_NOTE, { it.minimal }, { s, v -> s.copy(minimal = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.LOW_POWER, Strings.LOW_POWER_NOTE, { it.lowPower }, { s, v -> s.copy(lowPower = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.HAPTICS, Strings.HAPTICS_NOTE, { it.haptics }, { s, v -> s.copy(haptics = v) }))
        })
        finish()
    }

    private companion object {
        /** Ekranda gösterim sırası: Yok, Az, Tam. */
        val MOTION_ORDER = listOf(Motion.OFF, Motion.REDUCED, Motion.FULL)
        /** OPT_MOTION etiketleri enum sırasına göre (0 Tam, 1 Az, 2 Yok): her Motion için etiket dizini. */
        val MOTION_LABEL_INDEX = mapOf(Motion.FULL to 0, Motion.REDUCED to 1, Motion.OFF to 2)
    }

    private fun themeName(id: String): String = if (id == Themes.DYNAMIC_ID) Strings.themeName(id) else (Themes.byId(id)?.name ?: id)

    /** Satırdaki kısa değer: "Otomatik" ya da dilin kendi adı. */
    private fun langName(setting: String): String = if (setting == L.AUTO) Strings.THEME_AUTO else (Lang.byCode(setting)?.native ?: Strings.THEME_AUTO)

    private fun openLanguage(nav: Nav) {
        val cur = model.settings.lang
        val opts = ArrayList<Option>()
        opts.add(Option(L.AUTO, Strings.LANG_AUTO, L.lang.native, cur == L.AUTO))
        for (l in Lang.values()) opts.add(Option(l.code, l.native, "", cur == l.code))
        nav.openOptions(Strings.LANGUAGE, opts) { id -> if (id != null) model.setLanguage(id) }
    }

    /** "Otomatik" temanın açık ya da koyu modda kullanacağı tema; duvar kağıdı teması varsa o da seçilebilir. */
    private fun openAutoTheme(nav: Nav, dark: Boolean) {
        val cur = if (dark) model.settings.autoDark else model.settings.autoLight
        val opts = ArrayList<Option>()
        if (model.accentSeed != null) opts.add(Option(Themes.DYNAMIC_ID, Strings.themeName(Themes.DYNAMIC_ID), "", cur == Themes.DYNAMIC_ID))
        for (t in Themes.all.filter { it.dark == dark }) opts.add(Option(t.id, t.name, "", cur == t.id))
        nav.openOptions(if (dark) Strings.AUTO_DARK else Strings.AUTO_LIGHT, opts) { id ->
            if (id != null) model.update { if (dark) it.copy(autoDark = id) else it.copy(autoLight = id) }
        }
    }

    private fun openStyle(nav: Nav) {
        val cur = model.settings.style
        val opts = UiStyle.values().mapIndexed { i, st -> Option(st.id, st.label, Strings.STYLE_NOTES[i], cur == st) }
        nav.openOptions(Strings.STYLE, opts) { id -> UiStyle.byId(id)?.let { st -> model.update { it.copy(style = st) } } }
    }

    /** [themeId] teması için ana düğme şeklini seçtirir (küre, üçgen, kare, altıgen, yıldız). */
    private fun openOrbFlow(nav: Nav) {
        val cur = model.settings.orbFlow
        val opts = OrbFlow.values().map { Option(it.id, Strings.orbFlowName(it), "", it == cur) }
        nav.openOptions(Strings.ORB_FLOW, opts) { id -> OrbFlow.byId(id)?.let { model.setOrbFlow(it) } }
    }

    private fun openOrbShape(nav: Nav, themeId: String) {
        val cur = model.orbShapeFor(themeId)
        val opts = OrbShape.values().map { Option(it.id, Strings.orbShapeName(it), "", it == cur) }
        nav.openOptions(Strings.ORB_SHAPE + ": " + Strings.themeName(themeId), opts) { id -> OrbShape.byId(id)?.let { model.setOrbShape(themeId, it) } }
    }

    /** Tema başına şekil: 12 temanın her biri ayrı listelenir, seçilen temanın şekil penceresi açılır. */
    private fun openOrbShapeThemes(nav: Nav) {
        val opts = Themes.all.map { t -> Option(t.id, Strings.themeName(t.id), Strings.orbShapeName(model.orbShapeFor(t.id)), t.id == model.shownThemeId) }
        nav.openOptions(Strings.ORB_SHAPE_EACH, opts) { id -> if (id != null) openOrbShape(nav, id) }
    }

    private fun openAppIcon(nav: Nav) {
        val cur = model.settings.appIcon
        val opts = UiStyle.values().mapIndexed { i, st -> Option(st.id, st.label, Strings.ICON_NOTES[i], cur == st) }
        nav.openOptions(Strings.APP_ICON, opts, footer = Strings.ICON_NOTE) { id -> UiStyle.byId(id)?.let { model.setAppIcon(it) } }
    }

    private fun openWallpaper(nav: Nav) {
        val opts = ArrayList<Option>()
        opts.add(Option("pick", Strings.WP_PICK, Strings.WP_PICK_NOTE))
        opts.add(Option("presets", Strings.WP_PRESETS, Strings.WP_PRESETS_NOTE))
        if (model.settings.wallpaper) opts.add(Option("remove", Strings.WP_REMOVE))
        nav.openOptions(Strings.WALLPAPER, opts) { id ->
            when (id) {
                "pick" -> model.pickWallpaper()
                "remove" -> model.removeWallpaper()
                "presets" -> openPresets(nav)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun openPresets(nav: Nav) {
        val opts = WallpaperPresets.NAMES.mapIndexed { i, n -> Option("p$i", n) }
        nav.openOptions(Strings.WP_PRESETS, opts) { id ->
            val i = id?.removePrefix("p")?.toIntOrNull()
            if (i != null && i in WallpaperPresets.NAMES.indices) model.usePresetWallpaper(i)
        }
    }
}

// =============================================================================== ayar pencereleri

/** Ayar pencereleri: ☰ menüsündeki her satır birini açar. */
enum class Section { DNS, FILTER, CONNECTION, NOTIFICATIONS, LIST, STATS, DATA, SOUND }

private fun sectionTitle(s: Section): String = when (s) {
    Section.DNS -> Strings.DNS_SETTINGS
    Section.FILTER -> Strings.FILTER
    Section.CONNECTION -> Strings.CONN_APPS
    Section.NOTIFICATIONS -> Strings.SEC_NOTIF
    Section.LIST -> Strings.SEC_LIST
    Section.STATS -> Strings.STATS_HISTORY
    Section.DATA -> Strings.SEC_DATA
    Section.SOUND -> Strings.SOUND_MOTION
}

class SectionPage(private val model: AppModel, nav: Nav, val section: Section) : ScrollPage(sectionTitle(section), true, nav) {
    private var seenVersion = -1

    // Satırların değeri ayar değişince değişir; başlıkla sığmayan değer alta iner, bu yüzden yerleşim yenilenir.
    override fun tick(dt: Float, env: Env): Boolean {
        if (seenVersion != model.version) { seenVersion = model.version; relayoutContent(env) }
        return super.tick(dt, env)
    }

    init {
        when (section) {
            Section.DNS -> buildDns(nav)
            Section.FILTER -> buildFilter(nav)
            Section.CONNECTION -> buildConnection(nav)
            Section.NOTIFICATIONS -> buildNotifications()
            Section.LIST -> buildList(nav)
            Section.STATS -> buildStats(nav)
            Section.DATA -> buildData()
            Section.SOUND -> buildSound()
        }
        finish()
    }

    private fun card(build: (SettingsCard) -> Unit) { col.add(SettingsCard().also(build)) }

    private fun buildDns(nav: Nav) {
        card { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.PROFILES, null, Icon.SHIELD) { openProfiles(nav) })
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.REMEMBER_MODS, Strings.REMEMBER_MODS_NOTE, { it.rememberModules }, { s, v -> s.copy(rememberModules = v) }))
        }
        card { c ->
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.ENCRYPTION, Strings.OPT_ENCRYPTION, { it.encryption.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(encryption = Encryption.values()[i]) }, Strings.ENCRYPTION_NOTE))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.STRICT_ENC, Strings.STRICT_ENC_NOTE, { it.strictEncryption }, { s, v -> s.copy(strictEncryption = v) }))
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.ODOH, Strings.OPT_ODOH, { it.odoh.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(odoh = OdohMode.values()[i]) }, Strings.ODOH_NOTE))
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.IP_MODE, Strings.OPT_IP_MODE, { it.ipMode.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(ipMode = IpMode.values()[i]) }, Strings.IP_MODE_NOTE))
        }
        card { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.BACKUP_SERVER, { backupName(it.backupServer) }) { openBackup(nav) })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.RULE_WIFI, { ruleName(it.wifiServer) }) {
                nav.openChoice(Strings.RULE_WIFI, model.settings.wifiServer) { id -> model.update { it.copy(wifiServer = id) } }
            })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.RULE_MOBILE, { ruleName(it.mobileServer) }) {
                nav.openChoice(Strings.RULE_MOBILE, model.settings.mobileServer) { id -> model.update { it.copy(mobileServer = id) } }
            })
        }
        card { c ->
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.CACHE, Strings.OPT_CACHE, { it.cache.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(cache = CacheLevel.values()[i]) }))
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.CLEAR_CACHE, null, Icon.REFRESH) { model.clearCache() })
        }
        card { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.TEST, { if (model.testing) Strings.TESTING else "" }, Icon.CHECK) { nav.openTest() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.TROUBLE, null, Icon.INFO) { openTrouble(nav) })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.DIAG_ROW, null, Icon.INFO) { openDiag(nav) })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.SITE_DIAG, null, Icon.INFO) { openSiteDiag(nav) })
        }
    }

    private fun buildFilter(nav: Nav) {
        card { c ->
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.FILTER_LEVEL, Strings.OPT_FILTER, { it.filterLevel.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(filterLevel = FilterLevel.values()[i]) },
                noteFn = { Strings.FILTER_NOTES[it.filterLevel.ordinal] }))
            c.add(InfoRow(Strings.STAT_BLOCKED) { Format.count(FilterLive.blockedTotal) })
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.REBIND, Strings.REBIND_NOTE, { it.rebindGuard }, { s, v -> s.copy(rebindGuard = v) }))
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.FILTER_MEM, Strings.OPT_FILTER_MEM, { it.filterMem.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(filterMem = FilterMem.values()[i]) }, noteFn = { Strings.FILTER_MEM_NOTE }))
        }
        card { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.FILTER_LAST, { FilterLive.recent().size.let { n -> if (n == 0) "" else n.toString() } }, Icon.LOG) { openRecentBlocked(nav) })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.FILTER_PASSED, { FilterLive.recentPassed().size.let { n -> if (n == 0) "" else n.toString() } }, Icon.LOG) { openRecentPassed(nav) })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.FILTER_ALLOW, { if (it.filterAllow.isEmpty()) "" else it.filterAllow.size.toString() }, Icon.CHECK) { openFilterList(nav, true) })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.FILTER_BLOCK, { if (it.filterBlock.isEmpty()) "" else it.filterBlock.size.toString() }, Icon.BLOCK) { openFilterList(nav, false) })
            if (model.host.personalBuild()) c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.YT_ADS, Strings.YT_ADS_NOTE, { it.youtubeAds }, { s, v -> s.copy(youtubeAds = v) }))
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.FILTER_MINE, { if (model.importedCount == 0) "" else Format.count(model.importedCount.toLong()) }, Icon.COPY) { openMine(nav) })
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.DOH_GUARD, Strings.DOH_GUARD_NOTE, { it.dohGuard }, { s, v -> s.copy(dohGuard = v) }))
        }
        col.add(ParagraphCard(Strings.FILTER_INFO))
    }

    /** Bu oturumda engellenenler: dokununca izin listesine eklenir ("site bozuldu" çaresi). */
    private fun openRecentBlocked(nav: Nav) {
        val opts = FilterLive.recent().map { Option(it.name, it.name, if (it.user) Strings.FILTER_BLOCK else Strings.FILTER_RECENT_NOTE) }
        nav.openOptions(Strings.FILTER_LAST, opts, Strings.FILTER_RECENT_EMPTY, Strings.FILTER_RECENT_FOOT) { id -> if (id != null) model.addFilterName(true, id) }
    }

    /**
     * Bu oturumda süzgeçten geçen adlar: reklam hâlâ görünüyorsa kaçan sunucuyu bulup tek dokunuşla engellemek için.
     * Dokununca ad kendi engel listesine girer ve bu listeden çıkar.
     */
    private fun openRecentPassed(nav: Nav) {
        // Reklama benzeyen adlar ([AdSuspect]) başa alınır ve işaretlenir; birden çoksa hepsini tek seferde engelleme seçeneği çıkar.
        val all = FilterLive.recentPassed()
        val suspects = all.filter { AdSuspect.isSuspect(it.name) }.map { it.name }
        val opts = ArrayList<Option>()
        if (suspects.size > 1) opts.add(Option(BLOCK_SUSPECTS, Strings.FILTER_BLOCK_SUSPECTS, Strings.mineCount(suspects.size)))
        for (n in suspects) opts.add(Option(n, n, Strings.FILTER_SUSPECT_NOTE))
        for (it in all) if (it.name !in suspects) opts.add(Option(it.name, it.name, Strings.FILTER_PASSED_NOTE))
        nav.openOptions(Strings.FILTER_PASSED, opts, Strings.FILTER_PASSED_EMPTY, Strings.FILTER_PASSED_FOOT) { id ->
            when {
                id == null -> {}
                id == BLOCK_SUSPECTS -> { if (model.addFilterBlocks(suspects)) for (n in suspects) FilterLive.forgetPassed(n) }
                model.addFilterName(false, id) -> FilterLive.forgetPassed(id)
            }
        }
    }

    /** Kendi listem: panodan ya da dosyadan içe aktarma, hosts olarak kopyalama, içe aktarılanları silme. */
    private fun openMine(nav: Nav) {
        val opts = listOf(
            Option(MINE_PASTE, Strings.MINE_PASTE, Strings.MINE_PASTE_NOTE),
            Option(MINE_FILE, Strings.MINE_FILE, Strings.MINE_FILE_NOTE),
            Option(MINE_EXPORT, Strings.MINE_EXPORT, Strings.MINE_EXPORT_NOTE),
            Option(MINE_CLEAR, Strings.MINE_CLEAR, Strings.mineCount(model.importedCount)),
        )
        nav.openOptions(Strings.FILTER_MINE, opts, "", Strings.MINE_FOOT) { id ->
            when (id) {
                MINE_PASTE -> model.importFromClipboard()
                MINE_FILE -> model.importFromFile()
                MINE_EXPORT -> model.copyBlockList()
                MINE_CLEAR -> model.askClearImported()
                else -> {}
            }
        }
    }

    /** İzin ya da kendi engel listesi: "Ekle…" satırı ve kayıtlı alan adları (dokununca kaldırma sorusu). */
    private fun openFilterList(nav: Nav, allow: Boolean) {
        val names = if (allow) model.settings.filterAllow else model.settings.filterBlock
        val opts = ArrayList<Option>()
        opts.add(Option(ADD_ID, Strings.FILTER_ADD, ""))
        for (n in names) opts.add(Option(n, n, Strings.FILTER_REMOVE))
        val title = if (allow) Strings.FILTER_ALLOW else Strings.FILTER_BLOCK
        val foot = if (allow) Strings.FILTER_ALLOW_FOOT else Strings.FILTER_BLOCK_FOOT
        nav.openOptions(title, opts, if (allow) Strings.FILTER_ALLOW_EMPTY else Strings.FILTER_BLOCK_EMPTY, foot) { id ->
            when (id) {
                null -> {}
                ADD_ID -> model.promptFilterName(allow) { openFilterList(nav, allow) }
                else -> model.askRemoveFilterName(allow, id)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun buildConnection(nav: Nav) {
        card { c ->
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.AUTO_CONNECT, Strings.AUTO_CONNECT_NOTE, { it.autoConnect }, { s, v -> s.copy(autoConnect = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.CONNECT_ON_BOOT, Strings.CONNECT_ON_BOOT_NOTE, { it.connectOnBoot }, { s, v -> s.copy(connectOnBoot = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.AUTO_FASTEST, Strings.AUTO_FASTEST_NOTE, { it.autoFastest }, { s, v -> s.copy(autoFastest = v) }))
        }
        card { c ->
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.AUTO_RECONNECT, Strings.AUTO_RECONNECT_NOTE, { it.autoReconnect }, { s, v -> s.copy(autoReconnect = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.FAIL_CLOSED, Strings.FAIL_CLOSED_NOTE, { it.failClosed }, { s, v -> s.copy(failClosed = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.REFRESH_ON_NET, Strings.REFRESH_ON_NET_NOTE, { it.refreshOnNetwork }, { s, v -> s.copy(refreshOnNetwork = v) }))
        }
        card { c ->
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.CONFIRM_OFF, Strings.CONFIRM_OFF_NOTE, { it.confirmDisconnect }, { s, v -> s.copy(confirmDisconnect = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.BLOCK_QUIC, Strings.BLOCK_QUIC_NOTE, { it.blockQuic }, { s, v -> s.copy(blockQuic = v) }))
        }
        card { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.APPS, { appsSummary(it) }) { nav.openApps() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.GUARD, null, Icon.SHIELD) {
                nav.openInfo(Strings.GUARD, Strings.GUARD_BODY, Strings.GUARD_BUTTON) { model.host.openVpnSettings() }
            })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.BATTERY, { batteryText() }, Icon.BOLT) {
                nav.openInfo(Strings.BATTERY, Strings.BATTERY_BODY, Strings.BATTERY_BUTTON) { model.host.openBatterySettings() }
            })
        }
    }

    private fun buildNotifications() {
        card { c ->
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.NOTIFY_CONNECT, Strings.NOTIFY_CONNECT_NOTE, { it.notifyConnect }, { s, v -> s.copy(notifyConnect = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.NOTIFY_DROP, Strings.NOTIFY_DROP_NOTE, { it.notifyDrop }, { s, v -> s.copy(notifyDrop = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.NOTIFY_STOP, Strings.NOTIFY_STOP_NOTE, { it.notifyStop }, { s, v -> s.copy(notifyStop = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.NOTIFY_TIMEOUT, Strings.NOTIFY_TIMEOUT_NOTE, { it.notifyTimeout }, { s, v -> s.copy(notifyTimeout = v) }))
        }
        card { c ->
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.LOCK_HIDE, Strings.LOCK_HIDE_NOTE, { it.hideOnLockscreen }, { s, v -> s.copy(hideOnLockscreen = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.QUIET_NOTIF, Strings.QUIET_NOTIF_NOTE, { it.quietNotification }, { s, v -> s.copy(quietNotification = v) }))
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.NOTIF_PERM, { if (model.host.notificationsAllowed()) Strings.PERM_ALLOWED else Strings.PERM_BLOCKED }, Icon.INFO) {
                model.host.openNotificationSettings()
            })
        }
    }

    private fun buildList(nav: Nav) {
        card { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.RECOMMEND, null, Icon.STAR) { nav.openRecommend() })
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.COMPACT, Strings.COMPACT_NOTE, { it.compact }, { s, v -> s.copy(compact = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.REMEMBER_FILTER, Strings.REMEMBER_FILTER_NOTE, { it.rememberFilter }, { s, v -> s.copy(rememberFilter = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.AUTO_MEASURE, Strings.AUTO_MEASURE_NOTE, { it.autoMeasure }, { s, v -> s.copy(autoMeasure = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.MEASURE_ENC, Strings.MEASURE_ENC_NOTE, { it.measureEncrypted }, { s, v -> s.copy(measureEncrypted = v) }))
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.HIDDEN, { if (it.hidden.isEmpty()) Strings.HIDDEN_NONE else it.hidden.size.toString() }) { openHidden(nav) })
        }
    }

    private fun buildStats(nav: Nav) {
        card { c ->
            c.add(InfoRow(Strings.STAT_QUERIES) { Format.count(it.totalQueries) })
            c.add(InfoRow(Strings.STAT_HITS) { Strings.percent(model.hitPercentTotal()) })
            c.add(InfoRow(Strings.STAT_BLOCKED) { Format.count(it.totalBlocked) })
            c.add(InfoRow(Strings.STAT_TIME) { Format.span(it.totalSeconds) })
            c.add(InfoRow(Strings.STAT_AVG) { s -> s.avgLatencyMs?.let { Format.ms(it) } ?: "—" })
            c.add(InfoRow(Strings.STAT_SAVED) { Format.span(it.savedSeconds) })
            c.add(InfoRow(Strings.STAT_TRAFFIC) { Strings.traffic(Format.bytes(it.bytesUp), Format.bytes(it.bytesDown)) })
            c.add(LatencyChart())
            c.add(WeekChart())
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.SESSIONS, { SessionLog.decode(it.sessions).size.toString() }, Icon.LOG) { nav.openSessions() })
        }
        card { c ->
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.KEEP_HISTORY, Strings.KEEP_HISTORY_NOTE, { it.keepHistory }, { s, v -> s.copy(keepHistory = v) }))
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.SHARE_RESULTS, null, Icon.COPY) { model.shareResults() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.CLEAR_HISTORY, null, Icon.REFRESH) { model.clearHistory() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.RESET_STATS, null, Icon.BLOCK) { model.askResetStats() })
        }
    }

    private fun openProfiles(nav: Nav) {
        val opts = Profiles.all.mapIndexed { i, p -> Option(p.id, Strings.PROFILE_NAMES[i], Strings.PROFILE_NOTES[i]) }
        nav.openOptions(Strings.PROFILES, opts) { id -> if (id != null) model.applyProfile(id) }
    }

    /** Ses paketi listesi: 4 klasik paket ve stile özel 8 animasyonlu paket. */
    private fun openSoundPack(nav: Nav) {
        val cur = model.settings.soundPack
        val opts = SoundPack.values().map { Option(it.id, Strings.packName(it), if (it == SoundPack.AUTO) Strings.SOUND_PACK_NOTE else "", it == cur) }
        nav.openOptions(Strings.SOUND_PACK, opts, footer = Strings.PACKS_NOTE) { id ->
            val p = SoundPack.values().firstOrNull { it.id == id }
            if (p != null) { model.update { it.copy(soundPack = p) }; model.previewSound() }
        }
    }

    private fun openSoundPart(nav: Nav) = openSoundVoicePicker(model, nav)

    private fun buildSound() {
        col.add(SectionTitle(Strings.SEC_SOUND))
        card { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.SOUND_PART, { if (it.soundPart < 0) Strings.SOUND_PART_AUTO else Strings.soundPartName(it.soundPart) }) { openSoundPart(nav) })
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.SOUND_ON, Strings.SOUND_ON_NOTE, { it.soundOn }, { s, v -> s.copy(soundOn = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.SOUND_UI, Strings.SOUND_UI_NOTE, { it.soundUi }, { s, v -> s.copy(soundUi = v) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.SOUND_CONN, Strings.SOUND_CONN_NOTE, { it.soundConn }, { s, v -> s.copy(soundConn = v) }))
            c.add(SliderRow(Strings.SOUND_VOL, { it.soundVolume }, { s, v -> s.copy(soundVolume = v) }, { Strings.percent((it.soundVolume * 100).roundToInt()) }))
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.SOUND_PACK, { Strings.packName(it.soundPack) }) { openSoundPack(nav) })
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.SOUND_OUT, Strings.OPT_SOUND_OUT, { it.soundOutput.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(soundOutput = SoundOutput.values()[i]) },
                noteFn = { Strings.soundOutNote(it.soundOutput) }))
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.SOUND_TEST, null, Icon.BELL) { model.previewSound() })
        }
        card { c ->
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.QUIET_HOURS, Strings.QUIET_NOTE, { it.quietHours }, { s, v -> s.copy(quietHours = v) }))
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.QUIET_RANGE, NightHours.values().map { it.label }, { it.quietRange.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(quietRange = NightHours.values()[i]) }))
        }
        col.add(SectionTitle(Strings.SEC_MOTION_FX))
        card { c ->
            c.add(SliderRow(Strings.ANIM_SPEED, { (it.animSpeed - AppSettings.SPEED_MIN) / (AppSettings.SPEED_MAX - AppSettings.SPEED_MIN) },
                { s, v -> s.copy(animSpeed = (Math.round((AppSettings.SPEED_MIN + v * (AppSettings.SPEED_MAX - AppSettings.SPEED_MIN)) * 20f) / 20f).coerceIn(AppSettings.SPEED_MIN, AppSettings.SPEED_MAX)) },
                { Strings.percent((it.animSpeed * 100).roundToInt()) }))
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.TAP_FX, Strings.TAP_FX_NOTE, { it.tapFx }, { s, v -> s.copy(tapFx = v) }))
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.FX_VARIANT, { Strings.fxVariantName(FxVariants.get(it.fxVariants, it.style)) }) { openFxVariant(nav) })
            c.add(ToggleRow(Strings.CELEBRATE, Strings.CELEBRATE_NOTE, { it.celebrate }, { s, v -> s.copy(celebrate = v) }))
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.HAPTIC_LEVEL, Strings.OPT_HAPTIC, { it.hapticLevel.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(hapticLevel = HapticLevel.values()[i]) }))
        }
    }

    /** Aktif stil için dokunma/kutlama efekti varyantı: özgün (0) ve dört yeni biçim. */
    private fun openFxVariant(nav: Nav) {
        val cur = FxVariants.get(model.settings.fxVariants, model.settings.style)
        val opts = (0 until FxVariants.COUNT).map { Option(it.toString(), Strings.fxVariantName(it), "", it == cur) }
        nav.openOptions(Strings.FX_VARIANT, opts) { id -> id?.toIntOrNull()?.let { model.setFxVariant(it) } }
    }

    private fun buildData() {
        card { c ->
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.COPY_STATUS, null, Icon.COPY) { model.copyStatusSummary() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.EXPORT, null, Icon.COPY) { model.exportSettings() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.IMPORT, null, Icon.LOG) { model.importSettings() })
            c.add(NavRow(Strings.RESET_SETTINGS, null, Icon.REFRESH) { model.askResetSettings() })
        }
    }

    private fun appsSummary(s: AppSettings): String = when (s.appScope) {
        AppScope.ALL -> Strings.APPS_ALL
        AppScope.ONLY -> Strings.appsOnly(s.apps.size)
        AppScope.EXCEPT -> Strings.appsExcept(s.apps.size)
    }

    private fun ruleName(id: String?): String = id?.let { Catalog.byId(it)?.name } ?: Strings.RULE_AUTO

    private fun backupName(id: String?): String = when (id) {
        null -> Strings.BACKUP_OFF
        AppSettings.BACKUP_AUTO -> Strings.BACKUP_FASTEST
        else -> Catalog.byId(id)?.name ?: Strings.BACKUP_OFF
    }

    private fun batteryText(): String = when (model.host.batteryRestricted()) {
        true -> Strings.BATTERY_LIMITED
        false -> Strings.BATTERY_OK
        null -> ""
    }

    /** Sorun giderici: telefon durumunu okuyup bilgi panelinde gösterir; "Yeniden denetle" yeniden okur. */
    /** "Site neden açılmıyor?": bir alan adı yazılır, sonuç bilgi panelinde; engelliyse izin verme düğmesi çıkar. */
    private fun openSiteDiag(nav: Nav) {
        model.host.promptText(Strings.SITE_DIAG, "ornek.com", "", maxLen = 253) { raw ->
            val v = model.siteView(raw)
            nav.openInfo(Strings.SITE_DIAG, v.paragraphs, v.button) { v.allowName?.let { model.addFilterName(true, it) } }
        }
    }

    private fun openTrouble(nav: Nav) {
        val r = Troubleshoot.report(model.host.networkCheck(), model.vpn.active || model.vpn.gwOnly)
        nav.openInfo(Strings.TROUBLE, r.paragraphs, Strings.TROUBLE_RECHECK) { openTrouble(nav) }
    }

    /** Tanılama raporu: metni önce gösterir; paylaşma yalnızca kullanıcı onayıyla yapılır. */
    private fun openDiag(nav: Nav) {
        val st = model.settings
        val (ver, code) = model.host.appVersion()
        val problems = Troubleshoot.report(model.host.networkCheck(), model.vpn.active || model.vpn.gwOnly).problems
        val text = DiagReport.build(DiagInput(
            appVersion = ver, versionCode = code, androidSdk = model.host.androidSdk(),
            deviceModel = model.host.deviceModel(), netKind = model.host.networkKind(),
            vpnActive = model.vpn.active, encryption = st.encryption.name, odoh = st.odoh.name,
            ipMode = st.ipMode.name, failClosed = st.failClosed, strictEncryption = st.strictEncryption,
            filterMem = st.filterMem.name, problems = problems,
            crashCount = model.host.crashes().size, lastCrash = model.host.crashes().firstOrNull()))
        nav.openInfo(Strings.DIAG_TITLE, text.split("\n") + Strings.DIAG_NOTE, Strings.DIAG_SHARE_BTN) { model.host.shareText(text) }
    }

    private fun openBackup(nav: Nav) {
        val cur = model.settings.backupServer
        val opts = ArrayList<Option>()
        opts.add(Option(OFF_ID, Strings.BACKUP_OFF, Strings.BACKUP_OFF_NOTE, cur == null))
        opts.add(Option(AppSettings.BACKUP_AUTO, Strings.BACKUP_FASTEST, Strings.BACKUP_FASTEST_NOTE, cur == AppSettings.BACKUP_AUTO))
        for (s in Catalog.all) opts.add(Option(s.id, s.name, s.note, cur == s.id))
        nav.openOptions(Strings.BACKUP_SERVER, opts) { id -> model.update { it.copy(backupServer = if (id == OFF_ID) null else id) } }
    }

    private fun openHidden(nav: Nav) {
        val opts = model.hiddenServers().map { Option(it.id, it.name, Strings.UNHIDE) }
        nav.openOptions(Strings.HIDDEN, opts, Strings.HIDDEN_NONE) { id -> if (id != null) model.unhide(id) }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val OFF_ID = "off"
        const val ADD_ID = "\u0000add"
        const val BLOCK_SUSPECTS = "\u0000suspects"
        const val MINE_PASTE = "\u0000paste"
        const val MINE_FILE = "\u0000file"
        const val MINE_EXPORT = "\u0000export"
        const val MINE_CLEAR = "\u0000clear"
    }
}

/** En çok kullanılan sunucular ve son oturumlar (yalnızca sunucu, yöntem, süre, sorgu sayısı; ad tutulmaz). */
class SessionsPage(private val model: AppModel, nav: Nav) : ScrollPage(Strings.SESSIONS, true, nav) {
    init {
        col.add(Label(Strings.SESSIONS_NOTE, 13f, ink = Ink.SOFT, maxLines = 0))
        val top = UsageStats.top(model.settings.usage, 3)
        if (top.isNotEmpty()) {
            col.add(SectionTitle(Strings.MOST_USED))
            col.add(SettingsCard().also { c ->
                for ((id, secs) in top) c.add(InfoRow(Catalog.byId(id)?.name ?: id) { Format.span(secs) })
            })
        }
        val sessions = SessionLog.decode(model.settings.sessions).asReversed()
        col.add(SectionTitle(Strings.SESSIONS))
        if (sessions.isEmpty()) col.add(ParagraphCard(Strings.SESSIONS_EMPTY))
        else col.add(SettingsCard().also { c -> for (x in sessions) c.add(SessionRow(x, model)) })
        finish()
    }
}

/** Bağlantı geçmişinde tek satır: sunucu · yöntem, zaman, süre ve bitiş nedeni. */
class SessionRow(private val s: Session, private val model: AppModel) : Node() {
    private val title = (Catalog.byId(s.serverId)?.name ?: s.serverId) + " · " + Strings.protoName(s.proto)
    private val line1 = whenText() + " · " + Strings.endReason(s.end)
    private val line2 = Strings.sessionLine(Format.span(s.seconds), Format.count(s.queries))
    private var shown = arrayOf(title, line1, line2)
    private var titleRows: List<String> = listOf(title)
    private var laidW = -1f
    private var laidFs = 0f

    private fun whenText(): String {
        val now = model.host.now()
        val day = app.dnshizli.core.DailyStats.today(s.startMs)
        val today = app.dnshizli.core.DailyStats.today(now)
        val yesterday = app.dnshizli.core.DailyStats.today(now - 86_400_000L)
        val d = when (day) { today -> Strings.TODAY; yesterday -> Strings.YESTERDAY; else -> String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%02d.%02d", day % 100, (day / 100) % 100) }
        return d + " " + Format.hm(s.startMs)
    }

    override fun layout(env: Env, maxW: Float) {
        w = maxW
        // uzun sunucu adı kesilmez: en çok iki satıra sarılır, satır buna göre uzar
        titleRows = TextFit.wrap(env.metrics, title, w - 32f, env.sz(15f), true).ifEmpty { listOf(title) }.take(2)
        h = 74f + (titleRows.size - 1) * env.sz(15f) * 1.25f
        laidW = -1f
    }

    private fun relay(env: Env) {
        laidW = w; laidFs = env.fs
        shown = arrayOf(
            title,
            TextFit.ellipsize(env.metrics, line1, w - 32f, env.sz(13f), false),
            TextFit.ellipsize(env.metrics, line2, w - 32f, env.sz(13f), false),
        )
    }

    override fun draw(g: Gfx, env: Env) {
        if (laidW != w || laidFs != env.fs) relay(env)
        g.paint(env.theme.text)
        val step = env.sz(15f) * 1.25f
        for (i in 0 until titleRows.size) g.text(titleRows[i], 16f, 24f + i * step, env.sz(15f), true, ALIGN_LEFT)
        val extra = (titleRows.size - 1) * step
        g.paint(env.theme.textSoft)
        g.text(shown[1], 16f, 44f + extra, env.sz(13f), false, ALIGN_LEFT)
        g.text(shown[2], 16f, 62f + extra, env.sz(13f), false, ALIGN_LEFT)
    }

    override fun a11y(): A11y = A11y("$title. $line1. $line2", Role.TEXT)
}

// =============================================================================== uygulama seçimi

/**
 * Uygulama satırları kartı. Yüzlerce uygulama olabilir: yalnızca ekranda görünen satırlar çizilir
 * ([offset]: bu sayfanın kaydırma konumu; kart doğrudan içerik sütununun çocuğudur).
 */
class AppListCard(private val offset: () -> Float) : Node() {
    fun setApps(list: List<AppEntry>) {
        removeAll()
        for (a in list) {
            val pkg = a.pkg
            add(ToggleRow(a.label, null, { pkg in it.apps }, { s, v -> s.copy(apps = if (v) s.apps + pkg else s.apps - pkg) }))
        }
    }

    override fun layout(env: Env, maxW: Float) {
        w = maxW
        var cy = 0f
        for (k in kids) { k.layout(env, maxW); k.x = 0f; k.y = cy; cy += k.h }
        h = cy
    }

    override fun draw(g: Gfx, env: Env) {
        env.art.card(g, 0f, 0f, w, h, M.CARD_R)
        val top = offset() - y - 80f
        val bottom = offset() + env.height - y + 80f
        g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (env.theme.dark) 0.14f else 0.55f))
        var i = 0
        while (i < kids.size) {
            val k = kids[i++]
            if (k.y + k.h < top || k.y > bottom) continue
            g.save(); g.translate(k.x, k.y); k.draw(g, env); g.restore()
            if (i > 1) {
                g.paint(Rgb.alpha(Rgb.WHITE, if (env.theme.dark) 0.14f else 0.55f))      // çocuğun boyası ezmiş olabilir
                g.rect(16f, k.y - 0.5f, w - 16f, k.y + 0.5f)
            }
        }
    }
}

/** "Hangi uygulamalar": DNS'in uygulanacağı uygulamaları seçer. */
class AppsPage(private val model: AppModel, nav: Nav) : ScrollPage(Strings.APPS, true, nav) {
    private val status = Label("", 14f, ink = Ink.SOFT, align = ALIGN_CENTER, maxLines = 0)
    private val list = AppListCard { scroll.offset }
    private val pending = ParagraphCard(Strings.APPS_PENDING)
    private val apply = ActionButton(Strings.APPS_APPLY, true) { model.applyAppsNow() }
    private var seen = -1
    private var shownApps: List<AppEntry>? = null

    init {
        col.add(SettingsCard().also { c ->
            c.add(SegmentRow(Strings.APPS_MODE, Strings.OPT_APPS, { it.appScope.ordinal }, { s, i -> s.copy(appScope = AppScope.values()[i]) }))
        })
        col.add(ParagraphCard(Strings.APPS_NOTE))
        col.add(pending)
        col.add(apply)
        col.add(status)
        col.add(list)
        finish()
        col.gap = 12f
        model.loadApps()
    }

    override fun onLaidOut(env: Env, left: Float) { seen = -1 }

    override fun tick(dt: Float, env: Env): Boolean {
        if (seen != model.version) {
            seen = model.version
            val s = model.settings
            val apps = model.apps
            if (apps !== shownApps) { shownApps = apps; list.setApps(apps ?: emptyList()) }
            val picking = s.appScope != AppScope.ALL
            val installed = apps?.map { it.pkg }?.toSet() ?: emptySet()
            status.text = when {
                !picking -> ""
                apps == null -> Strings.APPS_LOADING
                apps.isEmpty() -> Strings.APPS_EMPTY
                s.apps.none { it in installed } -> Strings.APPS_NONE_SELECTED
                else -> ""
            }
            list.visible = picking && !apps.isNullOrEmpty()
            pending.visible = model.appsPending
            apply.visible = model.appsPending
            relayoutContent(env)
        }
        return super.tick(dt, env)
    }
}

// =============================================================================== yardım ve günlük

/** İçinde çok satırlı yazı olan cam kart. [tail] verilirse metnin son cümlesi olarak yeşil renkte, aynı kartta çizilir. */
class ParagraphCard(text: String, tail: String? = null) : Node() {
    private val label = Label(text, 15f, ink = Ink.TEXT, maxLines = 0)
    private val last = tail?.let { Label(it, 15f, ink = Ink.GOOD, maxLines = 0) }

    // Uzun basınca kartın metni panoya kopyalanır (yardım yazılarını paylaşmak için).
    override val tappable: Boolean get() = true
    override val longPressable: Boolean get() = true
    override fun onLongPress(env: Env): Boolean {
        env.model.copy(if (last == null) label.text else label.text + "\n" + last.text)
        return true
    }
    override fun layout(env: Env, maxW: Float) {
        w = maxW
        label.layout(env, maxW - 32f)
        label.x = 16f; label.y = 14f
        h = label.h + 28f
        if (last != null) {
            last.layout(env, maxW - 32f)
            last.x = 16f; last.y = 14f + label.h + 8f
            h = last.y + last.h + 14f
        }
    }
    override fun draw(g: Gfx, env: Env) {
        env.art.card(g, 0f, 0f, w, h, M.CARD_R)
        g.save(); g.translate(label.x, label.y); label.draw(g, env); g.restore()
        if (last != null) { g.save(); g.translate(last.x, last.y); last.draw(g, env); g.restore() }
    }
    override fun a11y(): A11y = A11y(if (last == null) label.text else label.text + " " + last.text, Role.TEXT)
}
